t: Musnad Ahmad 8396: Muslim-Brotherhood – Let’s adopt the attitude: we learn, and we teach.
e: Whoever enters our mosque in order to teach goodness, or to learn it himself, he is striving in jihad in the way of Allah. Whoever enters it for another reason, he is viewing what does not belong to him. Source: Musnad A

t: Quran 47:38 – Surah Muhammad: Allah replaces (punishes) those Muslims who do not spend their wealth/ give Sadaqah for Jihad Fi Sabilillah!
e: هَا أَنتُمْ هَٰؤُلَاءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ ۖ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ ۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ
x: هَا أَنتُمْ هَٰؤُلَاءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ ۖ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ ۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوا أَمْثَالَكُم Sahih International Here you are – those invited to spend in the cause of Allah – but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you. Bangla শুন, তোমরাই তো তারা, যাদেরকে আল্লাহর পথে ব্যয় করার আহবান জানানো হচ্ছে, অতঃপর তোমাদের কেউ কেউ কৃপণতা করছে। যারা কৃপণতা করছে, তারা নিজেদের প্রতিই কৃপণতা করছে। আল্লাহ অভাবমুক্ত এবং তোমরা অভাবগ্রস্থ। যদি তোমরা মুখ ফিরিয়ে নাও, তবে তিনি তোমাদের পরিবর্তে অন্য জাতিকে প্রতিষ্ঠিত করবেন, এরপর তারা তোমাদের মত হবে না। Bismillah! Al-Hamdulillah! O Muslim, do you wonder why this is happening to the UMMAH! It’s because ‘Allah replaces those who TURN AWAY from His CALL (Command)!” Subhanallah! The warning of replacement of Muslims for withholding wealth and not spending in Allah’s path (Jihad, as this Ayah is related to the context of fighting Jihad, not about regular Sadaqah) And Allah knows best. May Allah guide us!

t: Quran 2:120.7. Why only reading a translation is not enough to save you from the punishment of Allah, Shadidul Eqab?
e: وَلَن تَرْضَىٰ عَنكَ الْيَهُودُ وَلَا النَّصَارَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى اللَّهِ هُوَ الْهُدَىٰ ۗ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُم بَعْدَ الَّذِي جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ ۙ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ
x: وَلَن تَرْضَىٰ عَنكَ الْيَهُودُ وَلَا النَّصَارَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى اللَّهِ هُوَ الْهُدَىٰ ۗ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُم بَعْدَ الَّذِي جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ ۙ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ And never will the Jews or the Christians approve of you until you follow their Deen. Say, “Indeed, the guidance of Allah is the [only] guidance.” If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allah no protector or helper. Bangla ইহুদী ও খ্রীষ্টানরা কখনই আপনার প্রতি সন্তুষ্ট হবে না, যে পর্যন্ত না আপনি তাদের ধর্মের অনুসরণ করেন। বলে দিন, যে পথ আল্লাহ প্রদর্শন করেন, তাই হল সরল পথ । যদি আপনি তাদের আকাঙ্খাসমূহের অনুসরণ করেন, ঐ জ্ঞান লাভের পর, যা আপনার কাছে পৌঁছেছে, তবে কেউ আল্লাহর কবল থেকে আপনার উদ্ধারকারী ও সাহায্যকারী নেই। Why only reading a translation is not enough to save you from the punishment of Allah, Shadidul Eqab? When you read a translation, how was the word ‘Millat’ translated? As ‘Religion’. So, you think, ‘Hey, I don’t follow their religion, I follow Islam!’ That’s how you are done understanding this ayah, therefore, you don’t realize the importance of this Ayah as a Muslim. And that’s how you are heading towards the punishment of Allah. May Allah guide you and me and save us from Allah’s punishment. Did you notice how you should greet a Muslim? Do you not understand the importance of mentioning something in the Quran? Does it not cross your mind how important it is to follow Allah’s prescribed way in your daily life? Then how come you say, ‘Hi’ and ‘Bye’ to a Muslim? Is it Allah’s deen you followed or the deen of the Kuffar? (Just as a quick example, and there are hundreds of them if not thousands. Please other posts of this Ayah to get the more clarification of the meaning.) Then, what not in your daily life you follow the ways of the Kuffar? And Allah knows best. May Allah guide you and me to follow Allah’s Deen completely. Ameen.

Part (4) بَعْدَ الَّذِي جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ “A fter what has come to you of knowledge, “ “ ঐ জ্ঞান লাভের পর, যা আপনার কাছে পৌঁছেছে “ :|: Why learning Deen is Obligatory for a Muslim? :|: What does it mean? Allah confirms here that a Muslim has been given the knowledge. What is that knowledge? As Allah has already mentioned in the previous part, His guidance. That knowledge is the GUIDANCE. Therefore, Muslims must have, Muslims must possess that knowledge. Allah, Al-Hakeem, equipped Muslims with the knowledge of what Allah’s Deen is. So, what’s the knowledge for? That knowledge is what should save a Muslim from following Kuffar’s Deen. Because the CORE point/ issue of this Ayah is warning about following Kuffar’s Deen. Therefore, if you do not learn Deen, you won’t be able to save yourself from following Kuffar’s Deen. Period. :|: Understanding the Time – Understanding the Misguidance: :|: :|: Muslims Abandoned the Quran – Abandoned the Wahee :|: But what do we see today? Muslims, not only follow Kuffar’s Deen, rather they even endorse and establish Kuffar’s Deen, democracy. Muslims, not only follow Kuffar’s Deen, they obey and submit to the Kuffar’s Sharia’/ Deen by willingly coming, living and settling under the Kuffar’s authority. The question is, How is it possible? How is it possible that when Allah gave such warning to the Muslims for following Kuffar’s Deen, yet instead of keeping themselves away from following it, they endorse, establish and submit to the Kuffar’s Deen? It’s only possible when they leave that guidance, when these Muslims abandon the Quran. But now, the next question is, Don’t those Muslims learn Deen? Yes, they are learned Muslims, learned Ulama of Muslims, and they are the followers of the big Ulama. How come then, that they obey Kuffar’s Deen? How come they establish Kuffar’s Deen by endorsing it? How come they call to establish Kuffar’s Deen? How come they submit to the Kuffar’s Deen, willingly? The only answer is, Though they are learned Muslims but they don’t take guidance from the Quran. Their learning is based on the understanding of the contemporary Ulema they follow. And their contemporary Ulema teach them the copy and paste ‘package Deen’ they learned from the Salaf while the Salaf did not encounter such level of aggression from the Kuffar’s Deen in their times that have been forced on us by the Kuffar’s in the last 100 years. A few examples are: Democracy was not present in the time of the Salaf. Citizenship and Kuffar’s Law was not enforced on Muslims in the time of the Salaf even though they went to the Kuffar’s lands for Dawah. Kuffar’s lifestyle was remain unknown to the regular Muslims living in the isolated Muslim lands during the time of the Salaf while today Kuffar was able to forced their Deen inside every house of the Muslims. Yet these Ulema copy paste the Deen from the Salaf while remain unaware that not only the regular Muslims but he Ulama themsleves also adopted Kuffar’s Deen in every walks of life from family issues, business, finance, trade, education, health, medicine, food to what not. So, these Muslims and their Ulama keep doing ‘five pillars’ following the ‘Package Deen’ from the Salaf while Kuffar has demolished the Roof, demolished the wall (The Authority/ Khilafah) that would have protected Muslims from following Kuffar’s Deen. Therefore, though we have so many learned Ulema, so many learned Muslims, so many Muslim organisations, so many Muslims who practice Islam, yet they are either endorsing Kuffar’s Deen of democracy or obeying Kuffar’s Deen willingly and the Ummah at large drown into the ocean of Kuffar’s Deen and adopted it in their life. Where as, even reading of a few translations and contemplating on Allah’s Ayat would have been sufficient for even a regular Muslim to understand Kuffar’s Deen and stay away from it. But they were warned about how difficult it is to understand and contemplate on the Quran. Therefore, the Quran became an abandoned thing to the Muslims. They get Deen, they understand Deen, and they take Deen what comes from their respected Ulama only. But again, that would not have been a problem if the Ulama had contemplated on the Quran themselves. That’s the only explanation of this mass misguidance of the Ulama behind endorsing Kuffar’s Deen and submitting willingly under the Kuffar’s Deen by living in the Kuffar’s lands. And that points to only one root cause, The Ummah left contemplating on the Quran, The Ummah thus abandoned the Quran. Subhanallah! That’s why Ibn Kathir commented that not contemplating on the Quran is abandoning the Quran when he commented on the Ayah, about ‘Rasululllah’s complaint about the Ummah saying, “O My Rabb, this my Ummah has abandoned the Quran”. This Quran is what Allah instructed Muslims to contemplate. This Quran is what Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam has prescribed as protection at the end of the time by holding onto it. But this scholarship of Ummah abandoned the Quran themselves and also made it Haram for Muslims to contemplate. They only preach learning the package understanding of the Quran by sitting under the Ulama who teach the ‘package Deen’. So, Allah Subhanahu clearly warned you that if you follow their ways, after that knowledge came to you, you will be doomed. May Allah protect us from that disaster. And Allah knows best. May Allah guide Muslims. May Allah protect us from following Kuffar’s Deen.

Part 3, 4 and 5: وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُم بَعْدَ الَّذِي جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ ۙ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allah no protector or helper. ঐ জ্ঞান লাভের পর, যা আপনার কাছে পৌঁছেছে, তবে কেউ আল্লাহর কবল থেকে আপনার উদ্ধারকারী ও সাহায্যকারী নেই। The 3rd Question: Do you know about the questions in Qabr? Here comes the Hadith which states the 3rd question in the Qabr, “ W hat is your Deen? (Sunan Abu Dawood, Vol 5, Book 39, The Book of the Sunnah, Hadith No. 4753; Musnad Ahmad, 18063 al-Albaani in Saheeh al-Jaami’, 1676.) And therefore, this Ayah of the Quran and the said Hadith makes a clear link to the THIRD question in the Qabr. So, how would you respond, and who will help you against Allah’s punishment in the Qabr to begin with? And yet we are not sure whether this punishment will even end in the Qabr or continue during the Qiyamah or even lead to the Jahannam. Allah knows best. But that only tells you the certainty of punishment but yet we really don’t know the degree or the level of treatment. And what kind of punishment would that be? Depends on how the matter will be treated, right? Allah Ta’ala didn’t mention the category of punishment, but you can understand, it will be severe because of Allah’s way of warning, “You won’t find anyone to help you” SubhanAllah, another Hadith comes to mind, Remember other Hadiths which describe that different Malaikah will approach the person from different sides in the Qabr and then Salat, Siam, Quran etc, Ebadah will protect the person from the punishment of those Malaikah? But here Allah says, “ None will be at your aid” Does this give a clue how the matter will be dealt with, what would be the grade of the punishment? And here the other hadith comes: you know the Hadith that sets the level of treatment on following the Kuffar’s deen. “ The one who follows kuffar’s ways, he is one of them” (Abu Dawood, al-Libaas, 3512. Al-Albaani said in Saheeh Abi Dawood, (it is) hasan saheeh. No. 3401) As per this hadith, it could make a Muslim, one of ‘them’, meaning, those who belongs to the Kuffar. Does it mean, even though a Muslim gives two correct answers in the grave, failing to give the correct answer to the 3rd question could block his way to Jannah? Allah knows best. May Allah make Muslims understand Deen. May Allah protect Muslim from following Kuffar’s Deen. May Allah guide Muslims. and may Allah save us from Allah’s punishment.

x: In 1924, Turkey abolished the Ottoman Caliphate through a statute numbered 431, or Law No. 431. The construction of the statute was somewhat ambiguous in that it stated that the Caliphate was abolished because that institution was inherent to the State and the Republic, thus almost justifying its abolishment as a separate institution on the grounds that to keep it would be superfluous. Today, a very marginal political faction in Turkey is using this construction to argue that, despite the repeated references to secularism in the Turkish Constitution, it would be perfectly constitutional to reintroduce the caliphate. The legal consensus, however, is that the caliphate is abolished and cannot be reintroduced. Commentary :: Did Republican Turkey Really Abolish the Ottoman Caliphate? The Curious Case of Law No. 431

x: :|: Understanding of the End of the Time :|: :|: Misguidance – Misinterpretation of Deen :|: :|: Know the Misguidance – Know the ASTRAY U’lama :|: :|: Muslims Abandoned the Quran :|: Sa’eed bin Jumhan narrated: “Safinah narrated to me, he said: ‘The Messenger of Allah(s.a.w) said: “Al-Khilafah will be in my Ummah for thirty years, then there will be a monarchy after that.” Then Safinah said to me: ‘Count the Khilafah of Abu Bakr,’ Then he said: ‘Count the Khilafah of ‘Umar and the Khilafah of ‘Uthman.’ Then he said to me: ‘Count the Khilafah of ‘Ali.” ‘ He said: “So we found that they add up to thirty years.” Sa’eed said: “I said to him: ‘Banu Umaiyyah claim that the Khilafah is among them.’ He said: ‘Banu Az-Zarqa’ lie, rather they are a monarchy, among the worst of monarchies. (Tirmidhi 2226, Saheeh) “‘ باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخِلاَفَةِ حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَشْرَجُ بْنُ نُبَاتَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُمْهَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَفِينَةُ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ “‏ الْخِلاَفَةُ فِي أُمَّتِي ثَلاَثُونَ سَنَةً ثُمَّ مُلْكٌ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي سَفِينَةُ أَمْسِكْ خِلاَفَةَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَخِلاَفَةَ عُمَرَ وَخِلاَفَةَ عُثْمَانَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي أَمْسِكْ خِلاَفَةَ عَلِيٍّ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا ثَلاَثِينَ سَنَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعِيدٌ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ بَنِي أُمَيَّةَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ الْخِلاَفَةَ فِيهِمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَذَبُوا بَنُو الزَّرْقَاءِ بَلْ هُمْ مُلُوكٌ مِنْ شَرِّ الْمُلُوكِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عُمَرَ وَعَلِيٍّ قَالاَ لَمْ يَعْهَدِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْخِلاَفَةِ شَيْئًا ‏.‏ وَهَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ قَدْ رَوَاهُ غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُمْهَانَ وَلاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُمْهَانَ ‏.‏ গ্রন্থঃ সূনান আত তিরমিজী [তাহকীককৃত] অধ্যায়ঃ ৩১/ কলহ ও বিপর্যয় (كتاب الفتن عن رسول الله ﷺ) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ২২২৬ ৪৮. খিলাফাত প্রসঙ্গে ২২২৬। সাঈদ ইবনু জুহমান (রহঃ) হতে বর্ণিত আছে, তিনি বলেন, সাফীনাহ (রাঃ) আমার নিকট বর্ণনা করেন যে, রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেছেনঃ “আমার উম্মাতের খিলাফাতের সময়কাল (শাসনকাল) হবে ত্ৰিশবছর, তারপর হবে রাজতন্ত্র।” সহীহ, সহীহাহ (৪৫৯, ১৫৩৪, ১৫৩৫)। তারপর সাফীনাহ (রাঃ) আমাকে বললেন, তুমি আবূ বাকর (রাঃ)-এর খিলাফতকাল গণনা কর। তারপর বললেন, উমার ও উসমান (রাঃ)-এর খিলাফতকাল গণনা কর। তারপর বললেন, আলী (রাঃ)-এর খিলাফতকালও গণনা কর। আমরা গণনা করে এর সময়কাল ত্ৰিশবছরই পেলাম। সাঈদ (রহঃ) বললেন, আমি তাকে বললাম, বানু উমাইয়্যার জনগণও দাবি করে যে, তাদের মাঝেও খিলাফাত বিদ্যমান? তিনি বললেন, যারকার সন্তানেরা মিথ্যা বলছে, বরং তারা তো নিকৃষ্ট রাজতন্ত্রের অন্তর্ভুক্ত রাজতান্ত্রিক গোষ্ঠী। আবূ ঈসা বলেন, উমার ও আলী (রাঃ) হতেও এ অনুচ্ছেদে হাদীস বর্ণিত আছে। তারা বলেন, খিলাফাত প্রসঙ্গে রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম কোন অঙ্গীকার করে যাননি। এ হাদীসটি হাসান। অবশ্য এ হাদীসটি সাঈদ ইবনু জুমহান (রাহঃ) হতে একাধিক বর্ণনাকারী বর্ণনা করেছেন। আমরা এ হাদীস প্রসঙ্গে শুধুমাত্র তার রিওয়ায়াত হিসাবেই জেনেছি। The MISINTERPRETATION of this Hadith by the MISGUIDED ones: They say Khilafah is meant to be only 30 years; therefore, we don’t need Khilafah. La Hawla Wa La Quwata Illa Billah! Who are these misguided ones? If you know them, these are the ones already made Shirk easy. Either they live under the Kuffar’s authority, submitting willingly to the Kuffar’s authority, or they do not reject Taghut, but rather they accept and support Taghut as Muslim rulers. Therefore, to justify the Shirk and Kufr that they are already in, they misinterpret this Hadith, saying, “We don’t need Khilafah”. Rather, this Hadith is not a command to follow, but rather a prediction of the situation of the Ummah that they will fall into, as in such other hadith that says about entering into a lizard hole by following Jews and Christians. Does that Hadith mean a prescription to follow the Jews and the Christians? No! Saheeh Bukhari 3456. Know Rasulullah’s (Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam) PREDICTION about those ‘Muslims’ Following Kuffar’s Deen’ And the other predictions which say, “Never a Prophet had been sent before me by Allah towards his nation who had not among his people (his) disciples and companions who followed his ways and obeyed his command. Then, there came after them their successors who said whatever they did not practice, and practiced whatever they were not commanded to do. ” Saheeh Muslim 179/ (80/50). The Deen that Raulullah has brought in was changed after Sahaba. But how do you notice them? Only by reconciling with the Quran and the Sunnah! Most importantly, they abandon the Quran, which repeatedly says the obligation of establishing Khilafah. وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَـٰتٍۢ لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ ١٦٥ “He is the One Who has placed you as Khalifah on earth and elevated some of you in rank over others, so He may test you with what He has given you. Surely your Lord is swift in punishment, but He is certainly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.” “আর তিনি সে সত্তা, যিনি তোমাদেরকে যমীনের খলীফা বানিয়েছেন এবং তোমাদের কতককে কতকের উপর মর্যাদা দিয়েছেন, যাতে তিনি তোমাদেরকে যা প্রদান করেছেন, তাতে তোমাদেরকে পরীক্ষা করেন। নিশ্চয় তোমার রব দ্রুত শাস্তিদানকারী এবং নিশ্চয় তিনি ক্ষমাশীল, পরম দয়ালু।” (Sura Al-A’nam 6:165) For a further understanding, you can listen to this: https://archive.org/details/DidTheKhilafahLastForThirtyYears

An extract from the FATWA of the Shaykh al-‘Allāmah Sulaymān Ibn Nāsir al-‘Alwān (فك الله أسره) “Firstly, acquiring the citizenship of the kuffar is prohibited by default in all cases. Because what it means to acquire a citizenship is to comply with their systems, making tahakum to them, and submitting to their laws, and that you become an individual from amongst them.” “So whenever you acquire their citizenship, then the laws of every land [you go to] would apply upon you, and the laws are mandated in all lands. For that reason, when citizenships initially came out, and some Muslims acquired citizenships due to being subjected to severe harm, and [due to] the pressure from their rulers or the torture they would face. This issue was brought up around about 60 years ago, and no one at the time differed concerning its prohibition which is astonishing [compared to our times]. Rather, they differed upon whether he becomes a kafir or not, and they had two opinions regarding that: There are those who said he becomes an apostate; by merely acquiring the citizenship, he would become an apostate (MURTAD). And others said he does not become an apostate, because he is Mukrah (under compulsion, fleeing torture, etc.), however, he is sinful by that (as he shouldn’t have acquired it, but rather remained in their land temporarily, Wallahu A’lam).” The SHIRK and KUFR in acquiring citizenship of the Kuffar’s lands: You have to do a ‘Jury Duty’ in a court when you are called. x: :|: Know Your Creator – Know Your Rabb :|: :|: Allah – Ash-Shakur, Al-Gafur :|: :|: Forgiveness in Islam :|: গ্রন্থঃ সহীহ মুসলিম (হাঃ একাডেমী) অধ্যায়ঃ ৫০। তাওবাহ্ (كتاب التوبة) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ৬৮৫৩ ৬৮৫৩-(৭/২৭৪৭) মুহাম্মাদ ইবনু সাব্বাহ ও যুহায়র ইবনু হারব (রহঃ) ….. আনাস ইবনু মালিক (রাযিঃ) থেকে বর্ণিত। তিনি বলেন, রসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেছেনঃ বান্দা যখন আল্লাহর কাছে তাওবাহ করে তখন আল্লাহ ঐ লোকের চেয়েও বেশি আনন্দিত হন, যে মরুভূমিতে নিজ সওয়ারীর উপর আরোহিত ছিল। তারপর সওয়ারটি তার হতে হারিয়ে যায়। আর তার উপর ছিল তার খাদ্য ও পানীয়। এরপর নিরাশ হয়ে সে একটি গাছের ছায়ায় এসে আরাম করে এবং তার উটটি সম্বন্ধে সম্পূর্ণরূপে নিরাশ হয়ে পড়ে। এমতাবস্থায় হঠাৎ উটটি তার কাছে এসে দাঁড়ায়। অমনিই সে, তার লাগাম ধরে ফেলে। এরপর সে আনন্দে আত্মহারা হয়ে বলে উঠে, হে আল্লাহ! তুমি আমার বান্দা, আমি তোমার রব। আনন্দে আত্মহারা হয়ে সে ভুল করে ফেলেছে। (ইসলামিক ফাউন্ডেশন ৬৭০৮, ইসলামিক সেন্টার ৬৭৬৩) Anas b. Malik reported that Rasulullah Sallallahu A’laihi Wa Sallam said, “Allah is more pleased with the repentance of a servant as he turns towards Him for repentance than this that one amongst you is upon the camel in a water-less desert and there is upon (that camel) his provision of food and drink also and it is lost by him, and he having lost all hope (to get that) lies down in the shadow and is disappointed about his camel and there he finds that camel standing before him. He takes hold of his nose-string and then out of boundless joy says: 0 Rabb, You are my servant and I am your Rabb. He commits this mistake out of extreme delight.” (Saheeh Muslim 6853-7/2747) باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، – وَهُوَ عَمُّهُ – قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ “‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ حِينَ يَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ كَانَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ بِأَرْضِ فَلاَةٍ فَانْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ وَعَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَأَيِسَ مِنْهَا فَأَتَى شَجَرَةً فَاضْطَجَعَ فِي ظِلِّهَا قَدْ أَيِسَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَبَيْنَا هُوَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا هُوَ بِهَا قَائِمَةً عِنْدَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِخِطَامِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَأَنَا رَبُّكَ ‏.‏ أَخْطَأَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ ‏”

t: Saheeh Bukhari 6227. Greetings of a Muslim to another Muslim anywhere, everywhere is ‘AsSalamu A’laikum’, neither ‘Good Morning!’ nor ‘সুপ্রভাত!’

x: :|: Islam – the Supreme Way of Life :|: :|: Islamic Way of Life – Social :|: :|: Know the BASIC of Islam :|: :|: Islamic Education – an Obligation for a Muslim :|: :|: My Deen Study :|: :|: Imagine the Unseen :|: :|: Know the Certain Knowledge – Human Beings :|: :|: Muslims Following Kuffar’s Deen :|: গ্রন্থঃ সহীহ বুখারী (তাওহীদ) অধ্যায়ঃ ৭৯/ অনুমতি প্রার্থনা (كتاب الاستئذان) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ৬২২৭ আবূ হুরাইরাহ (রাঃ) হতে বর্ণিত যে, নাবী সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেছেনঃ আল্লাহ তা‘আলা আদাম (আ.)-কে তাঁর যথাযোগ্য গঠনে সৃষ্টি করেছেন, তাঁর উচ্চতা ছিল ষাট হাত। তিনি তাঁকে সৃষ্টি করে বললেনঃ “তুমি যাও। উপবিষ্ট ফেরেশতাদের এই দলকে সালাম করো এবং তুমি মনোযোগ সহকারে শোনবে তারা তোমার সালামের কী জবাব দেয়? কারণ এটাই হবে তোমার ও তোমার বংশধরের সম্ভাষণ (তাহিয়্যা)।” তাই তিনি গিয়ে বললেনঃ ‘আসসালামু ‘আলাইকুম’ । তাঁরা জবাবে বললেনঃ ‘আসসালামু ‘আলাইকা ওয়া রহমাতুল্লাহ’। তাঁরা বাড়িয়ে বললেনঃ ‘ওয়া রহমাতুল্লাহ’ বাক্যটি। তারপর নাবী সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম আরও বললেনঃ যারা জান্নাতে প্রবেশ করবে তারা আদাম (আঃ)-এর আকৃতি বিশিষ্ট হবে। তারপর থেকে এ পর্যন্ত মানুষের আকৃতি ক্রমশঃ কমে আসছে। (আধুনিক প্রকাশনী- ৫৭৮৬, ইসলামিক ফাউন্ডেশন- ৫৬৮১) Narrated Abu Huraira: Rasulullah Sallallahu A’laihi Wa Sallam said, “Allah created Adam in His picture, sixty cubits (about 30 meters) in height. When He created him, He said (to him), “Go and greet that group of angels sitting there, and listen what they will say in reply to you, for that will be your greeting and the greeting of your offspring.” Adam (went and) said, ‘As-Salamu alaikum (Peace be upon you).’ They replied, ‘AsSalamu-‘Alaika wa Rahmatullah (Peace and Allah’s Mercy be on you). So they increased ‘Wa Rahmatullah’ Rasulullah Sallallahu A’laihi Wa Sallam added: “So whoever will enter Paradise, will be of the shape and picture of Adam Since then the creation of Adam’s (offspring) (i.e. stature of human beings is being diminished continuously) to the present time.” (Saheeh Bukhari 6227) بَاب بَدْءِ السَّلاَم حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ آدَمَ عَلَى صُورَتِهِ، طُولُهُ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا، فَلَمَّا خَلَقَهُ قَالَ اذْهَبْ فَسَلِّمْ عَلَى أُولَئِكَ النَّفَرِ مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ جُلُوسٌ، فَاسْتَمِعْ مَا يُحَيُّونَكَ، فَإِنَّهَا تَحِيَّتُكَ وَتَحِيَّةُ ذُرِّيَّتِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَزَادُوهُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، فَكُلُّ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ آدَمَ، فَلَمْ يَزَلِ الْخَلْقُ يَنْقُصُ بَعْدُ حَتَّى الآنَ ‏”‏‏.‏

Responsibility towards Muslims Brothers Making DUA for Your Muslim Brothers Enjoining GOOD and forbidding EVIL Requisites – Seeking SIRATUL MUSTAQEEM Dua asking for GUIDANCE باب الدُّعَاءِ فِي صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَقِيَامِهِ ‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَأَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْتَتِحُ صَلاَتَهُ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَتْ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ افْتَتَحَ صَلاَتَهُ ‏ “‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ ‏”‏ ‘Abd al-Rahman b. ‘Auf reported: I asked ‘A’isha, the mother of the believers, (to tell me) the words with which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. She said: When he got up at night he would commence his prayer with these words: “O Allah, RABB of Gabriel, and Michael, and Israfil, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who knowest the unseen and the seen; Thou decidest amongst Thy servants concerning their differences. Guide me with Thy permission in the divergent views (which the people) hold about Truth, for it is Thou Who guidest whom Thou wilt to the Straight Path.” (Saheeh Muslim 1969-200/770) গ্রন্থঃ সহীহ মুসলিম হাদিস নম্বরঃ ১৬৯৬-(২০০/৭৭০) মুহাম্মাদ ইবনুল মুসান্না, মুহাম্মাদ ইবনু হাতিম, আবদ ইবনু হুমায়দ ও আবূ মা’ন আররাক্বাশী (রহঃ) …. ‘আবদুর রহমান ইবনু আওফ (রাযিঃ) থেকে বর্ণিত। তিনি বলেন, আমি উন্মুল মু’মিনীন আয়িশাহ (রাযিঃ) কে জিজ্ঞেস করলাম যে, নাবী সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম রাতের বেলা যখন সলাত আদায় করতেন তখন কীভাবে তার সলাত শুরু করতেন? জবাবে আয়িশাহ (রাযিঃ) বললেনঃ রাতে যখন তিনি (সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম) সলাত আদায় করতে উঠতেন তখন এ দু’আটি পড়ে সলাত শুরু করতেনঃ “আল্ল-হুম্মা রব্বা জিবরীলা ওয়া মীকাঈলা ওয়া ইসরা-ফীলা ফা-তিরাস সামা-ওয়া-তি ওয়াল আরযি আ-লিমাল গয়বি ওয়াশ্ব শাহা-দাতি আনতা তাহকুমু বায়না ইবা-দিকা ফীমা কা-নূ ফীহি ইয়াখতালিফ নাহদিনী লিমাখ তুলিফা ফীহি মিনাক হাক্কি বি ইযনিকা ইন্নাকা তাহদী মান তাশা-উ ইলা সিরা-ত্বিম মুসতাকীম” (অর্থাৎ- হে আল্লাহ! জিবরীল, মিকাঈল ও ইসরাফীলের প্রতিপালক, আসমান ও জমিনের স্রষ্টা, প্রকাশ্য ও গোপন বিষয়সমূহের জ্ঞানের অধিকারী। তোমার বান্দারা যেসব বিষয়ে মতানৈক্য পোষণ করে তুমিই সেগুলোর ফায়সালা করবে। সত্য ও ন্যায়ের যেসব বিষয়ে মতানৈক্য পোষণ করা হয়েছে সে বিষয়ে তুমি আমাকে পথ দেখাও। তুমিই তো যাকে ইচ্ছা সরল-সহজ পথ দেখিয়ে থাকো।)। (ইসলামী ফাউন্ডেশন ১৬৮১, ইসলামীক সেন্টার ১৬৮৮)

t: Sunan Nasaee’ 143: Acts that (1) Erase Sins, (2) Raise Status, (3) give control over Evil of Nafs, and (4) protect from shaitan.

x: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|: :|: My Deen Study :|: :|: Mapping My Journey :|: :|: Easy Deeds of Higher Rewards :|: গ্রন্থঃ সূনান নাসাঈ (ইফাঃ) অধ্যায়ঃ ১/ পবিত্রতা (كتاب الطهارة) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ১৪৩ ১৪৩ কুতায়বা (রহঃ) … আবূ হুরায়রা (রাঃ) থেকে বর্ণিত। রাসুলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেছেনঃ “আমি কি তোমাদের এমন বস্তুর সন্ধান দিবনা, যা দ্বারা আল্লাহ তা’য়ালা গুনাহসমূহ দূর করে দিবেন। এবং মর্যাদা বৃদ্ধি করে দিবেন? তা হল, (১) কষ্ট অবস্থায়ও পূর্ণরূপে উধু (ওজু/অজু/অযু) করা, (২) মসজিদের দিকে অধিক পদচালনা করা, (৩) আর এক সালাত এর পর অন্য সালাত এর অপেক্ষায় থাকা। এটাই রিবাত, এটাই রিবাত, এটাই রিবাত।* *রিবাতের মূল অর্থ হচ্ছে শত্রুকে প্রতিরোধ করয়ার জন্য সীমান্তে সর্বদা প্রহরারত অবস্থায় থাকা। আর মন ও শয়তানের শত্রুতা ও কুমন্ত্রণা সম্পর্কে সর্বদা সজাগ থাকাকেও রিবাত বলা হয়। অর্থাৎ ইসলামী রাষ্ট্রের সীমানা পাহারা দেয়ার ন্যায় সওয়াব এতে রয়েছে। (তিরমিযী হাঃ ৫১, মুসলিম (ইসলামিক সেন্টার) হাঃ ৪৯৪। * It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that Rasulullah Sallallahu A’laihi Wa Sallam said: “Shall I not tell you of that by means of which Allah erases sins and raises (people) in status? Doing Wudu’ properly even when it is inconvenient, Taking a lot of steps to the Masjid, And waiting for one Salah after another. That is the Ribat for you, that is the Ribat for you, that is the Ribat* for you.” (Sunan Nasaee’ 143, Saheeh) *Ribat has three meanings, Guarding the border of Islamic authority against the enemies. It also means guarding the Nafs from it’s evil And guarding oneself from shaitan. أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِمَا يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِهِ الْخَطَايَا وَيَرْفَعُ بِهِ الدَّرَجَاتِ إِسْبَاغُ الْوُضُوءِ عَلَى الْمَكَارِهِ وَكَثْرَةُ الْخُطَا إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ وَانْتِظَارُ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ فَذَلِكُمُ الرِّبَاطُ فَذَلِكُمُ الرِّبَاطُ فَذَلِكُمُ الرِّبَاطُ ‏”‏ ‏

e: Why do you must learn Deen?Why do you must contemplate on Quran and Hadith yourself? بَاب التَّأْمِينِ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَاهُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُ
x: Why do you must learn Deen? Why do you must contemplate on Quran and Hadith yourself? بَاب التَّأْمِينِ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَاهُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ إِذَا أَمَّنَ الْقَارِئُ فَأَمِّنُوا، فَإِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ تُؤَمِّنُ، فَمَنْ وَافَقَ تَأْمِينُهُ تَأْمِينَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏”‏‏.‏ Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet Sallallahu A’lahi Wa Sallam said, “When the QARI (IMAM) says ‘Amin’, then you should all say ‘Amin’, for the angels say ‘Amin’ at that time, and he whose ‘Amin’ coincides with the ‘Amin’ of the angels, all his past sins will be forgiven.” (Saheeh Bukhari 6402) গ্রন্থঃ সহীহ বুখারী (তাওহীদ) অধ্যায়ঃ ৮০/ দু‘আসমূহ (كتاب الدعوات) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ৬৪০২ ৬৪০২. ‘আলী ইবনু ‘আবদুল্লাহ (রহ.) আবূ হরাইরাহ (রাঃ) হতে বর্ণিত। নাবী সাল্লাল্লাহু আ’লাইহি ওয়া সাল্লাম বলেছেন, যখন ক্বারী ‘আমীন’ বলবে তখন তোমরাও আমীন বলবে। কারণ এ সময় ফেরেশতা আমীন বলে থাকেন। সুতরাং যার আমীন বলা ফেরেশতার আমীন বলার সঙ্গে মিলে যাবে, তার পূর্বের সব গুনাহক্ষমা করে দেয়া হবে। See, why you must read Quran and Hadith yourself and then contemplate over it. Why do you MUST reconcile your Deen with the Quran and Saheeh Hadith at all point of time, with anything and everything. See, how you’re missing the reward of being forgiven in each Salah, it’s nothing but Jahiliyyah! It’s is nothing but only reliance on the spoon-feeding by the Ulama. What a gross body of Jaheel these Ummah became only because their Deen was based only what they learn from their respective Ulama. It was alright until 50 years back when the regular Muslims did not have access to the resources therefore, they had to rely only on the Ulama. But today? What would be the excuse when all resources became handy? May Allah give us understanding. Ameen.

They said: “Shall we not bring water for Wudu’?” He said: “I have only been commanded to perform Wudu’ when I want to pray.” (Sunan Nasaee’ 132, Saheeh) أَخْبَرَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنَ الْخَلاَءِ فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ فَقَالُوا أَلاَ نَأْتِيكَ بِوَضُوءٍ فَقَالَ ‏ “‏ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ بِالْوُضُوءِ إِذَا قُمْتُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ ‏”‏ ‏.‏

e: “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers.” Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?
x: 31:21 31:21 And when it is said to them, “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers.” “E ven if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze”? وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوا مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ Sahih International And when it is said to them, “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers.” Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze? Bangla তাদেরকে যখন বলা হয়, আল্লাহ যা নাযিল করেছেন, তোমরা তার অনুসরণ কর, তখন তারা বলে, বরং আমরা আমাদের পূর্বপুরুষদেরকে যে বিষয়ের উপর পেয়েছি, তারই অনুসরণ করব। শয়তান যদি তাদেরকে জাহান্নামের শাস্তির দিকে দাওয়াত দেয়, তবুও কি?

t: Quran 95:4. Animals can see and hear what is unseen and un-hearable to human beings! Subhanallah! Yet, humans are the best of all creations!
e: :|: Building Muslim-Mindset :|::|: Quran Study – One Ayah a Day :|::|: Quran for Critical Reasoning :|::|: Critical Reasoning – Why? :|::|: Imagine the UNSEEN :|::|: Dignity Being Human :|: “لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ
x: :|: Building Muslim-Mindset :|: :|: Quran Study – One Ayah a Day :|: :|: Quran for Critical Reasoning :|: :|: Critical Reasoning – Why? :|: :|: Imagine the UNSEEN :|: :|: Dignity Being Human :|: “لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ” “We have certainly created man in the best of stature.” (Al-Quran, Sura At-Teen 95:4) (1) Animals can hear what is un-hearable to human beings. Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said about the situation after one is placed in the Qabr, “One who is blind and dumb will then be placed in charge of him (who deserves punishment), having a sledge-hammer such that if a mountain were struck with it, it would become dust. He will give him a blow with it which will be heard by everything between the east and the west except by men and Jinn, and he will become dust. Then his spirit will be restored to him.” (Sunan Abu Dawud 4753 (Saheeh) Subhanallah! Animals can see what is unseen to human beings. In another Hadith, Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “When you listen to the crowing of the cock, ask Allah for His favour as it sees Angels and when you listen to the braying of the donkey, seek refuge in Allah from the Satan for it sees Satan .” (Saheeh Muslim 6813/ 82-2729) Subhanallah! Look at the power and capability of the animals! They can see what humans can’t, They can hear what humans can’t, They can hear the unseen, which humans can’t They can see the unseen, what humans can’t. Subhanallah! Yet Allah says humans are the best of creations! Azeeb! Why? What makes humans better than animals? What makes humans the best of all creations? (2) The creation of the universe is more complicated than the creation of a human being, Allah, Al-Khaliq, the Creator says, “Which is harder to create: you or the sky?” (Sura Naziat 79:27) Yet Allah says humans are the best of creations! Azeeb! Why? What makes humans better than the universe? What makes humans the best of all creations? (3) The answer is given here by none other than the creator of human beings, Allah, Al-Khaliq, Al-Hakeem. “Indeed, the worst of all beings in the sight of Allah are the (wilfully) deaf and dumb, who do not use AQL. (Sura Anfal 8:22) If you do the Critical Reasoning of this Ayah, you can derive the answer. Who is Allah talking about here? Human beings? Who are the worst human beings? “Those who do not use their AQL” Meaning, human beings are supposed to use their AQL; this is how they are created, with AQL. An animal was not given AQL. The universe was not given AQL. It is the human beings who are given AQL. Therefore, we can derive the understanding that using the AQL is what makes the distinction among the animals, the universe and the human beings. On the contrary, NOT USING that AQL makes a human worse than the animals. And the worst than that is that they are for FIRE. Allah says, “And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless.” (Sura Al-A’raf 7:179) Thus, not only having but also USING the AQL (all the faculties) makes humans better than the animals and the universe. Wa Allahu A’lam. May Allah make us among those who contemplate the Quran. May Allah increase us in beneficial knowledge. May Allah make us to live by the Dignity Being Human. Ameen.

x: Al-Baqarah 2:22 الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ Sahih International [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him]. বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন যিনি তোমাদের জন্য যমীনকে করেছেন বিছানা, আসমানকে ছাদ এবং আসমান থেকে নাযিল করেছেন বৃষ্টি। অতঃপর তাঁর মাধ্যমে উৎপন্ন করেছেন ফল-ফলাদি, তোমাদের জন্য রিয্কস্বরূপ। সুতরাং তোমরা জেনে-বুঝে আল্লাহর জন্য সমকক্ষ নির্ধারণ করো না। ———— Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! My Comments and Understanding: Allah PROHIBITS mankind (2:21) not to set EQUALS with him. That’s easy to understand from the translation, right? But to really realize the meaning you just have to reflect when and how Allah said it. Read the Ayah again. When did Allah prohibit not to set equal? While he was describing his ACTS, his FAVOURS. Did you notice that? Therefore when you give credit for those things to others you are setting equal with Allah. And you know what does that mean, nothing but a clear SHIRK. Allah mentions here the blessings of earth as a whole (earth a bed) and then 7 layers of atmosphere (the sky a ceiling), weather (rain) and fruits and vegetables (brought forth thereby fruits as provision). Let’s just discuss one blessing, rain so that we can understand the others too. What usually people say and the Muslims alike when they discuss about weather? They talk about how global climate has changed, how the season has changed all over the world etc. and all they attribute it to just one reason ‘ global warming’, as if Allah has nothing to do with it. But Muslim should know it is Allah who sends winds, clouds, rain etc. Yes, truly, men’s hand brought disaster for themselves. But Muslim should not forget that things happen with Allah’s permission. And for sure, Allah deserves the credit for the nature. Therefore, giving credit to something else constitute Shirk. And Allah knows best. May Allah protect us from the built-in Shirk we are put in this modern times. Ameen.

(Slaves from War) But today’s Ulema mentions it with an apologetic notion. That’s how much Muslims minds were shaped by the systems of the Kuffar’s, by the philosophies and ways of life of the Kuffar’s. Who made it, how did that happen? Ulema those who preaching voting and “no Khilafah is needed” Ulema those who preaching ‘No Khalifah no Jihad” Ulema those who made Riba Halal by the name of ‘Islamic’ which finally has a link with Riba. Point 2: Correcting Kuffar’s Mindset: “Hate the Criminal not the crime”. The believers have to do Jihad by their HANDS فَمَنْ جَاهَدَهُمْ بِيَدِهِ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ) against those who do it (the change of Deen). Does this Hadith give you a tool to understand the Eeman of a Muslim? Yes, it does. How can you understand their level of faith? It’s Simple Math! When you see someone in authority who prevent or doesn’t allow occurring a change of Deen (not limited to Bida’a as usually we end up only limiting CHANGE OF DEEN to Bida’a in rituals, in fact this change of Deen happened in every aspect of Deen which is not only turned to Bida’a but to SHIRK and KUFR, which In Shaa Allah will discuss in its place), would you not understand his level of Eeman? The Sunnah of believers was always same (this Hadith). So, what is the Sunnah of the believers that Rasulullah sallillahu alaihi wa sallam warned here? That after the followers (Sahaba), there will be successors, What are the characteristics mentioned of the believers (the successors)? That they will say what they will not practice, يَقُولُونَ مَا لاَ يَفْعَلُونَ That they will practice what was not practiced (commanded) before (Bida’a) وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا لاَ يُؤْمَرُونَ Now, was the people before a different species than the people who followed Rasulullah? They are the same species. What does that suggest? How long it took for the followers of Eisa A”laihi Wa Sallam after him to change what Eisa A’laihi Wa Sallam taught? Not even 100 years. Therefore, as per Sunnah of the believers what is supposed to happen? How come you think the practice of Islam has remained the same as it was at the time of Rasulullah Sallillahu A’lahi Wa Sallam or at the time of Sahaba? Rather the Hadith of Hudaifah (his questions) (Sahih al-Bukhari 3606) also provide an added evidence to that, change of people and change of those people who will call from the gate of Jahannam. I don’t mean here that the books have been changed. I mean the understanding of the books and practice of people must have changed. Look at the Salah. I never thought that Salah remains the same after reading the books of Salah. Evidence? Rasulullah Sallillahu A’laihi Wa Sallam used to pause after every Ayah and when He recited an Ayah about Jahannam, He paused and asked refuge with Allah from it and when He recited an Ayah about Jannah, He paused and asked Allah to grant him Jannah. But In my life, I didn’t see any imam around the world doing it. And then the change of Allah’s system , Slavery is made Haram what Allah and Rasul made Halal and Sahaba practised it. (Slaves from War) But today’s Ulema mentions it with an apologetic notion. That’s how much Muslims minds were shaped by the systems of the Kuffar’s, by the philosophies and ways of life of the Kuffar’s. Who made it, how did that happen? Ulema those who preaching voting and “no Khilafah is needed” Ulema those who preaching ‘No Khalifah no Jihad” Ulema those who made Riba Halal by the name of ‘Islamic’ which finally has a link with Riba. The conclusion: The PRACTICE of Deen has CHANGED long back ! May Allah guide Muslims! Ameen. AND ALLAH KNOWS BEST ================================================================ Part 2: Point 1: The practice of Deen of Allah has changed So, we know from this Hadith that The DEEN of Allah must have changed by the successors of His companions. You might not see the change in your own eyes because the change is not rapid, it took generations to change to occur thus it doesn’t appear in one’s lifetime to experience the change himself but this Hadith says that the change will occur and brought in by the followers of the Sahaba, therefore, it must have happened long before, no doubt about that, if you believe this hadith is a truth. Point 2: Correcting Kuffar’s Mindset: “Hate the Criminal not the crime”. The believers have to do Jihad by their HANDS فَمَنْ جَاهَدَ هُمْ بِيَدِهِ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ) against those who do it (the change of Deen). And the lowest act of Jihad is disliking, hatred in the HEART against THEM (not against IT ) (We Muslim hate the criminal and the crime both, NOT “Hate the Crime, not the Criminal” , which is a Kuffar’s philosophy) Point 3: Correcting Kuffar’s Mindset: “You can’t Judge”. Does this Hadith give you a tool to understand the Eeman of a Muslim? Yes, it does. How can you understand their level of faith? It’s Simple Math! When you see someone in authority who prevent or doesn’t allow occurring a change of Deen (not limited to Bida’a as usually we end up only limiting CHANGE OF DEEN to Bida’a in rituals, in fact this change of Deen happened in every aspect of Deen which is not only turned to Bida’a but to SHIRK and KUFR, which In Shaa Allah will discuss in its place), would you not understand his level of Eeman? Then someone who voices against it, talks about it, write about it, discuss about it, take attempts in whatever way is possible, you can understand his level of Eeman, don’t you? But what about someone’s heart? How would you measure what’s in someone’s heart? Well, people reflect their heart in their words of mouth, in their facial expressions, through their glances, through their body languages. Don’t you understand the eye of a person who hates you by the look he gives to you? Don’t you understand the facial expression of your parent/teacher/supervisor/boss when he is not happy with you? Point 4: Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil: See that’s how it is so important in Islam to enjoin good and forbid evil, knowing the falsehood and hating it hard! It is simply standing for the TRUTH and HATING the falsehood. This is one of the basic Mindset of being a Muslim. You have to have strong adherence to the RIGHT and bitter HATRED for the wrong. Therefore, to understand the CHANGE of DEEN a believer MUST KNOW the Deen first, right? Absolutely, no doubt about that. But did we not miss something here? Not only knowing the Deen but have to know the CORRECT Deen! What are the CONSEQUENCES for not being able to do the LOWEST JIHAD? (which is by Jihad by heart) “He has NO FAITH to the extent of a mustard seed.” Then let’s do the simple math: No knowledge of correct Deen = Not able to FORBID evil = NO FAITH (not even to the extent of a mustard seed) What does this suggest? If you do NOT STUDY deen, you have NO FAITH. It’s Simple Math. AND ALLAH KNOWS BEST ================================================================ Part 2: Point 1: The practice of Deen of Allah has changed So, we know from this Hadith that The DEEN of Allah must have changed by the successors of His companions. You might not see the change in your own eyes because the change is not rapid, it took generations to change to occur thus it doesn’t appear in one’s lifetime to experience the change himself but this Hadith says that the change will occur and brought in by the followers of the Sahaba, therefore, it must have happened long before, no doubt about that, if you believe this hadith is a truth. Point 2: Correcting Kuffar’s Mindset: “Hate the Criminal not the crime”. The believers have to do Jihad by their HANDS فَمَنْ جَاهَدَ هُمْ بِيَدِهِ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ) against those who do it (the change of Deen). And the lowest act of Jihad is disliking, hatred in the HEART against THEM جَاهَدَهُمْ (not against IT ) (We Muslim hate the criminal and the crime both, NOT “Hate the Crime, not the Criminal” , which is a Kuffar’s philosophy) Point 3: Correcting Kuffar’s Mindset: “You can’t Judge”. Does this Hadith give you a tool to understand the Eeman of a Muslim? Yes, it does. How can you understand their level of faith? It’s Simple Math! When you see someone in authority who prevent or doesn’t allow occurring a change of Deen (not limited to Bida’a as usually we end up only limiting CHANGE OF DEEN to Bida’a in rituals, in fact this change of Deen happened in every aspect of Deen which is not only turned to Bida’a but to SHIRK and KUFR, which In Shaa Allah will discuss in its place), would you not understand his level of Eeman? Then someone who voices against it, talks about it, write about it, discuss about it, take attempts in whatever way is possible, you can understand his level of Eeman, don’t you? But what about someone’s heart? How would you measure what’s in someone’s heart? Well, people reflect their heart in their words of mouth, in their facial expressions, through their glances, through their body languages. Don’t you understand the eye of a person who hates you by the look he gives to you? Don’t you understand the facial expression of your parent/teacher/supervisor/boss when he is not happy with you? Point 4: Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil: See that’s how it is so important in Islam to enjoin good and forbid evil, knowing the falsehood and hating it hard! It is simply standing for the TRUTH and HATING the falsehood. This is one of the basic Mindset of being a Muslim. You have to have strong adherence to the RIGHT and bitter HATRED for the wrong. Point 5: No Knowledge of DeeN means NO FAITH To understand the CHANGE of something, is it logical that someone MUST KNOW the CORRECT thing in the first place? Yes, I think so. That seems obvious! Therefore, to understand the CHANGE of DEEN a believer MUST KNOW the Deen first, right? Absolutely, no doubt about that. But did we not miss something here? Not only knowing the Deen but have to know the CORRECT Deen! What are the CONSEQUENCES for not being able to do the LOWEST JIHAD? (which is by Jihad by heart) “He has NO FAITH to the extent of a mustard seed.” Then let’s do the simple math: No knowledge of correct Deen = Not able to FORBID evil = NO FAITH (not even to the extent of a mustard seed) What does this suggest? If you do NOT STUDY deen, you have NO FAITH. It’s Simple Math. Ya Rabb, give me knowledge, wisdom and strength to stand by the truth and fight against the falsehood. Ameen. The detail of the Hadith: It is narrated on the authority ‘Abdullah b. Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: Never a Prophet had been sent before me by Allah towards his nation who had not among his people (his) disciples and companions who followed his ways and obeyed his command. Then there came after them their successors who said whatever they did not practise and practised whatever they were not commanded to do. He who strove (JIHAD) against them with his hand was a believer: he who strove against them with his tongue was a believer, and he who strove against them with his heart was a believer and beyond that, there is no faith even to the extent of a mustard seed. Mas’ud who stayed at Qanat, and ‘Abdullah b ‘Umar wanted me to accompany him for visiting him (as ‘Abdullah b. Mas’ud was ailing), so I went along with him and as we sat (before him) I asked Ibn Mas’ud about this hadith. x: :|: Islam – the Supreme Way of Life :|: :|: Consequence of FOLLOWING Kuffar’s Deen :|: وَلَن تَرْضَىٰ عَنكَ الْيَهُودُ وَلَا النَّصَارَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى اللَّهِ هُوَ الْهُدَىٰ ۗ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُم بَعْدَ الَّذِي جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ ۙ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ And never will the Jews or the Christians approve of you until you follow their MILLAT (‘Way of LIfe’/LifeStyle). Say, “Indeed, the guidance of Allah is the [only] guidance.” If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allah no protector or helper. Bangla ইহুদী ও খ্রীষ্টানরা কখনই আপনার প্রতি সন্তুষ্ট হবে না, যে পর্যন্ত না আপনি তাদের জীবন ব্যাবস্থার অনুসরণ করেন। বলে দিন, যে পথ আল্লাহ প্রদর্শন করেন, তাই হল সরল পথ। যদি আপনি তাদের আকাঙ্খাসমূহের অনুসরণ করেন, ঐ জ্ঞান লাভের পর, যা আপনার কাছে পৌঁছেছে, তবে কেউ আল্লাহর কবল থেকে আপনার উদ্ধারকারী ও সাহায্যকারী নেই। Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! En Shaa Allah, we will do Critical Reasoning of the part of this Ayah. 2. ‘ Say, Allah’s GUIDANCE is the ONLY Guidance.’ What’s the guidance for? Guidance is for Ebadah, Guidance is for the systems of life/’ways of life’ 3. ‘ But if you are to follow their ways (Hawa) after this guidance (this way of life) .’ Here Allah mentions it as their ‘HAWA’, meaning desire. Which means, their ways of life is designed from their desires (Hawa), whatever their heart desires, whatever they think is ‘best’, because they left the ways of their creator long back. So, Allah Subhanahu clearly warned you that if you follow their ways, 4. ‘ Then you won’t find anybody to help you against Allah.’ What does this mean? Following Kuffar’s Deen means you are destroyed, you made Allah angry. There will be no help for you in the Qabr, nor in the Qiyamah! Wa Allahu A’lam. May Allah protect us from following Kuffar’s Deen. May Allah help us, save us from the punishment in Qabr and on the Qiyamah! Ameen.

t: Quran 22:52. Why do you need to take shaitan seriously? shaitan has always MANIPULATED (some falsehood) in what PROPHETS RECITED (Wahee/ Revelation)
e: Aujubillahi Min as-shaitaneer Razeem 22:52 وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰ أَلْقَى الشَّيْطَانُ فِي أُمْنِيَّتِهِ فَيَنسَخُ اللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ
x: Aujubillahi Min as-shaitaneer Razeem 22:52 وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰ أَلْقَى الشَّيْطَانُ فِي أُمْنِيَّتِهِ فَيَنسَخُ اللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ Sahih International And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding] . But Allah abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allah makes precise His verses. And Allah is Knowing and Wise. Muhsin Khan Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you, but; when he did recite the revelation or narrated or spoke, Shaitan (Satan) threw (some falsehood) in it. But Allah abolishes that which Shaitan (Satan) throws in. Then Allah establishes His Revelations. And Allah is All-Knower, All-Wise: Bangla আমি আপনার পূর্বে যে সমস্ত রাসূল ও নবী প্রেরণ করেছি, তারা যখনই কিছু কল্পনা করেছে, তখনই শয়তান তাদের কল্পনায় কিছু মিশ্রণ করে দিয়েছে। অতঃপর আল্লাহ দূর করে দেন শয়তান যা মিশ্রণ করে। এরপর আল্লাহ তাঁর আয়াতসমূহকে সু-প্রতিষ্ঠিত করেন এবং আল্লাহ জ্ঞানময়, প্রজ্ঞাময়। My Critical Reasoning: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! What type of Ayah is this? Information Regarding what? the power of shaitan (that Allah allowed him) and vulnerability of Allah’s messengers tackling shaitan Why Allah inform us this? Anything and everything in the Quran should benefit us. How this Ayah could benefit us? My understanding and Comments: Know the POWER of shaitan and then know your Ulema that you follow blindly. If shaitan could through his falsehood in the words of messengers then what about your Ulema! Allah has corrected His Wahee to His messengers straight away, but what about your Ulema? The scariest and most eye-opening Ayah for me! This Ayah is enough to get every Muslim on their toes! How you then rest your Jannah by blindly following your Ulema even who gives evidence from Quran and Hadith? Isn’t every Ulema of every sect following the same Quran and many times the same Hadith? And then aren’t every Ulema study their Deen for 10/20/30/40 years? Then, where would you go? How do you know, even they teach you of 99 things correct but just one thing could lead you to Jahannam as a slightest element of Shirk is enough for Jahannam and isn’t that the case today! How many Ulema today calling Muslims for voting? How many Ulema today living ‘happily ever after’ submitting to the Kuffar’s Law willingly when they are the one should warn Muslims for moving away from this SHIRK and KUFR? So, what’s your way out? Read and contemplate and ask guidance and plead to Allah, the Most Merciful to have Rahma on you! shaitan is there to take sons of Adam to Jahannam, don’t forget it! But you need to show Allah, the Most Just, that you tried hard! Don’t think you continue your wasting of time and thinking “Allah is forgiving!” Minimum thing is, know about SHIRK and KUFR that you’re living as a built-in system today! And Allah knows best. So you better stay away from wasting time and getting busy in making money for this and that! You better get rid of the mindset that “Scholars study whole life so they must be correct” or “If a scholar can make mistake what is my chance?” or “I study Deen, I am listening to the scholars always” No, my brother, You need to have a study method, an organized method! A study from facebook and youtube won’t be able to save you! You need to study from original books (The Quran and the Hadiths) contentiously to understand the right from the wrong! And then think and only after that you can listen to lectures. But on top of that, you need to continuously be aware of your situation that how vulnerable you are against shaitan and make pleading to Allah, the Most Merciful to have Rahma on you! But show Allah, the all Watching, that you are constantly tried hard for His cause! And Allah knows best. May Allah, the Most Merciful, save us from shaitan and save us from Jahannam! Ameen.

t: Adab al-Murfad 18. Don’t engage in SHIRK even if you’re CUT into pieces or BURNT alive.
e: গ্রন্থঃ আল-আদাবুল মুফরাদঅধ্যায়ঃ পিতা-মাতার সাথে সদ্ধ্যবহারহাদিস নম্বরঃ ১৮ ১৮। আবু দারদা (রাঃ) বলেন, রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম আমাকে নয়টি ব্যাপারে ওসিয়াত করেছেনঃ (১) আল্লাহর সাথে কিছু শরীক করো না, যদি
x: Abu’d-Darda’ Radiallahu ‘Anhu said, “The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, recommended nine things to me: ‘Do not associate anything with Allah, even if you are cut to pieces or burned. Do not abandon a prescribed prayer deliberately. Anyone who abandons it will forfeit Allah’s protection. Do not drink wine – it is the key to every evil. Obey your parents. If they command you to abandon your worldly possessions, then leave them for them. Do not contend with those in power, even if you think that you are in the right. Do not run away from the army when it advances, even if you are killed while your companions run away. Spend on your family out of your means. Do not raise a stick against your family. Cause your family to fear Allah, the Almighty and Exalted.'” (Adab Al-Murfad 18, Hasan) গ্রন্থঃ আল-আদাবুল মুফরাদ অধ্যায়ঃ পিতা-মাতার সাথে সদ্ধ্যবহার হাদিস নম্বরঃ ১৮ ১৮। আবু দারদা (রাঃ) বলেন, রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম আমাকে নয়টি ব্যাপারে ওসিয়াত করেছেনঃ (১) আল্লাহর সাথে কিছু শরীক করো না, যদিও তোমাকে হত্যা করা হয় অথবা অগ্নিদগ্ধ করা হয়। (২) ইচ্ছাকৃতভাবে ফরয নামায ত্যাগ করো না, যে ব্যক্তি স্বেচ্ছায় ফরয নামায ত্যাগ করবে তার সম্পর্কে আমার কোন দায়িত্ব নাই। (৩) মদ্যপান করো না, কেননা তা সকল অনাচারের চাবি। (৪) তোমার পিতা-মাতার আনুগত্য করবে, তারা যদি তোমাকে দুনিয়া ছাড়তেও আদেশ করেন তবে তাই করবে। (৫) শাসকদের সাথে বিবাদে জড়াবে না, যদিও দেখো যে, তুমিই তুমি। (৬) যুদ্ধক্ষেত্র থেকে পলায়ন করো না, যদিও তুমি ধ্বংস হও এবং তোমার সঙ্গীরা পলায়ন করে। (৭) তোমার সামর্থ্য অনুসারে পরিবারের জন্য ব্যয় করো। (৮) তোমার পরিবারের উপর থেকে লাঠি তুলে রাখবে না এবং (৯) তাদের মধ্যে মহামহিম আল্লাহর ভয় জাগ্রত রাখবে। بَابُ يَبَرُّ وَالِدَيْهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعْصِيَةً حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ‏:‏ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ الْبَصْرِيُّ لَقِيتُهُ بِالرَّمْلَةِ قَالَ‏:‏ حَدَّثَنِي رَاشِدٌ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ‏:‏ أَوْصَانِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتِسْعٍ‏:‏ لاَ تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا ؛ وَإِنْ قُطِّعْتَ أَوْ حُرِّقْتَ، وَلاَ تَتْرُكَنَّ الصَّلاَةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ مُتَعَمِّدًا، وَمَنْ تَرَكَهَا مُتَعَمِّدًا بَرِئَتْ مِنْهُ الذِّمَّةُ، وَلاَ تَشْرَبَنَّ الْخَمْرَ، فَإِنَّهَا مِفْتَاحُ كُلِّ شَرٍّ، وَأَطِعْ وَالِدَيْكَ، وَإِنْ أَمَرَاكَ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ مِنْ دُنْيَاكَ فَاخْرُجْ لَهُمَا، وَلاَ تُنَازِعَنَّ وُلاَةَ الأَمْرِ وَإِنْ رَأَيْتَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ، وَلاَ تَفْرُرْ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ، وَإِنْ هَلَكْتَ وَفَرَّ أَصْحَابُكَ، وَأَنْفِقْ مِنْ طَوْلِكَ عَلَى أَهْلِكَ، وَلاَ تَرْفَعْ عَصَاكَ عَنْ أَهْلِكَ، وَأَخِفْهُمْ فِي اللهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ‏.‏ Link: https://www.hadithbd.com/hadith/link/?id=45333

t: Quran 7:180. Learning Names and Attributes of Allah: 1st Stage; IMPRINTING the understanding in your heart – The EASY Way
e: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَٱدْعُوهُ بِهَا ۖ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ أَسْمَـٰٓئِهِۦ ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ١٨٠ “Allah has the Most Beautiful Names. So call upon Him by them, and ke
x: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَٱدْعُوهُ بِهَا ۖ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ أَسْمَـٰٓئِهِۦ ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ١٨٠ “Allah has the Most Beautiful Names. So call upon Him by them, and keep away from those who abuse His Names. They will be punished for what they used to do.” Bismillah Al Hamdulillah! How did we understand this Ayah? And how did we do the Critical Reasoning of this Ayah? What benefit did we think and derive from this Ayah? To learn these, please read from the link. May Allah make it beneficial. Ameen. This article describes a method how, in a simple way, you can always be with the names and attributes of Allah without spending any extra time. t: Mapping My Journey – A bird’s-eye view of WHERE you STAND, Where you LACK and Where you NEED to WORK on your Deen
e: Mapping My Journey – A bird’s-eye view of WHERE you STAND, Where you LACK and Where you NEED to WORK on your Deen :|: Mapping My Journey :|::|: Being Mindful is the Key :|: True wisdom lies not in acquiring a lot of know
x: Mapping My Journey – A bird’s-eye view of WHERE you STAND, Where you LACK and Where you NEED to WORK on your Deen :|: Mapping My Journey :|: :|: Being Mindful is the Key :|: True wisdom lies not in acquiring a lot of knowledge but how beneficially you use what you learn. Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! AsSalamu A’alaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barakatuhu! Did you learned something of Deen today? But if I were to ask you, Where does you FIT in which you learned today? D o you know where does it fit in the map of your journey? Do you even draw a map of your journey in the first place? Do you know exactly how significant it is to have a picture in your mind of the different stages of your journey? It surely seems important what you learned today but are you giving it the optimum importance it deserves? Are you keeping yourself busy with less priority ones leaving the most priority ones by going back to your traditions? You only know it when you put all these things together in the map of the entire journey in front of you. That’s what it is “MAPPING My JOURNEY towards Jannat Al-Firdous, En Shaa Allah, for.” GET a TOTAL PICTURE of your DEEN, KNOW where you STAND You are reading an Ayah of the Quran or reading a Hadith or listening to a lecture, you are learning something. You remain focused on whatever you learned today. Tomorrow new things add up because you are learning continuously. Therefore, what happens? You concentrate more on what you learned today and consequently, you give less concentration on the lessons of the previous days. And soon your focus on that previous ones gets faded away when you have to focus on new things every day. It happens to all of us, right? So, what do you do? How can you REMAIN focus on ALL the things and issues ALL the time? To do that you have to know how usually you remain focus on something. Simply, by acquiring full knowledge of it, by keeping attachment with it and most significantly by having a TOTAL PICTURE in our mind about it and BE ON it. And this is where this site ( MAPPING My JOURNEY ) comes! Your entire Deen, your entire PATH towards Jannah is in one page. You see it as a tree, as a whole and then you can zoom on a trunk, on a branch and then on a leaf. If you keep this practice for few days then sometime later you will look at the whole tree, you would know which trunk got what, which branch got what and you would know which leaf got what. What’s the benefit? Endless, can’t possibly describe. But the most important one could be, you can make a checklist of WHERE you STAND, where you LACK and where you NEED TO WORK on. May Allah make it beneficial. May Allah make our journey to Jannah easy. “Allahumma E’lmann Nafi’an” (O Allah give us beneficial knowledge) Ameen

x: Abu Huraira reported: Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said: “Angels take turns among you by night and by day, and they all assemble at the dawn and afternoon prayers. Those (of the angels) who spend the night among you, then, ascend, and their RABB asks them, though He is the best informed about them: “How did you leave My servants?” they say: “We left them while they were praying and we came to them while they were praying.” (Saheeh Muslim 1318-(210/ 632) باب فَضْلِ صَلاَتَىِ الصُّبْحِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَالْمُحَافَظَةِ عَلَيْهِمَا ‏ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ يَتَعَاقَبُونَ فِيكُمْ مَلاَئِكَةٌ بِاللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةٌ بِالنَّهَارِ وَيَجْتَمِعُونَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ الَّذِينَ بَاتُوا فِيكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ كَيْفَ تَرَكْتُمْ عِبَادِي فَيَقُولُونَ تَرَكْنَاهُمْ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ وَأَتَيْنَاهُمْ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ গ্রন্থঃ সহীহ মুসলিম (হাঃ একাডেমী) অধ্যায়ঃ ৫। মাসজিদ ও সলাতের স্থানসমূহ (كتاب المساجد ومواضعِ الصلاة) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ১৩১৮ ১৩১৮-(২১০/৬৩২) ইয়াহইয়া ইবনু ইয়াহইয়া (রহঃ) ….. আবূ হুরায়রাহ (রাযিঃ) থেকে বর্ণিত। রসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেছেনঃ “রাতের বেলা ও দিনের বেলা মালায়িকাহ (ফেরেশতাগণ) এক দলের পর আর একদল তোমাদের কাছে এসে থাকে এবং তাদের উভয় দল ফাজর ও আসর সলাতের সময় একত্রিত হয়। অতঃপর যারা তোমাদের সাথে রাত্রি যাপন করেছে তারা উঠে যায়।” তখন তাদের প্রভু মহান আল্লাহ তাদেরকে জিজ্ঞেস করেন, “তোমরা আমার বান্দাদেরকে কিরূপ অবস্থায় রেখে আসলে?” যদিও তিনি তাদের সম্পর্কে সম্যক অবগত।” মালায়িকাহ তখন বলেন, “আমরা যখন তাদেরকে ছেড়ে চলে আসলাম তখন তারা সলাত আদায় করছিল। আবার তাদের কাছে আমরা যখন গিয়েছিলাম তখনও তারা সলাত আদায় করছিল।” (ইসলামী ফাউন্ডেশন ১৩০৫, ইসলামীক সেন্টার ১৩১৭)

e: Al-Kahf 18:107 إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا Indeed, those who believe and do good will have the Gardens of Paradise[[ Al-Firdaws, the highest place in
x: Al-Kahf 18:107 إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا Indeed, those who believe and do good will have the Gardens of Paradise[[ Al-Firdaws, the highest place in Paradise. ]] as an accommodation, যারা বিশ্বাস স্থাপন করে ও সৎকর্ম সম্পাদন করে, তাদের অভ্যর্থনার জন্যে আছে জান্নাতুল ফেরদাউস। Subhanallah! Seems achieving Jannatul Firdous is so easy. Then, what do the ‘Sawlihat’ deeds consist of? It’s simply to obey the command of Allah and refrain from prohibitions. It’s simply to avoid those acts which cause punishments. It’s simply to remain steadfast on Deen And it’s simply to reject Shirk, Kufr, and Bida’a. Therefore, ‘Sawlihat’ deeds actually mean the obedience of the Sharia’a of Islam. And Allah knows best.

t: Quran 17:36. You will be questioned about how did you use (1) your Hearing (2) your Sight and (3) the Feelings (motion) of your Heart (Fuwad)
e: Sahih International “And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart – about all those [one] will be questioned.“ Bangla যে বিষয়ে তোমার কোন জ্ঞান নেই, তার পিছনে পড়ো ন
x: Sahih International “ And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart – about all those [one] will be questioned. “ Bangla যে বিষয়ে তোমার কোন জ্ঞান নেই, তার পিছনে পড়ো না। নিশ্চয় কান, চক্ষু ও অন্তঃকরণ এদের প্রত্যেকটিই জিজ্ঞাসিত হবে। (Quran Al Isra 17:36) My Reflection: Checked few translations and Tafseer about the word ‘Fuwada’, which they translated as ‘heart’. My curiosity was what will be asked about the heart? Tafseer Ibne Katheer, ‘Fi Jalalayn’ of Sayyid Qutb, Tafseer Ibne Abbas do not say anything of heart matters. Subhanallah! Usually I do not look at other Tafseer. But this issue make me to. So, Mareful Quran says few things. What I understood from his explanation is that basically it is about the feelings of the heart. Meaning, envy (Hasad, jealousy) of the heart, Anger of the heart, Hatred of the heart, Pride of the heart, etc all the negative feelings of the heart. May Allah save us from the evil feelings of our heart! Subhanallah! So we got ‘Qalb’, which also translated as ‘heart’ and we seek refuge with Allah from the evil of our Qalb. Then we got ‘Nafs’, which usually translated as ‘desire’ and we seek refuge with Allah for the evil of our Nafs. And then, we now get the ‘Fuwad’ as well and we seek refuge with Allah for the evil of our Fuad Dictionary: William Lane’s Lexicon Dictionary: Hen Wehr

t: Tirmidhi 2165: Stick with the first 3 generations, Be with the Jama’a, beware of the TIME you live in.
