x: Ibn ‘Umar narrated: ” ‘Umar delivered a Khutbah to us at Al-Jabiyah. He said: ‘O you people! Indeed, I have stood among you as the Messenger of Allah(s.a.w) stood among us, and he, Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said: “I order you (to stick to) my Companions, then those who come after them, then those who come after them. Then lying will spread until a man will take an oath when no oath was sought from him, and a witness will testify when his testimony was not sought. Behold! A man is not alone with a woman but the third of them is Ash-Shaitan. Adhere to the Jama’ah, beware of separation, for indeed Ash-Shaitan is with one, and he is further away from two. Whoever wants the best place in Paradise, then let him stick to the Jama’ah. Whoever rejoices with his good deeds and grieves over his evil deeds, then that is the believer among you.'” (Sunan At-Tirmidhi. Book of Fitan, Hadith 2165) গ্রন্থঃ সূনান আত তিরমিজী [তাহকীককৃত]অধ্যায়ঃ ৩১/ কলহ ও বিপর্যয় (كتاب الفتن عن رسول الله ﷺ)হাদিস নম্বরঃ ২১৬৫ ৭. সংঘবদ্ধ হয়ে থাকার প্রয়োজনীয়তা ২১৬৫৷ ইবনু উমার (রাঃ) হতে বর্ণিত আছে, তিনি বলেন, ‘জাবিয়া’ (সিরিয়ার অন্তর্গত) নামক জায়গায় উমর (রাঃ) আমাদের সামনে খুতবাহ দেয়ার উদ্দেশ্যে দাড়িয়ে বলেনঃ হে উপস্থিত জনতা! যেভাবে আমাদের মাঝে রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম দাড়াতেন, সেভাবে তোমাদের মাঝে আমিও দাড়িয়েছি। তারপর তিনি (রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম) বলেনঃ আমার সাহাবীদের ব্যাপারে আমি তোমাদেরকে উপদেশ দিচ্ছি (তাদের যমানা শ্রেষ্ঠ যমানা), তারপর তাদের পরবর্তীদের যমানা, তারপর তাদের পরবর্তীদের যমানা, তারপর মিথ্যাচারের বিস্তার ঘটবে। এমনকি কাউকে শপথ করতে না বলা হলেও সে শপথ করবে, আর সাক্ষ্য প্রদান করতে না বলা হলেও সাক্ষ্য প্রদান করবে। সাবধান! কোন পুরুষ কোন মহিলার সাথে নির্জনে মিলিত হলে সেখানে অবশ্যই তৃতীয়জন হিসাবে শাইতান অবস্থান করে (এবং পাপাচারে প্ররোচনা দেয়)। তোমরা ঐক্যবদ্ধ হয়ে বসবাস কর। বিচ্ছিন্নতা হতে সাবধান থেকো। কেননা, শাইতান বিচ্ছিন্নজনের সাথে থাকে এবং সে দুজন হতে অনেক দূরে অবস্থান করে। যে লোক জান্নাতের মধ্যে সবচাইতে উত্তম জায়গার ইচ্ছা পোষণ করে সে যেন ঐক্যবদ্ধ হয়ে থাকে (মুসলিম সমাজে)। যার সৎ আমল তাকে আনন্দিত করে এবং বদ্ আমল কষ্ট দেয় সেই হলো প্রকৃত ঈমানদার। সহীহ, ইবনু মা-জাহ (২৩৬৩)। আবূ ঈসা বলেন, এ হাদীসটি হাসান সহীহ এবং উপরোক্ত সূত্রে গারীব। এ হাদীসটি মুহাম্মাদ ইবনু সূকার সূত্রে ইবনুল মুবারাকও বর্ণনা করেছেন। একাধিক সূত্রে উমার (রাঃ)-এর বরাতে রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম হতে এ হাদীসটি বর্ণিত আছে। باب مَا جَاءَ فِي لُزُومِ الْجَمَاعَةِ ‏‏ حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا عُمَرُ بِالْجَابِيَةِ فَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي قُمْتُ فِيكُمْ كَمَقَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِينَا فَقَالَ ‏ “‏ أُوصِيكُمْ بِأَصْحَابِي ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَفْشُو الْكَذِبُ حَتَّى يَحْلِفَ الرَّجُلُ وَلاَ يُسْتَحْلَفُ وَيَشْهَدَ الشَّاهِدُ وَلاَ يُسْتَشْهَدُ أَلاَ لاَ يَخْلُوَنَّ رَجُلٌ بِامْرَأَةٍ إِلاَّ كَانَ ثَالِثَهُمَا الشَّيْطَانُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْجَمَاعَةِ وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالْفُرْقَةَ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ مَعَ الْوَاحِدِ وَهُوَ مِنَ الاِثْنَيْنِ أَبْعَدُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بُحْبُوحَةَ الْجَنَّةِ فَلْيَلْزَمِ الْجَمَاعَةَ مَنْ سَرَّتْهُ حَسَنَتُهُ وَسَاءَتْهُ سَيِّئَتُهُ فَذَلِكَ الْمُؤْمِنُ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ وَقَدْ رَوَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ مِنْ غَيْرِ وَجْهٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ Link: http://www.hadithbd.com/share.php?hid=40860

t: Tirmidhi 1931. SubhanAllah! Just standing against Gibah/ Backbiting saves from Jahannam!
x: গ্রন্থঃ সূনান আত তিরমিজী [তাহকীককৃত] অধ্যায়ঃ ২৫/ সদ্ব্যবহার ও পারস্পরিক সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা (كتاب البر والصلة عن رسول الله ﷺ) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ১৯৩১ ২০. কোন মুসলমানের মানসম্মানের উপর আসন্ন আক্রমণ প্রতিহত করা ১৯৩১। আবূদ দারদা (রাঃ) হতে বর্ণিত আছে, নাবী সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেছেনঃ “যে লোক তার কোন ভাইয়ের মান-সম্মানের উপর আঘাত প্রতিরোধ করে, কিয়ামাত দিবসে আল্লাহ তা’আলা তার মুখমণ্ডল হতে জাহান্নমের আগুন প্রতিরোধ করবেন।” সহীহ, গাইয়াতুল মারাম (৪৩১)। আসমা বিনতু ইয়াযীদ (রাঃ) হতেও এ অনুচ্ছেদে হাদীসটি বর্ণিত আছে। আবূ ঈসা বলেনঃ এ হাদীসটি হাসান। Abu Ad-Darda narrated that the Messenger of Allah said: “Whoever protects his brother’s honor, Allah protects his face from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection. ” باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الذَّبِّ عَنْ عِرْضِ الْمُسْلِمِ حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ النَّهْشَلِيِّ، عَنْ مَرْزُوقٍ أَبِي بَكْرٍ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ مَنْ رَدَّ عَنْ عِرْضِ أَخِيهِ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ النَّارَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ ‏.‏ In Saheeh At-Targeer 3/52, 53 it is mentioned that Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “If any one protects the honor of his Muslim brother against Gibah (Slandering, abusing), in his absense then it becomes incumbent upon Allah to save him from Jahannam! ”

t: Saheeh Bukhari 3456: ‘Muslims’ Following Kuffar’s Deen’ – The HAQQ that predicted by none other than Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam
e: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|: :||: ‘Muslims’ Following Kuffar’s Deen :||: Narrated Abu Sa`id: Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “You will follow the wrong ways of your predecessors so completely and literally th
x: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|: :||: ‘Muslims’ Following Kuffar’s Deen :||: Narrated Abu Sa`id: Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “You will follow the wrong ways of your predecessors so completely and literally that if they should go into the hole of a mastigure (lizard), you too will go there.” We said, “O Rasulullah! Do you mean the Jews and the Christians?” He replied, “Whom else?” (Meaning, of course, the Jews and the Christians.) (Saheeh Bukhari 3456, 7320) بَابُ مَا ذُكِرَ عَنْ بَنِيْ إِسْرَائِيْلَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيْدُ بْنُ أَبِيْ مَرْيَمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُوْ غَسَّانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِيْ زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِيْ سَعِيْدٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَتَتَّبِعُنَّ سَنَنَ مَنْ قَبْلَكُمْ شِبْرًا بِشِبْرٍ وَذِرَاعًا بِذِرَاعٍ حَتَّى لَوْ سَلَكُوْا جُحْرَ ضَبٍّ لَسَلَكْتُمُوْهُ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ الْيَهُوْدَ وَالنَّصَارَى قَالَ فَمَنْ ৩৪৫৬. আবূ সা‘ঈদ (রাঃ) হতে বর্ণিত। তিনি বলেন, নাবী সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেছেন, “তোমরা অবশ্যই তোমাদের পূর্ববর্তীদের পন্থা পুরোপুরি অনুসরণ করবে, প্রতি বিঘতে বিঘতে এবং প্রতি গজে গজে। এমনকি তারা যদি গো সাপের গর্তেও ঢুকে তবে তোমরাও তাতে ঢুকবে।” আমরা বললাম, হে আল্লাহর রাসূল! আপনি কি ইয়াহূদী ও নাসারার কথা বলছেন? নাবী সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বললেন, তবে আর কার কথা? (সহীহ বুখারী ৩৪৫৬ এবং ৭৩২০ (তৌহিদ প্রকাশনী) (আধুনিক প্রকাশনীঃ ৩১৯৮), (ইসলামিক ফাউন্ডেশনঃ ৩২০৭)

t: Quran 2:186. Al-Baqara. Subahallah! Allah RESPONDS to the DUA of EVERY Human being!
e: 2:186 وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ “And when My servants ask you,[O Muhammad], concerning
x: 2:186 وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ “And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me – indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.” :|: Quran for Critical Reasoning :|: :|: Quran Study – ONE Ayah a Day :|: :|: Know Your Creator – Know Your Rabb :|: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’la Rasulillah! Allah Subahanah says, He respond to the call of His slaves when they call Him. (أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ) SubhanAllah! This is so amazing news for mankind. A certain message from their Creator! That He RESPONDS to them whenever they call HIM. And then, He asks them in return, فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي “You respond to me, too” As if He, Al-Mujeeb, The Responder, approaching them with an attitude like, “Hey, I responded to you when you called me, so now, you respond to my call too, please!’ as if, “Hey, I gave you that, you give me this now, please!” What a motivation! What a generosity! What a gentleness! What a kind approach! He is Al-Azeez, the Almighty, yet He first issued and informed His commitment and confirmed His covenant, and only after that He asked the other party to fulfil or do their part now! SubhaAllah! This is Al-Kareem, the most gentle, This is Al-Mannan, the bestower of bounty. So, now, what Allah, Al-Mujeeb asking for? وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي Believe in Me! SubhanAllah! This Ayah is the proof that Allah responds to His A’abd (all Human beings) because He is asking them now to believe in Him. So, who can be asked to believe? Only those who didn’t believe in Him yet, the disbelievers! Al-Kafirun! The Kuffar! So, He, Al-Mujeeb respond to the Dua of the Kuffar too! SubhanAllah! He is Al-Kareem! The Most Gentle! He is Ar-Rahman! The Most Merciful ——- And then the second issue is, لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ Meaning here is that only the believer gets the right path. If they believe, then they will be guided to the right path! And Allah knows best. May Allah make us among those who constantly make Dua. And may Allah accept our Dua. May Allah guide us to the straight path! Ameen.

t: Abu Dawud 1551: Dua to PROTECT yourself from Gibah/ Backbiting
e: “‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّي ‏”‏ “O Allah, I seek refuge in you from the evil of what I hear, from the evil of
x: “‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّي ‏”‏ “O Allah, I seek refuge in you from the evil of what I hear, from the evil of what I see, from the evil of what I speak, from the evil of what I think, and from the evil of my semen” (i.e. sexual passion) This is one Dua, SubhanAllah! Very basic but comprehensive Dua. Most of the time these are the sources that lead us to sins and harm. A Must dua for Muslims. Easy way to memorise is to break it up like: আল্লাহুম্মা ইন্নি আউজুবিকা ১। মিন শাররি সামঈই ২। ওয়া মিন শাররি লিসানিই ৩। ওয়া মিন শাররি বাচরিই ৪। ওয়া মিন শাররি কলবিই ৫। ওয়া মিন শাররি মানিঈই ও আল্লাহ্‌, আমি তোমার কাছে আশ্রয় চাই, ১। আমার কান যেন অশ্লীল কিছু না শোনে, নোংরা কোন কিছু শোনার আকাঙ্খা থেকে, ২। আমার জিহ্বার পাপ থেকে, অশ্লীল কোন কথা বলা থেকে, তুমি অসন্তুষ্ট হও এমন কোন কথা থেকে ৩। আমার চোখের পাপ থেকে, দেখার মাধ্যমে যা কিছু পাপ হয় তা থেকে ৪। আমার অন্তরের নোংরামী থেকে, ৫। আমার অশ্লীল কোন আকাঙ্ক্ষা থেকে। সুনান আবু দাউদ ১৫৫১ Narrated Shakl ibn Humayd: I said: Messenger of Allah, teach me a supplication. He said: Say: “O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I hear, from the evil of what I see, from the evil of what I speak, from the evil of what I think, and from the evil of my semen” (i.e. sexual passion) .حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، – الْمَعْنَى – عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، عَنْ بِلاَلٍ الْعَبْسِيِّ، عَنْ شُتَيْرِ بْنِ شَكَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ شَكَلِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ – قَالَ – قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَلِّمْنِي دُعَاءً قَالَ ‏ “‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّي ‏”‏ ‏.‏ Grade : Sahih (Al-Albani) صحيح (الألباني) حكم : Reference : Sunan Abi Dawud 1551 In-book reference : Book 8, Hadith 136 English translation : Book 8, Hadith 1546

t: Saheeh al-Jaami 4869. O Ulama of Muslims, Know your RESPONSIBILITY being Scholars – It’s preaching TAWHEED!
e: Rasulullah Sallillahu ALaihi Wa Sallam said: “I have been sent ahead of the Hour with the sword, so that Allaah will be worshiped alone, and my provision has been placed in the shade of my spear, and humiliation has been
x: Rasulullah Sallillahu ALaihi Wa Sallam said: “I have been sent ahead of the Hour with the sword, so that Allaah will be worshiped alone , and my provision has been placed in the shade of my spear, and humiliation has been decreed for those who go against my command, and whoever imitates a people is one of them.” Narrated by Ahmad, 4869; Saheeh al-Jaami’, 2831. So, those who claim that ‘Ulema are the inheritors of the prophets’ which they rightfully claim though, but the problem is that these Ulema understand, follow and only take part of the responsibility of Rasulullah Sallillahu A’laihi Wa Sallam According to this Hadith the PRIME responsibility of the Ulema is to do Dawah of Tawheed with sword. If they are not in a position to do that then, they should at least talk about that, teach about that, make people aware about that. And even if they are not in a position to teach or talk about that they should support those who do that. In the utmost dire situation if they are not in a position to do even any of these, they should at least not stand against those who bear the responsibility being the true inheritor of Rasulullah Sallallahu A’laihi Wa Sallam. But most of the Ulema today left the responsibility being the ‘inheritor’ of Rasulullah yet they preach this Hadith (‘Ulema are the inheritor of the prophets’) to paralyses the minds of the Muslims to make them the blind followers of theirs. And this is the Hadith that should be enough for the ‘people of understanding’ to differentiate between the Haqq Ulema from the Baatil ones. I ask every Muslim, Since you were forbidden to learn Deen directly from the Quran and the Hadith, Since you were forbidden to contemplate on the Quran yourself, Then let me ask you, Who do you take your Deen from? Have you ever learned anything of Deen from such kind of Ulema? Have you ever even met any such Ulema in your life who really is the inheritor of the prophet? So, who are taking your Deen from? And Allah knows best. May Allah give us proper understanding of Deen.

t: Tirmidhi 57. You were WARNED about shaitan, al-walahan, but you keep WASTING water just because of the luxury and comfort of the Tap Water
e: ————– Jami` at-Tirmidhi » The Book on Purification Chapter: [What Has Been Related] About It Being Disliked To Be Wasteful With Water During Wudu (43) باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الإِسْرَافِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ بِالْمَاءِ U
x: ————– Jami` at-Tirmidhi » The Book on Purification Chapter: [What Has Been Related] About It Being Disliked To Be Wasteful With Water During Wudu (43) باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الإِسْرَافِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ بِالْمَاءِ Ubayy bin Ka’b narrated that : the Prophet said: “Indeed there is a Shaitan for Wudu’ who is called “AI-Walahan. “So beware of wasting of water.” حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَارِجَةُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عُتَىِّ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ السَّعْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ إِنَّ لِلْوُضُوءِ شَيْطَانًا يُقَالُ لَهُ الْوَلْهَانُ فَاتَّقُوا وَسْوَاسَ الْمَاءِ ‏” ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى حَدِيثُ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ وَلَيْسَ إِسْنَادُهُ بِالْقَوِيِّ وَالصَّحِيحِ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ الْحَدِيثِ لأَنَّا لاَ نَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا أَسْنَدَهُ غَيْرَ خَارِجَةَ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ مِنْ غَيْرِ وَجْهٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَوْلَهُ وَلاَ يَصِحُّ فِي هَذَا الْبَابِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْءٌ ‏.‏ وَخَارِجَةُ لَيْسَ بِالْقَوِيِّ عِنْدَ أَصْحَابِنَا وَضَعَّفَهُ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ‏. Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! This issue make me upset so much that I have to be hard on my writings: Only applicable to those who just took the practice so easy that they will open the tap and the water will just keep pouring while they make wudu. So, here it is: O Muslims of today! Where would you go! The modern times seems a curse for you. The modern technologies seems a blockade on your practice of Deen as the way your messenger taught you, as the way Sahaba practiced and the way the Salaf practiced Deen. May Allah guide you O Muslims. May Allah guide you to hold back and think what are you doing, which way you are heading only because you accepted anything and everything that the technology offered to you. And your Ulema is preaching you to do the Islam as the way Sahaba did. So, you keep following the Shabah in your rituals while they were under the Islamic authority but meanwhile the Kuffar pull you in a time where they became your authority and yet you are thinking doing only those rituals will do you any good on your way to Jannah! Had you just thought and imagined you are in the company of Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam! You would have always see things ‘out of the box’! Don’t you know how much water you waste while making Wudu only because you have the ease of flowing of the water, the Tap? Why do you have to do it because it’s just made that way? Why don’t you take a bowl and pour water in the bowl first and then make Wudu from that water. Practice this in your home while making Wudu and then suggest the Masjid authorities to put bowl in the Wudu area. It’s just that simple. You save water. Meaning, you stop wasting water. Meaning, you protect yourself from the shaitan, al-walahan. And more importantly you follow the way Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam made Wudu. SubhanAllah! How many benefits are there! May Allah guide us, protect us from wasting. Ameen. ‏ Grade : Sahih (Darussalam) Reference : Jami` at-Tirmidhi 57 In-book reference : Book 1, Hadith 57 English translation : Vol. 1, Book 1, Hadith 57

x: Al-Kahf 18:15 “These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear authority? t: Ibn Abee Shaybah 1/114: Know the VASTNESS: Our UNIVERSE and the 6 more above it, in comparison to the size of Allah’s Kursee, is a RING in a desert.
e: Prophet Muhammad (sallallahu ‘alayhi wa sallam) said: “The seven Heavens compared to the Kursee (the footstool) is like a ring which is thrown into a desert. And such is the magnitude of the ‘Arsh (the Throne of Allah) c
x: Prophet Muhammad (sallallahu ‘alayhi wa sallam) said: “ The seven Heavens compared to the Kursee (the footstool) is like a ring which is thrown into a desert. And such is the magnitude of the ‘Arsh (the Throne of Allah) compared with the Kursee.” Saheeh: Related by Ibn Abee Shaybah in Kitaabul-‘Arsh (1/114) and al-Bayhaqee in as-Asmaa was-Sifaat (p.290), from Abu Dharr (radiAllahu ‘anhu). The hadeeth is authentic due to its various routes of transmission-as Shaykh al-Albaanee has explained in as-Saheeh (no.109).

e: Two Greeds That Harm A Man’s Deen Prophet Muḥammad Ṣallallāhu-ʿAlaihi Wa Sallam said: “Two hungry wolves sent among a flock of sheep are NOT MORE destructive to them than a person’s GREED for WEALTH and FAME are to his D
x: Two Greeds That Harm A Man’s Deen Prophet Muḥammad Ṣallallāhu-ʿAlaihi Wa Sallam said: “Two hungry wolves sent among a flock of sheep are NOT MORE destructive to them than a person’s GREED for WEALTH and FAME are to his Deen.” Tirmidhi 2376 ● [سنن الترمذي ٢٣٧٦ ، صححه الألباني] গ্রন্থঃ সূনান আত তিরমিজী [তাহকীককৃত] অধ্যায়ঃ ৩৪/ দুনিয়াবী ভোগবিলাসের প্রতি অনাসক্তি (كتاب الزهد عن رسول الله ﷺ) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ২৩৭৬ ৪৩. সম্পদ ও প্রতিপত্তির মোহ মানুষকে পথভ্রষ্ট করে ২৩৭৬। কাব ইবনু মালিক আল-আনসারী (রাঃ) হতে বর্ণিত আছে, তিনি বলেন, রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেছেনঃ দুটি ক্ষুধার্ত নেকড়ে বাঘকে ছাগলের পালে ছেড়ে দেয়া হলে পরে তা যতটুকু না ক্ষতিসাধন করে, কারো সম্পদ ও প্রতিপত্তির লোভ এর চেয়ে বেশি ক্ষতিসাধন করে তার ধর্মের। সহীহ, রাওযুন নায়ীর (৫-৭)। আবূ ঈসা বলেন, এ হাদীসটি হাসান সহীহ। ইবনু উমর (রাঃ) হতে রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লামের সূত্রেও এ অনুচ্ছেদে হাদীস বর্ণিত আছে। তবে তার সনদসূত্র সহীহ নয়। Ibn Ka’b bin Malik Al-Ansari narrated from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said: “Two wolves free among sheep are no more destructive to them than a man’s desire for wealth and honor is to his religion.” باب ‏ حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ “‏ مَا ذِئْبَانِ جَائِعَانِ أُرْسِلاَ فِي غَنَمٍ بِأَفْسَدَ لَهَا مِنْ حِرْصِ الْمَرْءِ عَلَى الْمَالِ وَالشَّرَفِ لِدِينِهِ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏ وَيُرْوَى فِي هَذَا الْبَابِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ يَصِحُّ إِسْنَادُهُ ‏.‏ May Allah protect us from it.

t: Quran 35:28 – Fatir. What is Taqwa? Why do you need Taqwa? What are the ACTS of Taqwa and What are the ACTS that are NEARER to TAQWA?
e: Bismillah Al Hamdulillah Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’la Rasulillah! What is Taqwa? Why do you need Taqwa? Taqwa means Fear/ Mindfulness/ Consciousness of Allah. Allah ordered you to have Taqwa 3:102, 5:2, 58:9 Taqwa is what s
x: Bismillah Al Hamdulillah Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’la Rasulillah! What is Taqwa? Why do you need Taqwa? Taqwa means Fear/ Mindfulness/ Consciousness of Allah. Allah ordered you to have Taqwa 3:102, 5:2, 58:9 Taqwa is what saved a Muslim from materialism and many other tests (3:15) Taqwa is described as the best of the clothing of a believer (7:26) The one who has Taqwa is called Muttaqeen. and Allah loves Muttaqeen. The best person to Allah is the one who has Taqwa 49:13 You need Taqwa to got o Hajj. (2:197) Allah pour Rahmah to the one who has Taqwa (7:96), 47:36. Allah forgives the sins of those who have Taqwa (At-Talaq 65:5) How can you achieve Taqwa? Unless you have the knowledge of Allah you cannot have Taqwa (Khashia) (35:28) That’s how acquiring knowledge of Deen becomes an obligation. But there are other acts which are NEAR to TAQWA: Forgiveness 2:237 Graciousness Being Just (5:8) Honoring symbols of Allah (22:32) is a sign of Taqwa

x: গ্রন্থঃ সহীহ বুখারী (তাওহীদ) অধ্যায়ঃ ২/ ঈমান (বিশ্বাস) (كتاب الإيمان) হাদিস নম্বরঃ ২৫ ২/১৭. “অতঃপর যদি তাঁরা তাওবাহ করে, সালাত কায়িম করে এবং যাকাত দেয় তবে তাঁদের পথ ছেড়ে দাও।” (আত-তাওবাহ ৯/৫) ইবনু ‘উমার (রাযি.) হতে বর্ণিত। আল্লাহর রাসূল সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেনঃ আমি লোকদের সাথে যুদ্ধ চালিয়ে যাবার জন্য নির্দেশিত হয়েছি, যতক্ষণ না তারা সাক্ষ্য দেয় যে, আল্লাহ্ ব্যতীত প্রকৃত কোন উপাস্য নেই ও মুহাম্মাদ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম আল্লাহর রাসূল, আর সালাত প্রতিষ্ঠা করে ও যাকাত আদায় করে। তারা যদি এগুলো করে, তবে আমার পক্ষ হতে তাদের জান ও মালের ব্যাপারে নিরাপত্তা লাভ করলো; অবশ্য ইসলামের বিধান অনুযায়ী যদি কোন কারণ থাকে, তাহলে স্বতন্ত্র কথা। আর তাদের হিসাবের ভার আল্লাহর উপর অর্পিত। (মুসলিম ১/৮ হাঃ ২২) (আধুনিক প্রকাশনীঃ ২৪, ইসলামিক ফাউন্ডেশনঃ ২৪) (17) Chapter: (The Statement of Allah Jalla Jalalahu) “But if they repent [by rejecting Shirk (polytheism) and accept Islamic Monotheism] and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat) and give Zakat then leave their way free.” Narrated Ibn ‘Umar: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “I have been ordered (by Allah) to fight against the people until they testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ), and offer the prayers perfectly and give the obligatory charity, so if they perform that, then they save their lives and property from me except for Islamic laws and then their reckoning (accounts) will be done by Allah. ” بَابُ: {فَإِنْ تَابُوا وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاَةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَخَلُّوا سَبِيلَهُمْ} حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُسْنَدِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَوْحٍ الْحَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلاَةَ، وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ، فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ عَصَمُوا مِنِّي دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّ الإِسْلاَمِ، وَحِسَابُهُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏”‏‏. Ibn ‘Umar narrated: ” ‘Umar delivered a Khutbah to us at Al-Jabiyah. He said: ‘O you people! Indeed I have stood among you as Rasulullah Sallillahu ALaihi Wa Sallam stood among us, and he said: “I order you (to stick to) my Companions, then those who come after them, then those who come after them. Then lying will spread until a man will take an oath when no oath was sought from him, and a witness will testify when his testimony was not sought. Sunan At-Tirmidhi. Vol 4, Book 31, Book of Al-Fitan, Hadith No. 2165 Their explaining/ understanding of this Ayah remind me of those people who denied to pay Zakah anymore after Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam’s death. These people explained the following Ayah that paying Zakah is only applicable to Rasulullah. At-Taubah 9:103 خُذۡ مِنۡ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ صَدَقَةࣰ تُطَهِّرُهُمۡ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّ صَلَوٰتَكَ سَكَنࣱ لَّهُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ “তাদের সম্পদ থেকে সদাকা নাও। এর মাধ্যমে তাদেরকে তুমি পবিত্র ও পরিশুদ্ধ করবে। আর তাদের জন্য দো‘আ কর, নিশ্চয় তোমার দো‘আ তাদের জন্য প্রশান্তিকর। আর আল্লাহ সর্বশ্রোতা, সর্বজ্ঞ।” “Take, [O Muḥammad], from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke [Allāh’s blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.” Subhanallah! If you really carefully analyse the Ayah you might find their arguments somewhat understandable. Because they thought clearly it was mentioned Dua and blessing directly from Rasulullah! Since Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam is not there anymore, then, how paying Zakah is applied to them anymore! Subhanallah, got some logic. Yet their understanding and deniel of paying of Zakah was treated by fighting against them by Abu Bakr Radiallahu anhu. Then, what about the understanding of these people about the statement of Rasulullah, “I am ordered to fight….”? Where did they get this from? Did they provide any evidence that says it is only applied to the Arab Mushrikun as they explained? Did any previous Ulama including the Ulama of Madhabs ever explained it that it was only applied to Arab Mushrikun? Then, where they get thus from? Rather it goes in line with the understanding of giving distorting understanding of Jihad. And these all actually goes to the root of all evils, living with Shirk by living and submitting willingly to the Kuffar’s authority and thus sugarcoating their Dawah work by distorting Allah’s Deen. And Allah knows best. May Allah guide these people

t: Quran 7:54 – Al-A’raf: My RABB is Allah
e: Indeed, your creator, nourisher, sustainer is Allah
x: 7:54 إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ ۗ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ Bismillah Al Hamdulillah Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’la Rasulillah! ‘Lord Cromer’ author of ‘Modern Egypt’, the Kafir, the mastermind who stated how Muslims could be taken out of Islam, and they did. They have successfully taken Muslim out of Islam in the last 200 years. ‘Lord Robert Clive’, the first British Governor of the Bengal Presidency, the enemy of Islam, the Kafir, who planted the seed that made the Muslims subservient in the Indian Region. These are the people they call ‘Lord’. And we have a few generations of Muslim Scholars, those who call my RABB by the same title. Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Rajiun. This itself is the proof of the disaster that the Kuffar, like those two, have planned and succeeded in their plot of taking Muslims out of Islam. May Allah bring our Scholars back in Deen. It’s sickening; there’s rarely any English Quran or Tafseer of the Quran you would find that doesn’t do this. That’s how easy Muslim took it. It’s heartbreaking, rarely would you find any Khateeb in the mimbar or an Islamic lecturer use the word ‘RABB’ to describe my Rabb, though they give Khutba not to any Kuffar, to the Muslims, but they use the same word ‘Lord’ that was set for them by the Kuffar. By Allah, I feel vomiting when I hear the word ‘Lord’ from a Muslim Aleem in the Jumu’ah Khutbah. I beg my Rabb to guide them. And that’s how the Haqq manifested. Rasulullah is Haqq, Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam. The scholars, Ulema of the Muslim Ummah, in the last few generations have been following the Kuffar Inch by Inch. May Allah guide these Ulema of Muslims. My Rabb is He, who created me. My Rabb is He who does everything for me. My Rabb is He who created me (Quran 96:2) as the best creation. (Quran 95:4) My Rabb is He, who nourishes every single cell of my body , (Quran 91:7) My Rabb is He who gives me the needs , (Quran 93:8) My Rabb is He who guides me , (Quran 93:7) My Rabb is He who teaches me knowledge , (Quran 2:282) My Rabb is He who taught me how to worship Him , (Quran 2:239) My Rabb is He who guards me , (Quran 86:4) My Rabb is He who showed me right and wrong , (Quran 91:8) My Rabb is He who warned me of the evil (Quran 92:8-10) My Yabb is He who rewards me for the good (Quran 95:6) My Rabb is He who does everything else in between . (Quran 97:4) My Rabb is He who promised me of Jannah! (Quran 41:30) And you ‘Muslims’ in Kuffar’s Mindset’ , The product of the Kuffar’s manufacturing plant describes my Rabb by the filthy word of the Kuffar! Wa Allahu A’lam. May Allah save you from His wrath! May Allah guide you. May Allah bring you back to Deen! May Allah guide me and protect me. Ameen.

t: Tirmdhi 370: Know the Biological/ Physical Influence of shaitan over you
e: Jami` at-Tirmidhi » The Book on Salat (Prayer) » Hadith (156) Chapter: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked to Yawn During Salat (156) باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ التَّثَاؤُبِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ Abu Hurairah narra
x: Jami` at-Tirmidhi » The Book on Salat (Prayer) » Hadith (156) Chapter: What Has Been Related About It Being Disliked to Yawn During Salat (156) باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ التَّثَاؤُبِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ Abu Hurairah narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Yawning in prayer (salah) is from the Shaitan, so when one of you yawns then let him suppress (it) as much as possible.” حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ التَّثَاؤُبُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِذَا تَثَاءَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَكْظِمْ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ ‏” ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ وَجَدِّ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى حَدِيثُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ كَرِهَ قَوْمٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ التَّثَاؤُبَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِنِّي لأَرُدُّ التَّثَاؤُبَ بِالتَّنَحْنُحِ ‏.‏ Grade : Sahih (Darussalam) Reference : Jami` at-Tirmidhi 370 In-book reference : Book 2, Hadith 222 English translation : Vol. 1, Book 2, Hadith 370

t: Saheeh Bukhari 6406: Tasbeah that makes your SCALE heavy and LOVING to Ar-Rahman!
e: Narrated Abu Huraira Radiallahu Anhu: Rasulullah Sallallahu Allahi Wa Sallam said, “There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Ben
x: Narrated Abu Huraira Radiallahu Anhu: Rasulullah Sallallahu Allahi Wa Sallam said, “There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah), and they are, Subhan Allahil Azim and Subhan Allahi Wa Bihamdihi.” حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ ‏ كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏” ‏‏‏ Sahih al-Bukhari 6406 In-book : Book 80, Hadith 101 USC-MSA web (English) : Vol. 8, Book 75, Hadith 415 (deprecated) Note: If you read the Hadith carefully, these Tasbeah are not meant to be recited together. Rather, سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ Subhan Allahil Azim is one itself and سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ Subhan Allahi Wa Bihamdihi is another by itself. The Hadith didn’t make them both a combined Tasbeah. I used to combine both until I read the Hadith myself and notice that they actually are seperate Tasbeah. And Allah knows best. May Allah make our scale of good deeds heavy.

t: Sahih Bukhari 6408. Make TASBEAH on the ROADS and ASK for Jannah and seek REFUGE from Jahannam to get Allah’s FORGIVENESS
e: Narrated Abu Huraira: Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “Allah has some angels who look for those who celebrate the Praises of Allah on the roads and paths. And when they find some people celebrating the Prais
x: Narrated Abu Huraira: Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “Allah has some angels who look for those who celebrate the Praises of Allah on the roads and paths. And when they find some people celebrating the Praises of Allah, they call each other, saying, “Come to the object of your pursuit.’ “ He added, “Then the angels encircle them with their wings up to the sky of the world.” He added. “(after those people celebrated the Praises of Allah, and the angels go back), their RABB, asks them (those angels)—-though He knows better than them—-‘What do My slaves say?’ The angels reply, ‘They say: Subhan Allah, Allahu Akbar, and Alham-du-li l-lah , Allah then says ‘Did they see Me?’ The angels reply, ‘No! By Allah, they didn’t see You.’ Allah says, How it would have been if they saw Me?’ The angels reply, ‘If they saw You, they would worship You more devoutly and celebrate Your Glory more deeply, and declare Your freedom from any resemblance to anything more often.’ Allah says (to the angels), ‘What do they ask Me for?’ The angels reply, ‘They ask You for Paradise.’ Allah says (to the angels), ‘Did they see it?’ The angels say, ‘No! By Allah, O RABB! They did not see it.’ Allah says, How it would have been if they saw it?’ The angels say, ‘If they saw it, they would have greater covetousness for it and would seek It with greater zeal and would have greater desire for it.’ Allah says, ‘From what do they seek refuge?’ The angels reply, ‘They seek refuge from the (Hell) Fire.’ Allah says, ‘Did they see it?’ The angels say, ‘No By Allah, O RABB! They did not see it.’ Allah says, How it would have been if they saw it?’ The angels say, ‘If they saw it they would flee from it with the extreme fleeing and would have extreme fear from it.’ Then Allah says, ‘I make you witnesses that I have forgiven them.”‘ Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam added, “One of the angels would say, ‘There was so-and-so amongst them, and he was not one of them, but he had just come for some need.’ Allah would say, ‘These are those people whose companions will not be reduced to misery.’ “ حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ ‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً يَطُوفُونَ فِي الطُّرُقِ، يَلْتَمِسُونَ أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ، فَإِذَا وَجَدُوا قَوْمًا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ تَنَادَوْا هَلُمُّوا إِلَى حَاجَتِكُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَحُفُّونَهُمْ بِأَجْنِحَتِهِمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا‏. ‏ قَالَ فَيَسْأَلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَهْوَ أَعْلَمُ مِنْهُمْ مَا يَقُولُ عِبَادِي قَالُوا يَقُولُونَ يُسَبِّحُونَكَ، وَيُكَبِّرُونَكَ، وَيَحْمَدُونَكَ وَيُمَجِّدُونَكَ ‏. ‏ قَالَ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ رَأَوْنِي قَالَ فَيَقُولُونَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَوْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَقُولُ وَكَيْفَ لَوْ رَأَوْنِي قَالَ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ رَأَوْكَ كَانُوا أَشَدَّ لَكَ عِبَادَةً، وَأَشَدَّ لَكَ تَمْجِيدًا، وَأَكْثَرَ لَكَ تَسْبِيحًا‏.‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ فَمَا يَسْأَلُونِي قَالَ يَسْأَلُونَكَ الْجَنَّةَ‏. ‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ وَهَلْ رَأَوْهَا قَالَ يَقُولُونَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَبِّ مَا رَأَوْهَا‏. ‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ فَكَيْفَ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ رَأَوْهَا قَالَ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ رَأَوْهَا كَانُوا أَشَدَّ عَلَيْهَا حِرْصًا، وَأَشَدَّ لَهَا طَلَبًا، وَأَعْظَمَ فِيهَا رَغْبَةً‏.‏ قَالَ فَمِمَّ يَتَعَوَّذُونَ قَالَ يَقُولُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ‏. ‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ وَهَلْ رَأَوْهَا قَالَ يَقُولُونَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَوْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ فَكَيْفَ لَوْ رَأَوْهَا قَالَ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ رَأَوْهَا كَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهَا فِرَارًا، وَأَشَدَّ لَهَا مَخَافَةً‏. ‏ قَالَ فَيَقُولُ x: The Ayah 5:5 “This day [all] good foods have been made lawful, and the food of those who were given the Scripture is lawful for you and your food is lawful for them. And [lawful in marriage are] chaste women from among the believers and chaste women from among those who were given the Scripture before you, when you have given them their due compensation, desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual intercourse or taking [secret] lovers. And whoever denies the faith – his work has become worthless, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.” “আজ তোমাদের জন্য পবিত্র বস্তুসমূহ হালাল করা হল। আহলে কিতাবদের খাদ্য তোমাদের জন্যে হালাল এবং তোমাদের খাদ্য তাদের জন্য হালাল। তোমাদের জন্যে হালাল সতী-সাধ্বী মুসলমান নারী এবং তাদের সতী-সাধ্বী নারী, যাদেরকে কিতাব দেয়া হয়েছে তোমাদের পূর্বে, যখন তোমরা তাদেরকে মোহরানা প্রদান কর তাদেরকে স্ত্রী করার জন্যে, কামবাসনা চরিতার্থ করার জন্যে কিংবা গুপ্ত প্রেমে লিপ্ত হওয়ার জন্যে নয়। যে ব্যক্তি বিশ্বাসের বিষয় অবিশ্বাস করে, তার শ্রম বিফলে যাবে এবং পরকালে সে ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হবে।” Bismillah Al Hamdulillah AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah My Reflection: May Allah guide you O Muslim! O ‘Ulema’ of Muslim! How do you take Allah’s word! You take this Ayah to make the Jews and Christian women of today HALAL for Muslim? Is this the Ayah that your ‘Ulema’ use to allow you to marry a Jews and Christian woman while she remains a Jews or a Christian? Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Rajiun. Aren’t these the Ulema who say, ‘You can’t take one Ayah of the Quran to interpret it’? Look, my brother, I have to come back to the same thing again and again. Allah, Al-Khaliq created you with the best mould and make you above all the creation. How? By giving you the ability to think, by giving you the device to think. (common knowledge to a Muslim). And then He, Tabaraka Wa Ta’ala gave you a guideline. So, you have to use the brain and use the guideline. Both together. This is the bottom line for you being Muslim. Now, let’s get back to the Ayah to understand the sheep-headed ‘Ulema’ those allow you to marry today’s Jews and Christian women. Critical Reasoning: Let’s now discuss the criteria that Allah sets for you to marry a Ahlul Kitab. Your Rabb says, “Marry Mohsinaah (chaste) women from those who were given the Kitab (scripture) before you.” Now, go and find a women from among the Jews and Christian who has the Kitab of Allah which Allah Subhanahu Wa Tal’ala sent to Musa and Isa Alaihi Wa Sallam. Would you find the Kitab? Is the Bible of today the Kitab of Allah? How many words there today that remain of what was given to Musa and Isa Alaihi Wa Sallam? You have to find a woman among them who knows what is Allah’s Kitab. That’s the first criteria. Now, as for the next, let me put this scenerio for you. There’s a ‘Muslim’ women who believes in the Qur’an, believes in Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam, do all the rituals of Islam, a pious ‘Muslim’ woman. But she does just one act. She goes to a grave of an ‘Awlia’ of Allah, she asks the dead ‘Awlia’, to ask Allah for her to gave her a baby because she believes this dead ‘Awlia’ of Allah has special connection with Allah. Now let me ask you, would you marry this woman? Would your Ulema make this woman Halal for you? No! Why not? SubhanAllah! She was given the scripture! Al-Quran! What makes your Ulema now to make her Haram in marriage for you? Because she is a Mushrik! Then, what is a Jews and Christian woman of today? Do you find a Jews or Christian woman today who believes in the Kitab that Allah gave to Isa and Moses Alaihi Wa Sallam but she is not a Mushrik? Do you find a Jews or Christian woman today who doesn’t believe ‘Jesus’ as ‘God’? Does it make her a Mushrikah or not? It’s Simple Math! And Allah knows best. May Allah Al-Hadi guide you, O Muslim. May Allah guide your Ulema that you blindly follow! May Allah save you from Blind Following And May Allah guide you and me.

t: Ibn Taymiyyah. How to BEG Allah for the understanding of the Quran? How did SALAF reflected on the Quran?
e: SubhanAllah! What do you see here? Let’s do a Critical Reasoning. He had ‘come across’ different explanations: Does it mean he came across of explanations from his own self or from others too? I think this ‘hundred’ here
x: SubhanAllah! What do you see here? Let’s do a Critical Reasoning. He had ‘come across’ different explanations: Does it mean he came across of explanations from his own self or from others too? I think this ‘hundred’ here used as an expression, not exactly as a number. But what we can understand that it’s too many. So, where he got those different explanations from? If it is from himself, he has to think about it for many days! SubhanAllah what a Baraka they get of their time! And I think he got many explanations from many different scholars too! What does it mean? After knowing an explanation from a teacher yet he wanted to understand it properly and more precisely, so he kept thinking. And then if all of these explanations he came across from his ‘own mind’ then, he must have been kept thinking and thinking and he found new explanations. Then, why did he beg Allah so much? Was he confused of all different understanding or was he scared? Did he then ran from one teacher to another to get more confused! No! he got what he got, maybe from others and maybe from himself combined. And yet he kept thinking. He didn’t take those explanations as CERTAIN knowledge and sealed his brain off. He kept thinking and thinking and then see how he begged Allah for precise understanding! SubhanAllah! And for us? How many ways they put a restriction on today’s students! You are taught a Tafsir and that’s the explanation you have to swallow, you have no scope to think any other ways! ‘You can’t think about it yourself!’ There’s no encouragement for thinking and contemplating on the Quran. The teaching method suppose to encourage the students to open their minds for thinking but unfortunately the method itself put the seal on to the mind of the students that ‘You can’t think it yourself’, ‘You have to take from Ulema’ So, they pour unto them a ‘packaged’ understanding of the Quran and seal their brain off, thus produce a bunch of sheep from the ‘Islmaic’ Universities. Therefore, the sheep got the mindset that ‘We don’t have the Akl to think, thinking on the Quran! It’s for Ulema’! La Hawla Wa La Quwata Illa Billah! And the result! An Ayah of the Quran doesn’t impact on the Muslims now! He has to get it from his Ulema! The mind is sealed, the thinking is blocked and the Ummah is ruined! Allah knows best. May Allah guide me and guide Muslims! May Allah Ta Baraka Ta’ala give us proper understanding of the Deen.

t: Quran 17:27. How much WATER do you spend while making WUDU? Allah commanded you to take shaitan as your enemy but you took him as your brother!
e: إِنَّ ٱلْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورًۭا “Surely the wasteful are ˹like˺ brothers to the devils. And the Devil is ever ungrateful to his Lord.” (Sura Al-Isra 1
x: إِنَّ ٱلْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورًۭا “Surely the wasteful are ˹like˺ brothers to the devils. And the Devil is ever ungrateful to his Lord.” (Sura Al-Isra 17;27) Hadith أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ بِمَكُّوكٍ وَيَغْتَسِلُ بِخَمْسَةِ مَكَاكِيَّ ‏.‏ It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Jabr said: “I heard Anas bin Malik say: ‘The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform Wudu’ with a Makkuk (cup) and Ghusl with five Makkuks (cups).’” Sahih (Darussalam) Sunan an-Nasa’i 73 Arabic/English book : Vol. 1, Book 1, Hadith 73. Bismillah Al Hamdulillah AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah SubhanAllah! Ah technology! How easy is life! How technology and seeking comfort through it makes the path of Jannah harder for Muslims. Rabbir Rahmanul Musta’aan. What a system we follow and we took it easy, let alone take a step to escape or deny this system! How long people have been using water tap? This water TAP became a TRAP for shaitan! Nujubillah! How much water we Muslims waste today only during wudu? And we took it easy! Hey! Can’t you just use a common sense that Allah favoured you with most? Allah asked you to take shaitan as your enemy, didn’t he? Then, how come you take him as your brother by wasting so much water during wudu? And where that puts you? Yet, how can you think you are saved from shaitan’s mission! Naujubillah! Yeah Rabb, guide us! Yeah Allah guide us! O my Muslim nation, change you status. Save yourself from shaitan. Stop wasting anything, Water, electriity, food, money, your time! Stop! And start with saving water during wudu! And how do you do it? At home: Take the water in a pot, in a small bowl and make wudu from it. Teach your family too. At Masjid, take water on the right hand and use left hand to turn the Tap off while you are rubbing hands, face. That’s how you struggle not to waste water. Try it hard, do your best. Don’t let it go. Don’t make shaitan your brother! May Allah make it easy on us. May Allah save us from shaitan. May Allah guide us.

t: Ibn Hajar. Living among the Kuffar! Know the consequences!
e: “Dwelling among the Kuffar is a form of throwing oneself into destruction” Imam Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani (Fath-Al-Bari 13/61) May Allah save us from the destruction. 4:75 وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَ
x: “Dwelling among the Kuffar is a form of throwing oneself into destruction” Imam Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani (Fath-Al-Bari 13/61) May Allah save us from the destruction. 4:75 وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا وَاجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا And what is [the matter] with you that you fight not in the cause of Allah and [for] the oppressed among men, women, and children who say, “Our RABB, take us out of this city of oppressive people and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and appoint for us from Yourself a helper? “ Bangla আর তোমাদের কি হল যে, তেমারা আল্লাহর রাহে লড়াই করছ না দুর্বল সেই পুরুষ, নারী ও শিশুদের পক্ষে, যারা বলে, হে আমাদের পালনকর্তা! আমাদিগকে এই জনপদ থেকে নিষ্কৃতি দান কর; এখানকার অধিবাসীরা যে, অত্যাচারী! আর তোমার পক্ষ থেকে আমাদের জন্য পক্ষালম্বনকারী নির্ধারণ করে দাও এবং তোমার পক্ষ থেকে আমাদের জন্য সাহায্যকারী নির্ধারণ করে দাও।

t: Know the HARM you cause to yourself when you play MUSIC on your JOURNEY
e: Angels do not accompany the travelers who have with them a dog and a bell. حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، – يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ – حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
x: Angels do not accompany the travelers who have with them a dog and a bell. حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، – يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ – حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ لاَ تَصْحَبُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ رُفْقَةً فِيهَا كَلْبٌ وَلاَ جَرَسٌ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ Reference : Sahih Muslim 2113 a In-book reference : Book 37, Hadith 157 USC-MSA web (English) reference : Book 24, Hadith 5277

t: Saheeh Muslim 6925/84(2731). How do Malaikah (Angels) praise Allah? ‘Subhan Allahi Wa Bihamdihi’
e: Abu Dharr reported that Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said: “Should I not inform you about the words liked most by Allah? I said: Yeah Rasulullah, do inform me about the words liked most by Allah. He said: Ver
x: Abu Dharr reported that Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said: “Should I not inform you about the words liked most by Allah? I said: Yeah Rasulullah, do inform me about the words liked most by Allah. He said: Verily, the words liked most by Allah are: “Subhanallahi Wa Bihamdihi” “Glory to Allah and praise is due to Him.” “حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَسْرِيِّ، مِنْ عَنَزَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏”‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِأَحَبِّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي بِأَحَبِّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏”‏ إِنَّ أَحَبَّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ “ Reference : Sahih Muslim 2731 b In-book reference : Book 48, Hadith 118 USC-MSA web (English) reference : Book 35, Hadith 6587

t: Ibne Majah 3794: The greatest Tasbeah for any time and every time, for anywhere and everywhere!
e: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah and Abu Saeed bore witness that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:”If a person says: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‘La ilaha illallahu wa Allahu Akbar (None has the right to
x: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah and Abu Saeed bore witness that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:”If a person says: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‘La ilaha illallahu wa Allahu Akbar (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Allah is the Most Great),’ Allah says: ‘My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, and I am the Most Great.’ If a person says: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ La ilaha Illallah wahdahu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone), Allah says: ‘My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, alone.’ If he says, لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ La ilaha illallahu la sharikalahu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah with no partner or associate),’ Allah says: ‘My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, with no partner or associate.’ If he says: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ‘La illah illallah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah, all dominion is His and all praise is to Him),’ Allah says: ‘My slave has spoken the truth; there is none of worthy of worship except I, all dominion Mine and all praise is due to Me.’ If he says: ‘ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ La illaha illallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is none worthy of worship and there is no power and no strength except with Allah),’ Allah says: ‘My slave has spoken then truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, and tehre is no power and no strength except with Me.’ One of the narrators Abu Ishaq said: “Then Agharr (another narrator) said something that I did not understand. I said to Abu Jafar: ‘What did he say?’ He said: ‘Whoever is blessed with (the ability to say) them (these words) at the time of death, the Fire will not touch him. ‘”حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ الزَّيَّاتِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَغَرِّ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ، أَنَّهُ شَهِدَ عَلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَأَبِي سَعِيدٍ أَنَّهُمَا شَهِدَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ “‏ إِذَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ صَدَقَ عَبْدِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَأَنَا أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ صَدَقَ عَبْدِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَحْدِي ‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ صَدَقَ عَبْدِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَلاَ شَرِيكَ لِي ‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ قَالَ صَدَقَ عَبْدِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا لِيَ الْمُلْكُ وَلِيَ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ صَدَقَ عَبْدِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِي ‏”‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ ثُمَّ قَالَ الأَغَرُّ شَيْئًا لَمْ أَفْهَمْهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مَا قَالَ فَقَالَ مَنْ رُزِقَهُنَّ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ لَمْ تَمَسَّهُ النَّارُ ‏.‏ Grade : Da’if (Darussalam) Reference : Sunan Ibn Majah 3794 In-book reference : Book 33, Hadith 139 English translation : Vol. 5, Book 33, Hadith 3794 The other Hadith about LA ILAHA ILLA ALLAH Abu Sa`eed al-Khudri said, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (Sall’Allahu alayhi wa salam) said (narrated by Jabir bin `Abdullah): “Moses (Alayhi salam) said: O my Rabb! Teach me something that I can remember You with and I can supplicate You with. Allah said: “Say ‘La ilaha ill Allah’, O Musa.” He (Musa) said: All of your servants say this. He (Allah) said: “If the seven Heavens and those who dwell in them other than Me and the seven Earths are put into one pan (of the scale) and ‘La ilaha ill Allah’ is put into the other; ‘La ilaha ill Allah’ would be heavier.” [Ibn Hibbaan and Haakim] “The best Dhikr (remembering Allah) is La ilaha illallah and the best supplication is Al-Hamdu Lillah.” [At-Tirmidhi, An-Nasa’i and Ibn Majah]

t: Tirmidhi 513. So, You think Islam is Easy! Did you know how a LITTLE thing (Just passing over the neck on Jumu’a) could cause a Muslim to JAHANNAM!
e: Aujubillah! Look at this!You think Jannah is easy!You think just attending Halaka and listening to the lectures, that’s enough, you are doing enough! ‘Allah is forgiving!’ ‘And I am doing my best! ‘ Then know why you nee
x: Aujubillah! Look at this! You think Jannah is easy! You think just attending Halaka and listening to the lectures, that’s enough, you are doing enough! ‘Allah is forgiving!’ ‘And I am doing my best! ‘ Then know why you need to read the TEXT of the Quran yourself from the ORIGINAL sources! This again prompts the TWO issues again: (1) Unless you read it yourself, (2) unless you give thought by yourself, You would never understand the significance of these issues. That’s how Critical Reasoning is so important. And why do you need to study Deen? Because IGNORANCE has NO EXCUSE in Islam. And without studying Deen, without you contemplating, you won’t take it seriously. You might listen to it from a lecture, but you will get an average warning, and you make it big. You might prohibit someone from advancing even when there is space to pass through. On the other hand, when you read it yourself and read the wording mindfully, then you would know it is talking about passing OVER the NECK/Shoulder. Therefore, you can put things in their proper place. But the point is, it is scary! It should scare one to death for how little things could cause an Ebadh of Allah to fire. You know, a Kafir is for fire, understandable. A Mushrik is for fire, understandable. A Fasiq, disobedient of Allah, is for fire, understandable. A Taghut is for fire, understandable, and so on and so forth. But who wants to go to the front of the row? An Ebadh of Allah who wants to get more reward! SubhanAllah! And he is for fire! Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Rajiun! What’s the reason here? He is causing annoyance to another Ebadh of Allah! He is interrupting another Ebadh of Allah! That’s it! Aujubillah! Just causing disturbance to an AabdAllah is enough for one to be in the fire. May Allah save us from Jahannam! And about the issue of Daef. All Daef Hadith is not rejectable Hadith when you know the reason it was classified as Daef, as it is mentioned in the comment by the translator. And Allah, Al-A’alim knows best. May Allah give us a proper understanding of Deen Ameen.

t: Sunan Nasai’ 143: ERASER of Sins: Isbagh Al-Wudu, Walking long to the Masjid, waiting for Salat and the next one
e: Hadith أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ ‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِمَا يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِهِ
x: Hadith أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ ‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِمَا يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِهِ الْخَطَايَا وَيَرْفَعُ بِهِ الدَّرَجَاتِ إِسْبَاغُ الْوُضُوءِ عَلَى الْمَكَارِهِ وَكَثْرَةُ الْخُطَا إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ وَانْتِظَارُ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ فَذَلِكُمُ الرِّبَاطُ فَذَلِكُمُ الرِّبَاطُ فَذَلِكُمُ الرِّبَاطُ ‏” ‏ ‏‏ It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Shall I not tell you of that by means of which Allah erases sins and raises (people) in status? Isbagh Al-Wudu’ (Doing Wudu’ properly) even when it is inconvenient, taking a lot of steps to the Masjid, and waiting for one Salah after another. That is the Ribat for you, that is the Ribat for you, that is the Ribat for you.” Sahih (Darussalam) Sunan an-Nasa’i English : Vol. 1, Book 1, Hadith 143 Arabic : Book 1, Hadith 144

t: Sahih Bukhari 6405: How to get all SINS Forgiven?
e: Hadith حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ ‏ مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَب

t: Abu Dawud 3462. Do you REALLY wonder, What’s the CAUSE of HUMILIATION of the Ummah?
e: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! Because of those Ulema who abandoned Jihad and gave bayyiyah to TAGHUT. Because of you, who take those Ulema as your Rabb, instead of Allah (as you follow
x: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! Because of those Ulema who abandoned Jihad and gave bayyiyah to TAGHUT. Because of you, who take those Ulema as your Rabb, instead of Allah (as you follow them blindly instead of using your brain. and why won’t you? Because you take teaching from them while shutting your brain and the first thing they teach you is that “You have no brain! You have to get the ‘tool’ first to understand Deen by sitting under their feet and only then you talk about Deen” Isn’t that they teach you, O Muslim? And Allah knows best. So, now read the Hadith and read the explanation, not from me but from Ulema of HAQQ Neglecting jihad is a cause of humiliation and scorn Abu Dawood (3462) narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said: I heard the Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) say: “When you engage in ‘aynah transactions (a kind of transaction intended to circumvent the prohibition on riba or usury), and you take hold of the tails of oxen and you are content with agriculture (at the time when jihad is obligatory), and you give up jihad, then Allaah will send upon you humiliation that will not be dispelled until you return to your religion, Allaah will send upon you humiliation that will not be dispelled until you return to your religion, Allaah will send upon you humiliation that will not be dispelled until you return to your religion.” Classed as saheeh by al-Albaani in Saheeh Abi Dawood . https://islamqa.info/en/46807 Hadith Explanation Hanging onto the Tails of Cows It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar (radi Allahu anhu) that the Prophet (sal Allahu alaihi wa sallam) said: “If you deal in usury (riba) and hang onto the tails of cows, being satisfied with cultivation and ceasing to take part in Jihad, Allah will inflict a humiliation upon you which will not be removed until you return to your religion.” [Reported by Ahmad and Abu Dawud and graded as authentic by Al-Qattan. Al-Hafiz states in Al-Bulugh that the chain of narrators is trustworthy and reliable.] This hadith lists three practices of the Muslim community that will result in their being humiliated in the world. The first one mentioned is dealing in riba. Taking or paying interest, witnessing it or writing up a contract involving it are all major sins condemned in the Quran. When dealing in riba becomes a common malaise, Muslims should expect to be disgraced in this world and the next. Hanging on the tails of cows implies not only agriculture but involvement in all trades and transactions which occupy the Muslims to such an extent that they abandon Jihad as a result of this involvement. Rasul Allah (sal Allahu alaihi wa sallam) is warning us against abandoning the commands of Allah (subhana wa ta’ala). Keeping clear of riba and participating in Jihad has been described in this hadith as “returning to your religion”. Jihad is “Fardh-ul-Kifayah” (collective duty) in normal conditions, while it becomes “Fardh-ul-Ain” (individual obligation) in some special circumstances. When something becomes Fardh-ul-Ain, each man and woman has to do it, and no-one is required to take permission from anyone else to perform the duty, e.g. the five daily prayers, or fasting in Ramadhan. According to the Fuqaha (Islamic Jurists) Jihad becomes Fardh-ul-Ain when any one of the following conditions exists: 1. The occupation of any “hand span” of Muslim territory by the Kuffar. Should this happen, Jihad becomes Fardh-ul-Ain. 2. All the Fuqaha have mentioned in their compilations that if a single Muslim man or woman is imprisoned by the Kuffar, Jihad becomes Fardh-ul-Ain until the captive is delivered. 3. If the ruler of the Muslims apostasizes from Islam (becomes a murtad), Qitaal (fighting) to remove him becomes Fardh-ul-Ain. The fuqaha state that a ruler becomes a murtad (apostate) if (i) he implements the systems of kufr in place of the Islamic systems (Shariah law) in the state or, (ii) in the battle of the Kuffar against Muslims he sides with the Kuffar. Source: www.IslamQA.info

t: Quran 5:35. Al-Wasilah. The Ayah that uses the MISGUIDED ones
e: 5:35 يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَابْتَغُوا إِلَيْهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ O you who have believed, fear Allah and seek the means [of nearness] to Him and str
x: 5:35 يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَابْتَغُوا إِلَيْهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ O you who have believed, fear Allah and seek the means [of nearness] to Him and strive in His cause that you may succeed. Bangla হে মুমিনগণ! আল্লাহকে ভয় কর, তাঁর নৈকট্য অন্বেষন কর এবং তাঁর পথে জেহাদ কর যাতে তোমরা সফলকাম হও। Critical Reasoning: Bismillah Al Hamdulillah AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah What type of Ayah is that? 1. Instruction 2. Reward/ Consequence. What are those? (1) Fear Allah (2) Seek or work towards Allah THROUGH WASILAH (3) Do Jihad in the path of Allah And also there is a consequence or reward for obeying these instructions, which is SUCCESS. Obeying those three instructions will make a believer to succeed. What’s the subject? A prescription, as to how to be succeeded. What are those things? Those Issues/ Subjects? Those 3 instructions are the subjects. (1) How do you Fear Allah? By obeying His command. Easy to understand. (3) How do you do Jihad? Have to look for it what is meant by Jihad. We will do that another day n Shaa Allah! (2) What’s the WASILAH to get to Allah? No idea. So, what do we do now to understand this instruction? Check the Ayah before it and after it if you can find any relevant info. And this Ayah has no relevance with the Ayah before or after it. Now, what do you do? I check the Tafseer. What Tafseer you check? The first one is Tafseer Abdullah Ibne Abbas? Why is that? Because Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam made Dua for him for knowledge of Qur’an. Our Ulema consider him the best scholar knowledge of his time. Tafseer Ibne Abbas says the following: ‘Seek with Allah high degrees through RIGHTEOUS works.’ What do you mean by that? Through the work that please Allah. Which means basically follow closely the instructions, recommendation etc. So, we don’t get nothing special from here about the word WASILAH. So, What’s next? I will check Tafseer Ibne Katheer. Why do you choose that? He usually links an ayah with the relevant other Ayat and Hadith. So, what do you get there? He quote another Ayah where Allah mention about Wasilah. Also he mentions the understanding of the Sahaba. And he mentioned the Hadith that talks about how to get Wasilah. Can you summerize those? Wasilah means to them is How you approach, the way of approaching to things. So they mentioned it is by obeying Allah’s commands. Ath-Thawri said that Talhah said that Ata' said that Ibn Abbas said that Wasilah means the means of approach'. Muj ahid, Abu Wa'il, Al-Hasan, Qatadah, Abdullah bin Kathir, As-Suddi, Ibn Zayd and others gave the same meaning for Wasilah. Qatadah said that the Ayah means, “Seek the means of approach to Him by obeying Him and performing the acts that please Him.” But at the same time, the Hadith says that Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam instructed the companion to ask ‘WASILAH for him, for it is a GRADE in the Jannah which Allah will only allow one of His slaves’ And what did He instructed to do? Sending Salah and Salam after hearing Adhan and asking for WASILAH for Rasulullah. It is basically the Dua that we make after Adhan. Is that you think enough to understand the meaning and your action about this? Unless I get any other meaning from any other reliable sources. What about other Tafseer? What about reading the group who explains this word as for giving Baiyah to a Sheikh/ Awlia/ ‘Peer’ to seek means to Allah? It would be interesting to read that too. But I think it is enough when you have opinion of Sahaba about it from a reliable Tafseer. And anything extra-ordinary, unusual from any later generation of scholars can be easily discardable. And Allah knows best. May Allah guide us to the proper understanding of his Deen. Ameen

x: Hadith حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَنْصُورًا، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏‏ إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وَضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الأَيْمَنِ، وَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏. ‏ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مُتَّ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، فَاجْعَلْهُنَّ آخِرَ مَا تَقُولُ ‏”‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَسْتَذْكِرُهُنَّ وَبِرَسُولِكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏. ‏ قَالَ ‏”‏ لاَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ ‏” ‏‏.‏” Narrated Al-Bara bin `Azib: Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said to me, “When you want to go to bed, perform ablution as you do for prayer, then lie down on your right side and say: ‘Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fawwadtu ‘amri ilaika wa alja’tu dhahri ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika, la malja’a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabik al-ladhi anzalta wa binabiyyika al-ladhi arsalta’. If you should die then (after reciting this) you will die on the religion of Islam (i.e., as a Muslim); so let these words be the last you say (before going to bed)” While I was memorizing it, I said, “Wa birasulika al-ladhi arsalta (in Your Apostle whom You have sent).’ Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “No, but say: Wa binabiyyika al-ladhi arsalta (in Your Prophet whom You have sent). Sahih al-Bukhari 6311 In-book : Book 80, Hadith 8 USC-MSA web (English) : Vol. 8, Book 75, Hadith 323 (deprecated) Get Hadith Collection (All in one) App:https://goo.gl/8j06i9

x: ‎ SIX STRANGERS in SIX SITUATIONS… ‎The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلام said, ‎“Six things are strangers in 6 situations; ‎1- The masjid is a stranger amongst the people who do not pray ‎2- The Qur’an is a stranger in a household where it is not read ‎3- The memorised Qur’an is a stranger in the heart of an Fasiq 4- A righteous Muslim woman is a stranger in the hands of an oppressive husband of bad character; 5- A pious Muslim man is a stranger in the hands of an evil wife of bad character; 6- A scholar is a stranger amongst a group of people who they do not listen to ” Then he said, “Verily Allah the Exalted will not look at them on The Day of Judgement in a merciful manner.” -Ibn Hajr Asqalani,‘Preparing For The Day Of Judgement’,Ch 5:”,Qt.(1)

Bangla আর মূসা বেছে নিলেন নিজের সম্প্রদায় থেকে সত্তর জন লোক আমার প্রতিশ্রুত সময়ের জন্য। তারপর যখন তাদেরকে ভূমিকম্প পাকড়াও করল, তখন বললেন, হে আমার রব, তুমি যদি ইচ্ছা করতে, তবে তাদেরকে আগেই ধ্বংস করে দিতে এবং আমাকেও। আমাদেরকে কি সে কর্মের কারণে ধ্বংস করছ, যা আমার সম্প্রদায়ের নির্বোধ লোকেরা করেছে? এসবই তোমার পরীক্ষা; তুমি যাকে ইচ্ছা এতে পথ ভ্রষ্ট করবে এবং যাকে ইচ্ছা সরলপথে রাখবে। তুমি যে আমাদের রক্ষক-সুতরাং আমাদেরকে ক্ষমা করে দাও এবং আমাদের উপর করুনা কর। তাছাড়া তুমিই তো সর্বাধিক ক্ষমাকারী।

t: O Muslim, which news you spend your time on?
e: ﷽ THE OBLIGATION OF BEING AWARE OF CURRENT AFFAIRS OF MUSLIMS Sheikh Muhammad Nasir-ud-Din al-Albani on the obligation of being aware of current affairs of Muslims. He stated in his fatawa which was recorded in the al Is
x: ﷽ THE OBLIGATION OF BEING AWARE OF CURRENT AFFAIRS OF MUSLIMS Sheikh Muhammad Nasir-ud-Din al-Albani on the obligation of being aware of current affairs of Muslims. He stated in his fatawa which was recorded in the al Islaah magazine issue 18:- “As for obtaining the news to be aware of the state of affairs and the weakness the Muslims are in, and in order to avoid this outcome, then as we say, this is from the tasfiyah (purification) and the tarbiyah (educating) – purifying Islaam from what has entered into it and focusing on educating the Muslims and bringing them up on this purified Islam. So knowing these general circumstances, which encompass the Muslims, is a must for the matter is as the old Arab poet has stated, taking his meaning from an authentic hadeeth: “I learned evil not for the sake of evil, but to avoid it And whoever doesn’t know good from evil, he will fall into it.” This is derived from a hadeeth – and I mean by it, the hadeeth of Hudhaifah Ibn Al-Yamaan, radyAllaahu ‘anhumaa, which is reported in the Saheehs of Al-Bukhaaree and Muslim. He, radyAllaahu ‘anhumaa, said: “The people used to ask Allaah’s Messenger, sallAllaahu ‘alayhi wa sallam, about the good, but I used to ask him about the evil for fear of it reaching me.” So being aware of what the Muslims are upon from humiliation and weakness in order to turn them away from that towards using the means of knowledge, strength and power, this is an obligation from the many obligations…” Source: https://www.doamuslims.org/sheikh-albani-the-obligation-of-being-aware-of-current-affairs-of-muslims/

t: O Muslims, Have you ever wondered what are those 72 sheds of RIBA?
e: Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said: “A dirham which a man consumes as riba knowingly is worse before Allaah than thirty-six acts of zina.” Narrated by Ahmad and al-Tabaraani; classed as saheeh by al-Albaani in
x: Rasulullah Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said: “A dirham which a man consumes as riba knowingly is worse before Allaah than thirty-six acts of zina.” Narrated by Ahmad and al-Tabaraani; classed as saheeh by al-Albaani in Saheeh al-Jaami’, no. 3375. And he, Salla Allahu Alaihi Wa Sallam also said: “There are seventy-two types of riba, the least of which is like a man committing incest with his mother.” Narrated by al-Tabaraani in al-Awsat; classed as saheeh by al-Albaani in Saheeh al-Jaami’, no. 3537. The scholars are unanimously agreed that every loan involving interest or any kind of benefit is haraam. Ibn Qudaamah Rahimullah said: “ Every loan in which it is stipulated that an additional payment be made is haraam, with no scholarly dispute.” Ibn al-Mundhir said: “They are unanimously agreed that if the lender stipulates that the borrower must pay extra or give a gift, and he gives the loan on this basis, this is riba.” It was narrated from Ubayy ibn Ka’b, Ibn ‘Abbaas and Ibn Mas’ood that they forbade loans that lead to any kind of benefit (extra payment, gifts, etc). Al-Mughni, 6/436.

e: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ رَءُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ And of the people is he who SELLS himself, seeking means to PLEASE Allah. And Allah is kind to [His] servants. Bangla আর
x: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ رَءُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ And of the people is he who SELLS himself, seeking means to PLEASE Allah. And Allah is kind to [His] servants. Bangla আর মানুষের মাঝে এক শ্রেণীর লোক রয়েছে যারা আল্লাহর সন্তুষ্টিকল্পে নিজেদের জানের বাজি রাখে। আল্লাহ হলেন তাঁর বান্দাদের প্রতি অত্যন্ত মেহেরবান। ———- :|: My Deen Study :|: :|: Quran Study – One Ayah a Day :|: :|: Quran for Critical Reasoning :|: :|: Know the Misguidance – Know the Misinterpretation of Deen :|: :|: Know the Misguidance – Know The Astray Scholars :|: The Ayah 2:207 And of the people is he who sells himself, seeking means to the approval of Allah. And Allah is kind to [His] servants. Bangla আর মানুষের মাঝে এক শ্রেণীর লোক রয়েছে যারা আল্লাহর সন্তুষ্টিকল্পে নিজেদের জানের বাজি রাখে। আল্লাহ হলেন তাঁর বান্দাদের প্রতি অত্যন্ত মেহেরবান। Critical Reasoning – Intermediate Level: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! SubhanAllah! What’s the main issue here? Pleasing Allah (مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ) How do they please Allah? يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ “He who SELL his Nafs, his life.” In other words, he who do a business with his RABB. How does one SELLS his Nafs? He who overcomes his Nafs, he who throughs away his Nafs. The one who leaves his desire, his comfort! The one who gives his life, his wealth! For the sake of Allah! Is throughing your Nafs is a easy job? Is it a regular person’s Job? Can you do it in a regular mind? Or do you have to be very extremely conscious about Allah? Can a regular Ebadh of Allah be able to do it? One has to go beyond his regular scope, isn’t it? And that’s where the love comes! You command people to do something, you are pleased if they do it. But among those who do you like most? You like someone who goes extra steps to please you! And then, when someone goes extreme level of his ability, that’s when you love him! It’s a Simple Math! Allah Subhanahu loves you going Extreme! And Allah knows best! May Allah make us among those who obey him to their extreme level and attain his love. Ameen.

They said: “Shall we not bring water for Wudu’?” He said: “I have only been commanded to perform Wudu’ when I want to pray.” أَخْبَرَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنَ الْخَلاَءِ فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ فَقَالُوا أَلاَ نَأْتِيكَ بِوَضُوءٍ فَقَالَ ‏ “‏ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ بِالْوُضُوءِ إِذَا قُمْتُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ সহীহ, তিরমিযী হাঃ ১৮২৪, মুসলিম (ইসলামিক সেন্টার) হাঃ ৭২৬, ৭২৭। Hadith أَخْبَرَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنَ الْخَلاَءِ فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ فَقَالُوا أَلاَ نَأْتِيكَ بِوَضُوءٍ فَقَالَ ‏ ‏ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ بِالْوُضُوءِ إِذَا قُمْتُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ ‏” ‏ ‏‏ It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out from the toilet and food was brought to him. They said: “Shall we not bring water for Wudu’?” He said: “I have only been commanded to perform Wudu’ when I want to pray.” Sahih (Darussalam) Sunan an-Nasa’i English : Vol. 1, Book 1, Hadith 132 Arabic : Book 1, Hadith 133 Get Hadith Collection (All in one) App:https://goo.gl/8j06i9
