t: Abu Dawud 4832: DO NOT LET anyone eat your FOOD EXCEPT a MUTTAQI (Allah-Fearing/ Conscious) Muslim.
x: Narrated Abu Sa’id al-Khudri: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Do not ASSOCIATE except with a believer, and do not let anyone eat your food except a Allah-fearing person حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ غَيْلاَنَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَوْ عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ “‏ لاَ تُصَاحِبْ إِلاَّ مُؤْمِنًا وَلاَ يَأْكُلْ طَعَامَكَ إِلاَّ تَقِيٌّ ‏” ‏ ‏.‏ Grade : Hasan (Al-Albani) حسن (الألباني) حكم : Reference : Sunan Abi Dawud 4832 In-book reference : Book 43, Hadith 60 English translation : Book 42, Hadith 4814 Critical Reasoning (Subjective and objective): How many issues/subjects are here? Two. What are these? 1.) Guidelines for social friendship or association and 2.) Guidelines about the food (Rizk) or social invitation What type of statement is it? It is a prohibition. What does a prohibition mean? It is regarded as Haram. Can you then befriend a kafir? No! It would be haram How do you know a person is Allah-fearing or not? Very easy. You have known him for some time that he has been involved in Haram things, and you remind him about the haram with wisdom and still you find him does not change or comes out from the Haram by using different logic which clearly shows that he does not have fear of Allah, he knows only that “Allah will forgive” but he continues in Haram. Can you then invite such a person into your home who is not a Muslim or a so-called ‘Muslim’ (by birth) who does not follow or obey Allah or engage in Haram, shirk or in Bida’a? (as logically, a Muslim who fears Allah can’t do those things) No! It would be clear Haram. Then, is it Haram to invite such people to your functions and ceremonies? Yes, clearly. Because who do you invite to those functions? Your friends and associates, and it is Haram to be friends with those people in the first place; therefore, inviting them to eat your food makes it a double act of Haram! Is it possible that Allah gives you barakah in your Rizk when you use your RIZK in a Haram way? I don’t think so! Does it mean that you don’t give charity to such people? No, that’s a different issue. That does not have a relation with that. Does it also mean that you don’t give the proper rights to your neighbours who is not Muslims? No, that’s again a different issue. You just can’t befriend such neighbours, but then be very careful about their rights as neighbours. And Allah knows best. Do you have any sharia’ guideline about this? Yes, here it is . Read carefully when you have time and intention, so that you really do not involve yourself in Haram. And Allah knows best. May Allah make us firm in following HIS Deen strictly. Ameen.

t: 2:208 If you are not OBEYING Allah COMPLETELY, you are also obeying shaitan
e: The Ayah 2:208 “O you who have believed, enter into Islam completely [and perfectly] and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.” Bangla “হে ঈমানদার গন! তোমরা পরিপূর্ণভাবে ইসলামের অন্তর্
x: The Ayah 2:208 “O you who have believed, enter into Islam completely [and perfectly] and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.” Bangla “হে ঈমানদার গন! তোমরা পরিপূর্ণভাবে ইসলামের অন্তর্ভুক্ত হয়ে যাও এবং শয়তানের পদাংক অনুসরণ কর না। নিশ্চিত রূপে সে তোমাদের প্রকাশ্য শত্রু।” Critical Reasoning: Does this sound like Allah talking 2 different things here? Enter into Islam COMPLETELY and Do not follow shaitan’s footstep. Of course, it is two different things. One is an instruction to do and one is prohibition not to do. That’s the first thing to understand from this. But then, why Allah Subhanahu put this together? Does it sound more like they have a close link to each other? Of course, they do. If you use your brain to just give it a little thought you will see just one strong relation between the two, which is, If you do not obey Allah completely, you will definitely also follow shaitan. This is the certain info, certain knowledge for you O Muslim, from the one who made you. What is complete Islam? It is what encompasses all guidelines, laws, instructions, prohibitions, limits for all aspects of life. If you leave something from there would it be a complete Islam? No, if there is not complete Islam, the missing part is taken and filled by the way of shaitan. Now apply it to all those instructions and limits and prohibitions of Allah that you are not following and then you can see who you follow, none other but shaitan. What is a big chunk of Islam that the entire Ummah has abandoned? Khilafah, Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi rajiun And then what is the next best chunk of that complete Islam that Ummah abandoned and made almost Haram to pronounce and define it intentionally wrongly? Jihad. Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi rajiun Therefore, what is the path the Muslims heading towards? The path of shaitan. And where the path of shaitan leads to? Jahannam. So, how does that manifested in the open eyes even to a school kid? They are obeying and following the representative of shaitan, the Taghut, the United Nations, the head of the Taghut and the Taghut of their respective countries. Taghut gives them law of everything and they are following it. May Allah guide Muslim fully in the path of Allah subhanahu, Ameen.

t: 2:264 Al-Baqarah. Do you REMIND people that you GAVE them charity?

t: Quran Memorizing and UNDERSTANDING habit for life for the BUSIEST people.
e: Quran Memorizing program for life for the most busiest Muslim on the face of the earth. Just 1 (ONE) MINUTE after each Salah!
x: Quran Memorizing program for life for the most busiest Muslim on the face of the earth. Just 1 (ONE) MINUTE after each Salah! When: After each Fard salah. How much to memorize : ONE AYAH only. —————————————————————————————————————————————– ( By doing this you also implement the hadith* from Saheeh Muslim 803 (or Book 6, Hadith 301 ) Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi WaSallam asked his companion, “Which of you would like to go out every morning to Buthan or al-‘Aqiq and bring two large she-camels without being guilty of sin or without severing the ties of kinship?” We said: Yeah Rasulullah, we would like to do it. Upon this he said: “Does not one of you go out in the morning to the masjid and teach or recite two verses from the Book of Allah. the Majestic and Glorious? That is better for him than two she-camels, and three verses are better (than three she-camels). and four verses are better for him than four (she-camels), and to on their number in camels.” (Note that for our time, a ‘Red She-Camel’ could be equivalent to a ‘Mercede Benz Car’) —————————————————————————————————————————————– Time Required: ONE MINUTE. (After finishing tasbeah). Force yourself out after one minute so that you would able to do it continuously. The reason is psychological. If you spend 5 minutes in one time and you really seriously would want to do 5 minutes every time, in reality you won’t do it because you won’t be able to give five minutes time for this after every Salat. Therefore, your wishful mind will suggest you with the association of shaitan that “I don’t have 5 minutes for now, better will do it at next Salat”, thus you won’t do even for 1 minute. And then once you skip doing it sometime, the habit of not doing it will increase and finally you will do it only whenever you can make special time for it. And thus the ‘regular’ pattern or habit will be lost. And that habit won’t stay in one place, slowly it will take your mind away from memorizing or understanding Quran. That’s how shaitan works with our mind and desire and we give it a term ‘psychological’ but actually and in reality it is from shaitan. Therefore, stick only with ONE MINUTE and BE FIRM in doing that. Resources: Standard memorizing Mushaf or this Mobile App (Al Quran (Tafsir & by Word) by Green Tech (You can use this app to understand word per word meaning with their roots as well as different forms of the word with their meaning and application of meaning of same word in other Ayat in the entire Quran, amazing!) This method is specially for those who really want to increase understanding of Quran. All these you can do in ONE MINUTE and you will be amazed by the progress even in 3 months InShaaAllah ONLY if you do it regularly. Even if sometimes one Ayah takes 5 times X 7 days, don’t worry, keep practicing. If you want to do more, take another memorization program but don’t mess with this one, let it be your habit for entire life. How to keep in memory? Recite the memorized Ayat several times in the Salat during that day. You can recite few Ayat several times as long as you want. May Allah Ajja Wajal increase us in the knowledge of Quran and make us fully submitting Muslim. Ameen.

t: 9:113 Mumin has the KNOWLEDGE that the MUSHRIKEEN are for FIRE (O ‘Muslims’ in Kuffar’s Mindset, NOTE it)
e: At-Taubah 9:113
x: At-Taubah 9:113 مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن يَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا أُولِي قُرْبَىٰ مِن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ Sahih International It is not for the Prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of Hellfire. Muhsin Khan It is not (proper) for the Prophet and those who believe to ask Allah’s Forgiveness for the Mushrikun (polytheists, idolaters, pagans, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah) even though they be of kin, after it has become clear to them that they are the dwellers of the Fire (because they died in a state of disbelief). Bangla বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন নবী ও মুমিনদের জন্য উচিত নয় যে, তারা মুশরিকদের জন্য ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করবে। যদিও তারা আত্মীয় হয়। তাদের নিকট এটা স্পষ্ট হয়ে যাওয়ার পর যে, নিশ্চয় তারা প্রজ্বলিত আগুনের অধিবাসী। ডঃ মুজিবুর রহমান নাবী ও অন্যান্য মু’মিনদের জন্য জায়েয নয় যে, তারা মুশরিকদের জন্য ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করে, যদিও তারা আত্মীয়ই হোক না কেন, এ কথা প্রকাশ হবার পর যে, তারা জাহান্নামের অধিবাসী। মুহিউদ্দীন খান নবী ও মুমিনের উচিত নয় মুশরেকদের মাগফেরাত কামনা করে, যদিও তারা আত্নীয় হোক একথা সুস্পষ্ট হওয়ার পর যে তারা দোযখী। My Comments and Understanding: I will mention three issues here InShaaAllah. 1. Defining Mushrik SubhanAllah, Allah testifies that the Mumin has clear knowledge about the fate of the Mushrikeen. Now, who are the Mushrikin? (A) All kafirs, take any religion (Judaism, Christianity, Hinduism, Zorostian etc.), each of them worships something alongside the ‘God’ they believe in. So, they are Mushrikeen even though they believe in a Creator, or a ‘God’. (B) The ones who say, they don’t have a ‘God’ but only follow the guidance of the man (Buddha, in Buddhism), many of them actually worship that man as ‘God’ and pray to that man (talk to any ordinary Buddhist and you will know this). (C) Then the ones who say, we don’t take Buddha as ‘God’ we only follow his guidance, they are also clear Kuffar and Mushrikeen once they know, understand and then reject Allah, who is the only Guidance for mankind. Whoever takes any other guidance other than Allah, he is a Kafir and a Mushrik because GUIDANCE belongs to Allah ONLY. (D) The ones who say they do not have a religion (atheists and agnostics), do the same. They do not believe in a ‘God’, in their terms, but they take their DESIRE as their ‘God’ , They take their IDEAS and PHILOSOPHIES as their ‘God’ (Click the link to know that Allah says that there are people who take their desire as their ‘God’). 2. ‘Muslims in Kuffar’s Mind-Set’ There are many Muslims today who have a mindset of the Kuffar’s. They say, “You cannot say who is going to the fire, you don’t know. Allah is the Judge.” Even the prominent scholars, I heard, say the same thing “you cannot judge”. I know that you would say, “They are saying this about the living ones.” No, my brother, ask one of those ‘Muslims in Kuffar’s Mind-Set’ what is the fate of Nelson Mandela and listen to their answer. They have the mindset of the Christians, the Zalimun, the liars who lied about Allah the Most Merciful, and the foolish ones who believed it, saying that He has a son, (which also implies that He has a wife, a family, and therefore has a father too) Aujubillah. Those Muslims got this philosophy from these Zalimun. But now you know who Allah was talking about. The Kuffar, the Mushrikeen who died rejecting Allah, worshipping others besides Allah and never said “La Ilaha Illa Allah”. Allah said they are for the fire and Allah confirms that Mu’min KNOWS it. The Mu’min has CERTAIN KNOWLEDGE of it. But I was not there with the Kafir or the Mushrik to know what happened before death came to him. There could be few who knew that Islam is the truth but never proclaimed it out of fear of people, society or authority or for any other reason. Therefore, I would never know their fate. So whenever I pass by a graveyard of Christians, I feel pain and think to myself that there could be someone lying there who was Muslim inside. If you dig into the history and read mindfully, you will actually find several cases like this among the Christian scholars. But even with such cases, for a Mu’min saying he is in fire doesn’t make him (the Mu’min) a sinner, because we judge by what is apparent, we don’t know the heart of the people, we don’t judge by what is not apparent. Therefore, I can say FIRMLY after knowing this Ayah that those who died in Kufr (as per my knowledge), rejecting Allah, worshipping others besides Allah and never said “La Ilaha Illa Allah”, they are for the fire. And Allah knows best. 3. The poor condition of Bangla translation: See the poor condition of Bangla translations of Dr. Mujibur Rahman and Muhiuddin Khan. Would any reader reading only one of these translations get the understanding, the importance of this knowledge for Muslims that Allah CONFIRMS that the Mu’min has CERTAIN knowledge of those who are for the fire? If they don’t understand this then what will happen? They will continuously be indoctrinated by the Christian philosophy of “You cannot judge”. Think of it! Understanding just one Ayah can change the Muslims from the mindset of the Kuffar to the mindset of Allah’s knowledge, which is the proper knowledge of the Deen. But they did not realise the importance of it. Probably because they never knew the mindset of those Muslims in these modern times. But if you were to talk to the Muslims around you today, you might find more than 99% of them today are in the mindset of the Kuffar’s in many aspects. 4. A warning from your Brother: We are living in a time now, where our lifestyles are no different than those of the Kuffar’s, our mindset is no different than that of the Kuffar’s. Therefore, only reading a translation of the Quran and reading a Tafsir might not save you from the mindset of the Kuffar’s neither save you from Jahannam, (May Allah save us from Jahannam). Most of the Tafsir you read has written more than 50 years before and the world is different now. The Shirk in those times and now has changed in many folds, many aspects and many avenues. Now Shirk is in our ‘Words of Mouth’, Shirk is in our daily activities, in the actions and ‘Act of Limbs’, Shirk is in our mindset. Most of the Muslims do Islam today as a rituals only. Therefore, you must, therefore, contemplate on each Ayah yourself first. If you want to get to know what are those Shirk that we are living with today, then read and follow this blog “Is Allah not your Rabb?” And please my brothers do not get me wrong here. What I am emphasing is that YOU need to contemplate on Quran YOURSELF first so that you will develop the habit of Critical Reasoning and only then you read Tafsir and explanations from other resources and when you will find that your understanding goes with the scholars, you will see how that boost your confidence and knowledge about deen InShaaAllah. But in case you thought something wild, immediately turn to Tafsirs and scholars, ask them, discuss with them. And Allah knows best. May Allah make us steadfast in Deen and May Allah Tabaraka Ta’ala give us proper understand of our Deen and May Allah save us from the Kuffar’s mindset. Ameen.

(A) All kafirs, take any religion (Judaism, Christianity, Hinduism, Zorostian etc.), each of them worships something alongside the ‘God’ they believe in. So, they are Mushrikin even though they believe in a Creator, or a ‘God’. (B) The ones who say, they don’t have a ‘God’ but only follow the guidance of the man (Buddha, in Buddhism), many of them actually worship that man and pray to that man (talk to any ordinary Buddhist and you will know this). (C) Then, the ones who say, we don’t take Buddha as ‘God’ we only follow his guidance, they are also clear Kafirun and Mushrikun once they know, understand, and then reject Allah, who is the only Guidance for mankind. Whoever takes any other guidance other than Allah, he is a Kafir and a Mushrik because GUIDANCE belongs to Allah ONLY. (D) The ones who say they do not have a religion (atheists and agnostics), do the same. They do not believe in a ‘God’, in their terms, but they take their DESIRE as their ‘God’ , They take their IDEAS and PHILOSOPHIES as their ‘God’ (Click the link to know that Allah says that there are people who take their desire as their ‘God’) so these atheists and agnostics are those people who say they don’t have a religion. 2. ‘Muslims in Kuffar’s Mind-Set’ There are many Muslims today who have a mindset of that of the Kuffar. They say, “You cannot say who is going to the fire, you don’t know. Allah is the Judge.” Even the prominent scholars, I heard, say the same thing “you cannot judge”. I know that you would say, “They are saying this about the living ones.” No, my brother, ask one of those ‘Muslims in Kuffar Mind-Set’ what is the fate of Nelson Mandela and listen to their answer. They have the mindset of the Christians, the Zalimun, the liars who lied about Allah the Most Merciful, and the foolish ones who believed it, saying that He has a son, (which also implies that He has a wife, a family, and therefore has a father too) Aujubillah. Those Muslims got this philosophy from these Zalimun. But now you know who Allah was talking about. The Kafir, the Mushrik who died rejecting Allah, worshipping others besides Allah and never said “La Ilaha Illa Allah”. Allah said they are for the fire and Allah confirms that Mu’min KNOWS it. The Mu’min has CERTAIN KNOWLEDGE of it. But I was not there with the Kafir’s, or the Mushrik to know what happened before death came to them. There could be a few who knew that Islam is the truth but never proclaimed it out of fear of people, society or authority or for any other reason. Therefore, I would never know their fate. So whenever I pass by a graveyard of Christians, I feel pain and think to myself that there could be someone lying there who was a Muslim inside. If you dig into the history and read mindfully, you will actually find many cases like this. But I can say FIRMLY after knowing this Ayah that those who died in Kufr, rejecting Allah or as a Mushrik, worshipping others besides Allah and never said “La Ilaha Illa Allah”, they are for the fire. And Allah knows best. 3. The poor condition of Bangla translation: See the poor condition of Bangla translations of Dr. Mujibur Rahman and Muhiuddin Khan. Would any reader reading only one of these translations get the understanding, the importance of this knowledge for Muslims that Allah CONFIRMS that the Mu’min has CERTAIN knowledge of those who are for the fire? If they don’t understand this then what will happen? They will continuously be indoctrinated by the Christian philosophy of “You cannot judge”. Just think of it, understanding just one Ayah can change the Muslims from the mindset of the Kuffar to the mindset of Islam, which is the proper knowledge of the Deen. But they did not realise the importance of it. Probably because they never knew the mindset of those Muslims in these modern times. But if you were to talk to the Muslims around you today, I can assure you that more than 95% of them today are in the mindset of the Kuffar’s in many aspects. 4. A MUST Tool for a Muslim is to know Arabic The Bangla translations of this Ayah proofs the point why a non-Arabic speaking Muslim must know Arabic. This is a must tool to navigate in this time and era. Period. A warning from your Brother: We are living in a time now, where our lifestyles are no different than that of the Kuffar’s. Therefore, only reading a translation of the Quran and reading a tafsir written before this time, when the Kuffar set became the authority of the world, might not save you from the mindset of the Kuffar’s neither save you from Jahannam, (May Allah save us from Jahannam). Most of the Tafsir you reading has written more than 50 years before and the world is different now. The Shirk in those times and now has changed in many folds, many aspects and many avenues. Now Shirk is in our words of mouth, Shirk is in our daily activities, Shirk is in our mindset. Most of the Muslims do Islam today as a rituals only. Therefore, you must, therefore, contemplate on each Ayah yourself first. If you want to get to know what are those Shirk that we are living in today, then read and follow this blog “Is Allah not your Rabb?” And please my brothers do not get me wrong here. What I am emphasizing is that YOU need to contemplate on Quran YOURSELF first so that you will develop the habit of critical reasoning and only then you read Tafsir and explanations from other resources and when you will find that your understanding goes with the scholars, you will see how that boost your confidence and knowledge about Deen InShaaAllah. But in case you thought something wild, immediately turn to tafsirs and scholars, ask them, discuss with them. And Allah knows best. May Allah make us steadfast in Deen and May Allah save us from the Kuffar’s mindset. Ameen.

x: 2:21 يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ Sahih International O mankind, worship your RABB, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous – মুহিউদ্দীন খান হে মানব সমাজ! তোমরা তোমাদের পালনকর্তার এবাদত কর, যিনি তোমাদিগকে এবং তোমাদের পূর্ববর্তীদিগকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন। তাতে আশা করা যায়, তোমরা পরহেযগারী অর্জন করতে পারবে। My Comments and Understanding: That’s what I call ‘Muslims in kuffar’s mind-set’ . What I mean by that? Well, you can easily check about yourself, are you the one with kuffar mind-set or not! How you test yourself? O Muslim, see, who you call a righteous person? A kafir? Can a kafir be ever a righteous even though he is a humanitarian person? What does the creator of men say? A person becomes righteous ONLY through worshipping the creator! SubhanAllah! Then can you call a disobedient Muslim a righteous person? Who doesn’t pray Salat, nor he follows Allah’s law or systems, whatever good he does for the society, can you call him a righteous person? What is the criteria to become a righteous person? One has to worship his creator! That’s the starting point! So, where you get the idea of assessing a person’s righteousness? Is it because he is so generous and most humanitarian? Does it have any value to Allah if he does not worship his creator? O Muslims, correct your mind-set of kuffar’s. See the world, assess the world through what your creator says, not what the kuffar teach you. The values, ethics, morality, humanity that you know set for you by the kuffar’s education system that you nourished with and that happened because you took the Quran as a thing only to read without understanding it and that you took Ulemas as your gateway to Jannah who even prevent you or discourage you to read and contemplate and understand Quran yourself.

t: Quran 9:31 – At-Tawbah. O ‘Muslims’, Do you know when you take ‘ULAMA’ as your RABB besides Allah?
e: 9:31 اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَانَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا ۖ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ Sah
x: 9:31 اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَانَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا ۖ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ Sahih International They have taken their scholars and monks as RABB besides Allah , and [also] the Messiah, the son of Mary. And they were not commanded except to worship one God; there is no deity except Him. Exalted is He above whatever they associate with Him. Bangla তারা তাদের পন্ডিত ও সংসার-বিরাগীদিগকে তাদের পালনকর্তারূপে গ্রহণ করেছে আল্লাহ ব্যতীত এবং মরিয়মের পুত্রকেও। অথচ তারা আদিষ্ট ছিল একমাত্র মাবুদের এবাদতের জন্য। তিনি ছাড়া কোন মাবুদ নেই, তারা তাঁর শরীক সাব্যস্ত করে, তার থেকে তিনি পবিত্র। Tafsir Ibne Kathir on this Ayah: Imam Ahmad, At-Tirmidhi and Ibn Jarir At-Tabari recorded a Hadith via several chains of narration, from Adi bin Hatim , may Allah be pleased with him, who became Christian during the time of Jahiliyyah. ………………….. Adi, who was one of the chiefs of his people (the tribe of Tai’) and whose father, Hatim At-Ta’i , was known for his generosity, went to Al-Madinah. When the people announced his arrival, Adi went to the Messenger of Allah wearing a silver cross around his neck. The Messenger of Allah recited this Ayah; Adi commented, “I said, `They did not worship them.” The Prophet said, “Yes they did. They (rabbis and monks) prohibited the allowed for them (Christians and Jews) and allowed the prohibited, and they obeyed them. This is how they worshipped them.” The Hadith: ‘Adi ibn Hatim reported: I came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, while I had a crucifix of gold around my neck . The Prophet said, “O ‘Adi! Remove this idol from yourself!” I heard him reciting the verse in Surat al-Tawbah, “ They have taken their priests and rabbis as Lords besides Allah. ” (9:31) The Prophet said, “ As for them, they did not worship them, but rather when they made something lawful for them, they considered it lawful. When they made something unlawful for them, they considered it unlawful. ” Source: Sunan al-Tirmidhī 3095 Grade: Hasan (fair) according to Al-Albani عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَفِي عُنُقِي صَلِيبٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَقَالَ يَا عَدِيُّ اطْرَحْ عَنْكَ هَذَا الْوَثَنَ وَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ فِي سُورَةِ بَرَاءَةٌ اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَانَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالَ أَمَا إِنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَعْبُدُونَهُمْ وَلَكِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا أَحَلُّوا لَهُمْ شَيْئًا اسْتَحَلُّوهُ وَإِذَا حَرَّمُوا عَلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا حَرَّمُوهُ 3095 سنن الترمذي كتاب تفسير القرآن باب ومن سورة التوبة 3095 المحدث الألباني خلاصة حكم المحدث حسن في صحيح الترمذ My Reflections: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! O Muslims, now look at your situation today. See where you stand. See how did you take your respective Ulema as your Rabb too. (whoever is applicable to)Notice how you are living in Shirk though you are praying Salah, Tahajjud, observing Syiam, doing Hajj, giving Sadaqah and whatnot. How do you have a house loan? Your ‘Ulema’ made it Halal for you by the name of ‘Islamic Finance’. If you dig the matter you will see, the process, calculations, etc what they follow is Islamic at your end (that’s how they deceive you) but the money they lend you comes from the loan they borrow from mainstream banks (whoever applicable), so indirectly they put you into the stream of Riba that Allah made Haram. Then look at the insurance that your ‘Ulema’ made Halal for you. They quote you many general statements from Quran and Hadith against specific Shirk of Insurance. If you are only taking the COMPULSORY insurance where the authority forces you while that also should shook you in fear of Allah, not feeling content and must always keep looking for a way out. (May Allah help us) But not the volunteer comprehensive insurance for your car at all. Engaging in Voting: Then, look at the greatest Shirk you doing by obeying your Ulema who give you fatwa of ‘engaging’ in voting and democrazy by the disguise of ‘preventing greater loss’ etc. You are actually engaging in double Shirk here. 1. By doing the actual Shirk of voting in which you endorse people who make laws against Allah’s laws 2. You are following Ulema’s fatwa on something which Allah made Haram but your Ulema made Halal. Allah’s punishment is Near: So, reconcile today my brother. If you really realise in your heart that Jahannam is truth then Save yourself from Jahannam. Allah forgives everything but not Shirk. You can stand before Allah with all the sins that can fill the earth but do not dare to have the slightest Shirk. Don’t make the Scholars as your Rabb: Don’t be reluctant or lazy my brother. shaitan is true, he wants to confirm son of Adam alaihi wa Sallam Jahannam. And think, who were the Jews and Christians? They were not a different species, they were Muslims of that time but then slowly they changed Allah’s systems and followed other ILAHA and make their priests as their Rabb. They were same human being like you do and they turned themselves from Muslim to ‘Jews’ and ‘Christians’, then what about you today? Aren’t you following your Ulema against Allah’s clear command of Halal and Haram? Who are you taking as your Rabb beside Allah subhanahu wa Ta’ala? Is Allah not your only Rabb? And Allah knows best. I call out to Allah to guide you and guide me and guide all Muslims and make us of those who struggled for their life only because they remain in Tawheed and did not take anything or anybody besides Allah as their RABB. Ameen.

t: Quran 33:21 Al-Ahzab. If you WISH to keep HOPES in Allah then (1) FOLLOW Rasulullah as a BEST EXAMPLE (2) Make ZIKR (remember) of Allah a LOT
x: Al-Ahzab 33:21 لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا Sahih International There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allah often. Bangla যারা আল্লাহ ও শেষ দিবসের আশা রাখে এবং আল্লাহকে অধিক স্মরণ করে, তাদের জন্যে রসূলুল্লাহর মধ্যে উত্তম নমুনা রয়েছে। My Comments and Understanding*: This is one of the scariest Ayah for me. It’s like saying, If you have hope in Allah better follow your Rasul Sallillahi Alahi WaSallam. It’s like a silent and mild way of saying ‘The plane is just flying without a pilot at the moment, but don’t worry, we are looking for a pilot and they are sending a pilot from ground’ How can I be a husband like Rasulullah? How can I control my anger more? How can I keep more silent? How can I do better in being careful criticizing others? How can I be more patience with others? Even an attempt is seem disastrous! I can do my personal Ebadah as much as I can, but by character and manner? La Ilaha Illa Allah! Yeah Allah, Yeah Rabb, help me, I want your help. Guide me, I need your guidance. Have mercy on me, I need your mercy. Ameen.

t: Quran 15:22 – Al-Hijr. Allah CAUSES rain (not NATURE! O Muslims, SHIRK is in your MIND-SET and KUFR is in your ‘Words of Mouth’)
x: 15:22 وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ Muhsin Khan And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then caused the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We gave it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like]. Bangla Translations: বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন ডঃ মুজিবুর রহমান মুহিউদ্দীন খান আর আমি বায়ুকে ঊর্বরকারীরূপে প্রেরণ করি অতঃপর আসমান থেকে বৃষ্টি বর্ষণ করি এবং তা তোমাদের পান করাই। তবে তোমরা তার সংরক্ষণকারী নও। আমি বৃষ্টিগর্ভ বায়ু প্রেরণ করি, অতঃপর আকাশ হতে বৃষ্টি বর্ষণ করি এবং তা তোমাদেরকে পান করতে দিই; ওর ভান্ডার তোমাদের কাছে নেই। আমি বৃষ্টিগর্ভ বায়ু পরিচালনা করি অতঃপর আকাশ থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করি, এরপর তোমাদেরকে তা পান করাই। বস্তুতঃ তোমাদের কাছে এর ভান্ডার নেই। The Ayah 15:22 Muhsin Khan And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then caused the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We gave it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like]. Bangla Translations: বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন আর আমি বায়ুকে ঊর্বরকারীরূপে প্রেরণ করি অতঃপর আসমান থেকে বৃষ্টি বর্ষণ করি এবং তা তোমাদের পান করাই। তবে তোমরা তার সংরক্ষণকারী নও। The Kufr of the Kuffar is understandable: Clearly Allah says that He is the one who causes rain. But science gives explanations on how and in what process the rain or the weather develops. Therefore, they give credit to nature itself. That’s understandable as they are the people who do not believe in a creator. Then there are people who believe in a creator, who worship the creator along with other Ilaha (‘God’) and they also give credit to nature itself for causing the weather, that’s also understandable as they don’t have the proper and certain knowledge of their Creator. But the KUFR of ‘Muslims’? a Disaster! But then there are people who call themselves Muslim, they have certain knowledge from their creator, Allah, from their book, Quran, as to how He causes rain to come down. But unfortunately, they are taught the same, to credit the nature like those of atheists and the Kuffar. Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Rajeun. The ORIGIN of Secularism: The science books in the school curriculum in the ‘Muslim’ countries teach the same explanations that are taught in a country of the Kuffar, with no difference. Inna lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Rajiun. Therefore, Muslim children study in a ‘Muslim’ school raised up with the mindset of the Kuffar knowing that nature is responsible for rain and weather, Allah has nothing to do with it. They don’t know that it is, Allah, the nourisher, the sustainer, who gives rizk (rain). And yes, a proper Muslim family though teach their children about Allah, Ar-Razzak, the provider of rain but that merely remain as bookish learning and merely a belief in their heart but when the same kids are sent to school and get a practical explanation of the cause of the rain without mentioning Allah’s name anywhere, rather they are taught in a way that science itself is the cause of the rain, that’s when the seed of secularism planted in the mind of the Muslims children. ‘Muslims’ in Kuffar’s Mindset’ And you see the result in the last 2/3 generations today. Even a Muslim scholar describes these phenomena of weather as ‘Natural causes’ and the calamity allowed by Allah as ‘Natural Disaster’. That’s how the Kuffar were successfully taken Muslims out of Islam through their school system. Even a ‘Shiekh’ of today coming out from the ‘Islamic’ university studying ‘Islamic Shariah’ for 10 years but in their ‘Words of Mouth’ they utter the word of Shirk and Kufr. And the Misguided ones: And we have Islamic parties in all those ‘Muslim’ countries who give their life to establish the Law of Allah by engaging in democracy (Inna lillahi wa Inna ilaihi rajiun) but they do not have the knowledge as to how generations after generations of Muslims are raising their kids with the mindset of the Kuffar (secularism). There is no Tawheed. Shirk is in the blood of the ‘Muslim’ Ummah today! And the status with Allah is KUFR: And Allah, the owner of the day of judgment, says that most of the people believe in Allah but they also believe in other ILAHA too (Al-Quran 12:106). (This is what ‘Muslims’ have become today! And Allah, the owner of the day of judgement, says that most of the people believe in Allah but they also believe in other ILAHA too (12:106). (This is what Muslims have become today! Then Allah asked what’s the matter with you? why don’t you give credit to Allah for what He deserves? (71:13) And giving credit to somewhere else what Allah deserves is even a clear KUFR. (Sahih Al-Bukhari 1038) May Allah guide Muslims. Ameen. May Allah bring Muslims to Tawheed. Ameen. May Allah save the Muslims from shirk. Ameen. May Allah make Muslims not to meet Him on Qiyamah with shirk. Ameen.

t: 60:3 Al-Mumtaĥanah. PARENTS or CHILDREN won’t benefit you on the day of Qiyamah
x: Al-Mumtaĥanah 60:3 لَن تَنفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ ۚ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ Sahih International Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allah , of what you do, is Seeing. Related Hadith and commentary: Bangla: আয়াত নাম্বার বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন ডঃ মুজিবুর রহমান মুহিউদ্দীন খান 3 কিয়ামত দিবসে তোমাদের আত্নীয়তা ও সন্তান-সন্ততি তোমাদের কোন উপকার করতে পারবে না। তিনি তোমাদের মাঝে ফায়সালা করে দেবেন। তোমরা যা কর আল্লাহ তার সম্যক দ্রষ্টা। তোমাদের অত্মীয়-স্বজন ও সন্তান-সন্ততি কিয়ামাত দিবসে কোন কাজে আসবেনা। আল্লাহ তোমাদের মধ্যে ফাইসালা করে দিবেন; তোমরা যা কর তিনি তা দেখেন। তোমাদের স্বজন-পরিজন ও সন্তান-সন্ততি কিয়ামতের দিন কোন উপকারে আসবে না। তিনি তোমাদের মধ্যে ফয়সালা করবেন। তোমরা যা কর, আল্লাহ তা দেখেন।

t: Quran 34:21. Allah let shaitan OVERPOWER people to TESTS who is CERTAIN or in DOUBT in the hereafter
x: Saba’ 34:21 وَمَا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِالْآخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِي شَكٍّ ۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ Sahih International And he (shaitan, please read the previous Ayah) had over them no authority except [it was decreed] that We might make evident who believes in the Hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. And your Lord, over all things, is Guardian. Muhsin Khan And he (Iblis Satan) had no authority over them, except that We might test him, who believes in the Hereafter from him who is in doubt about it. And your Lord is a Hafiz over everything. (AllKnower of everything i.e. He keeps record of each and every person as regards deeds, and then He will reward them accordingly). Bangla তাদের উপর শয়তানের কোন ক্ষমতা ছিল না, তবে কে পরকালে বিশ্বাস করে এবং কে তাতে সন্দেহ করে, তা প্রকাশ করাই ছিল আমার উদ্দেশ্য। আপনার পালনকর্তা সব বিষয়ে তত্ত্বাবধায়ক। My Comment: O Muslims, half-hearted belief will no take you anywhere. So, if you have any doubt better you dig that now, be clear with yourself and stand on firm belief. I pray for you that Allah make you firm, ameen. And I pray for us that Allah, the ONLY GUIDE, make us more firm in following his deen. And you must ask Allah’s guidance for that. Please make this dua constantly. “O, Turner of the hearts, turn our hearts to Your obedience.”

t: 25:30 Al-Furqan. Rasulullah will COMPLAIN for abandoning QURAN
x: Al-Furqan 25:30 وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا Sahih International And the Messenger has said, “O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’an as [a thing] abandoned.” Muhsin Khan And the Messenger (Muhammad SAW) will say: “O my Rabb! t: Quran 13:12. Allah displays/ strikes the lightning, to CAUSE FEAR

This is in fact KUFR for not giving credit to Allah as He deserves. And that’s the impact of not letting people to read and contemplate on the Quran themselves. They kept many generations away from contemplating on the Quran. Allah knows best. May Allah guide Muslims, May Allah guide those Ulema! (whoever is applicable to)

t: 2:213 Al-Baqarah. All MANKIND was in only ONE ‘RELIGION’

And Allah guided those who believed to the truth concerning that over which they had differed, by His permission. And Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path.

t: Quran 13:11. Each person is PROTECTED by two Malaikah (Angels) at the front and the back.
x: Ar-Ra’d 13:11 لَهُ مُعَقِّبَاتٌ مِّن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوءًا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَالٍ Sahih International For each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allah . Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron. Bangla তাঁর পক্ষ থেকে অনুসরণকারী রয়েছে তাদের অগ্রে এবং পশ্চাতে, আল্লাহর নির্দেশে তারা ওদের হেফাযত করে। আল্লাহ কোন জাতির অবস্থা পরিবর্তন করেন না, যে পর্যন্ত না তারা তাদের নিজেদের অবস্থা পরিবর্তন করে। আল্লাহ যখন কোন জাতির উপর বিপদ চান, তখন তা রদ হওয়ার নয় এবং তিনি ব্যতীত তাদের কোন সাহায্যকারী নেই। My Comments and Understanding: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! I give importance to 2 Tafsir mostly. No. 1 is Tafsir Ibne Katheer because it is mostly about the statements from Hadith, rarely his own understanding or opinion. No. 2 Tafsir Ibne Abbas because he (Radi Allahu Anhu) is regarded as the one who understands the Quran the Most. So, the tafsir of this Ayah baffled me when I found the following statement about the act of those malaikah. SubhanAllah. I will InShaaAllah, dig into this statement more. If this statement is true, then it shows, SubhanAllah, how vulnerable Allah made people; they think they are doing things themselves, but it is actually according to their INTENTION that Allah drives them through these Malaikah (Angels). This statement to me is the most scarey statement about our destiny. Qadr. Tafsir Ibne Abbas: About the guarding malaikah (For him are angels ranged before him) He has angels who succeed one another: the angels of the night succeed the angels of the day and vice versa (and behind him who guard him by Allah’s command) “and who drive him to the things destined.”

t: 5:51. Whoever takes Jews and Christians as FRIENDS or PROTECTOR, he is ONE of THEM
x: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۘ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ Sahih International O you who have believed, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies. They are [in fact] allies of one another. And whoever is an ally to them among you – then indeed, he is [one] of them. Indeed, Allah guides not the wrongdoing people. Bangla হে মুমিণগণ! তোমরা ইহুদী ও খ্রীষ্টানদেরকে বন্ধু হিসাবে গ্রহণ করো না। তারা একে অপরের বন্ধু। তোমাদের মধ্যে যে তাদের সাথে বন্ধুত্ব করবে, সে তাদেরই অন্তর্ভুক্ত। আল্লাহ জালেমদেরকে পথ প্রদর্শন করেন না। My Critical Reasoning: What does it mean? What’s the status of Jews and Christian to Allah? Kafir What are Jews and Christians to Allah? Enemy to Allah and His Rasul and to Believers Therefore, what does “one of them” could mean? Kafir Enemy Not “One of Us” But ” Brother, it is a very serious issue to tell a Muslim as Kafir, it needs high scholarly judgement to tell a Muslim Kafir, you cannot do that yourself, who are you to do that?” Alright then, tell me what does “One of them” means? I have to understand something as it is in clear English! (Actually Arabic). Then can I at least say, they are enemy of Muslims? Can I at least say, they do not belong to Muslims because clearly “One of them” could noway mean “One of US”! Therefore, if I cannot say, “they are Kafir”, but at least I can say that they are not Muslim! and they are enemy of Muslim! And so, if I cannot say all those govt. in the so called ‘Islamic’ Countries (not state, it’s haram to say that) as kafir, at least I can say they are not Muslim and I can say they are enemy of Muslim. It’s a simple math! And Allah knows best.

x: The Ayah Ash-Shura 42:52 وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْإِيمَانُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِي بِهِ مَن نَّشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith , but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path Bangla Translations: বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন ডঃ মুজিবুর রহমান মুহিউদ্দীন খান অনুরূপভাবে (উপরোক্ত তিনটি পদ্ধতিতে) আমি তোমার কাছে আমার নির্দেশ থেকে ‘রূহ’কে ওহী যোগে প্রেরণ করেছি। তুমি জানতে না কিতাব কী এবং ঈমান কী? কিন্তু আমি একে আলো বানিয়েছি, যার মাধ্যমে আমি আমার বান্দাদের মধ্যে যাকে ইচ্ছা হিদায়াত দান করি। আর নিশ্চয় তুমি সরল পথের দিক নির্দেশনা দাও। এভাবে আমি তোমার প্রতি প্রত্যাদেশ করেছি রূহ তথা আমার নির্দেশ; তুমিতো জানতেনা কিতাব কি ও ঈমান কি! পক্ষান্তরে আমি একে করেছি আলো যা দ্বারা আমি আমার বান্দাদের মধ্যে যাকে ইচ্ছা পথ-নির্দেশ করি; তুমিতো প্রদর্শন কর শুধু সরল পথ – এমনিভাবে আমি আপনার কাছে এক ফেরেশতা প্রেরণ করেছি আমার আদেশক্রমে। আপনি জানতেন না, কিতাব কি এবং ঈমান কি? কিন্তু আমি একে করেছি নূর, যাদ্দ্বারা আমি আমার বান্দাদের মধ্য থেকে যাকে ইচ্ছা পথ প্রদর্শন করি। নিশ্চয় আপনি সরল পথ প্রদর্শন করেন- My Reflection: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! AsSalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatuallh Wa Barakatuhu! Bangla Translaitons: বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন ডঃ মুজিবুর রহমান মুহিউদ্দীন খান আর প্রতিটি বস্তুরই ভান্ডারসমূহ রয়েছে আমার কাছে এবং আমি তা অবতীর্ণ করি কেবল নির্দিষ্ট পরিমাণে। আমারই কাছে আছে প্রত্যেক বস্তুর ভান্ডার এবং আমি তা সুসম পরিমাণেই সরবরাহ করে থাকি। আমার কাছে প্রত্যেক বস্তুর ভান্ডার রয়েছে। আমি নির্দিষ্ট পরিমানেই তা অবতরণ করি।

t: Quran 15:22. Allah sends WINDS to FERTILIZE the clouds to produce rain
x: 15:22 وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ Muhsin Khan And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then caused the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We gave it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like]. Bangla Translations: বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন ডঃ মুজিবুর রহমান মুহিউদ্দীন খান আর আমি বায়ুকে ঊর্বরকারীরূপে প্রেরণ করি অতঃপর আসমান থেকে বৃষ্টি বর্ষণ করি এবং তা তোমাদের পান করাই। তবে তোমরা তার সংরক্ষণকারী নও। আমি বৃষ্টিগর্ভ বায়ু প্রেরণ করি, অতঃপর আকাশ হতে বৃষ্টি বর্ষণ করি এবং তা তোমাদেরকে পান করতে দিই; ওর ভান্ডার তোমাদের কাছে নেই। আমি বৃষ্টিগর্ভ বায়ু পরিচালনা করি অতঃপর আকাশ থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করি, এরপর তোমাদেরকে তা পান করাই। বস্তুতঃ তোমাদের কাছে এর ভান্ডার নেই।

t: Quran 9:31 – At-Tawbah. Following Ulema BLINDLY is taking them as ILAHA

Praise and glory be to Him, (far above is He) from having the partners they associate (with Him).” Bangla তারা তাদের পন্ডিত ও সংসার-বিরাগীদিগকে তাদের পালনকর্তারূপে গ্রহণ করেছে আল্লাহ ব্যতীত এবং মরিয়মের পুত্রকেও। অথচ তারা আদিষ্ট ছিল একমাত্র মাবুদের এবাদতের জন্য। তিনি ছাড়া কোন মাবুদ নেই, তারা তাঁর শরীক সাব্যস্ত করে, তার থেকে তিনি পবিত্র।

t: Quran 2:132. O ‘Muslim’, DO NOT DIE except FULLY OBEYING and FOLLOWING Islamic Way of Life.
x: Al-Baqarah 2:132 وَوَصَّىٰ بِهَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بَنِيهِ وَيَعْقُوبُ يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَىٰ لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ And Abraham instructed his sons [to do the same] and [so did] Jacob, [saying], “O my sons, indeed Allah has chosen for you this Deen (Systems of Allah, The way of life) , so do not die except while you are Muslims (fully obeying and following Allah’s system) .” Bangla এরই ওছিয়ত করেছে ইব্রাহীম তার সন্তানদের এবং ইয়াকুবও যে, হে আমার সন্তানগণ, নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ তোমাদের জন্য তাঁর দ্বীন (জীবনের প্রতিটি পর্যায়ে অনুসরনীয় জীবন যাপন পদ্দতি, জীবন ব্যবস্থা) মনোনীত করেছেন। কাজেই তোমরা মুসলমান না হয়ে ( পুরোপুরিভাবে, প্রতিটি বিষয়ে আল্লাহর নির্দেশ না মেনে, আল্লাহর প্রদত্ত জীবন ব্যবস্থা অনুসরন না করে ) কখনও মৃত্যুবরণ করো না। Bismillah Al Hamdulillah! t: Quran 28:16 – Al-Qasas. Dua for repentance
e: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
x: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي 28:16 قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ Sahih International He said, “My Rabb, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me,” and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful. Bangla মুহিউদ্দীন খান তিনি বললেন, হে আমার পালনকর্তা, আমি তো নিজের উপর জুলুম করে ফেলেছি। অতএব, আমাকে ক্ষমা করুন। আল্লাহ তাকে ক্ষমা করলেন। নিশ্চয় তিনি ক্ষমাশীল, দয়ালু। বায়ান ফাউন্ডেশন সে বলল, ‘হে আমার রব, নিশ্চয় আমি আমার নফ্সের প্রতি যুলম করেছি, সুতরাং আপনি আমাকে ক্ষমা করে দিন’। অতঃপর তিনি তাকে ক্ষমা করলেন। নিশ্চয় তিনি অতি ক্ষমাশীল, পরম দয়ালু। ডঃ মুজিবুর রহমান সে বললঃ হে আমার রাব্ব! আমিতো আমার নিজের প্রতি যুল্‌ম করেছি; সুতরাং আমাকে ক্ষমা করুন! অতঃপর তিনি তাকে ক্ষমা করলেন। তিনিতো ক্ষমাশীল, পরম দয়ালু।

t: Quran 7:180 – Al-A’raaf. DISASSOCIATE with those who ABUSE/ practice DEVIATION concerning Allah’s NAMES
e: And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.
x: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|: :|: Muslims Abandoned the Quran – Abandoned the Wahee, Following a PACKAGE Islam :|: :|: ‘Muslims’ Following Kuffar’s Deen :|: :|: Understanding of the End of the Time :|: :|: Understanding of the Shirk of Kufr of the End of the Time :|: :|: Going with the Flow! – Know the Disaster! :|: وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا ۖ وَذَرُوا الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي أَسْمَائِهِ ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ “And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.” Bangla “আর আল্লাহর জন্য রয়েছে সব উত্তম নাম। কাজেই সে নাম ধরেই তাঁকে ডাক। আর তাদেরকে বর্জন কর, যারা তাঁর নামের ব্যাপারে বাঁকা পথে চলে। তারা নিজেদের কৃতকর্মের ফল শীঘ্রই পাবে।” :|: Quran for Critical Reasoning :|; Part 1.1 of the Ayah: وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ All the best names belong to Allah. Or it can be translated as ‘To Allah belong the best names.’ Part 1.2 of the Ayah: فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا This part of the Ayah gives a command/ directive about the manner of Dua, as to how to make Dua to Allah, Al-Mujeeb, which is, by citing/ calling/ mentioning HIM by HIS best names. Part 2 of the Ayah: وَذَرُوا الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي أَسْمَائِهِ And then, the next section of the Ayah tells Muslims to leave, reject those who engage in wrong practices about Allah’s names. Now, what is the wrong practices concerning Allah’s names? Traditionally, the earlier generation of scholars referred to these wrong practices as calling Allah ‘Lat’, ‘Ujja’, ‘Manat’, by the names of the idols that Quraish used to call. But most of the Muslims adopted an Idol name, ‘Khuda’/ ‘Khoda’ and started calling Allah by that idol name after the advent of Islam to Pagan Persia, and then they carried it forward later in the Indian subcontinent. And then, what happened in the last 300 years? Most of the Muslims living/ associating with the Kuffar and the Mushrikun, calling Allah by another idol name, ‘God’ (a name of idol originated from a German tribe, which English people have carried forward) Thus, deviation in regards to Allah’s names has been in practice for a long time by the Muslims. And these only happened because Muslims do not contemplate the Quran. An Ayah of the Quran do not impact them. They do not learn Islam from the Quran; rather, they learn Islam from a ‘package’ carried forward from the earlier generations of the Ulama. Thus, due to the blind following of the ‘package’, they failed to track those deviations in Allah’s names adopted in their times. They read the Tafsirs of the earlier generations, which relate these Ayat to the Idols of the Quraish, and they limit their understanding of the Ayah to that time, as if this Quran was only sent for that time. As if, in our times, we don’t need to follow what the Quran says; we only follow what the earlier generations explained to us about the Quran. As if the Quran is not a Wahee to us anymore, the understanding of the earlier generations is the Wahee for us. This is one of the many examples of how the Muslims have abandoned the Quran, abandoned the Wahee for a long time. Simply, we can say, calling Allah ‘God’/ ‘Khuda’/ ‘Khoda’ is a sinful act as it shows a negation of Allah’s command. Because these are not Allah’s names. These were the names of Idols. Therefore, by calling/ mentioning Allah as ‘God’/ ‘Khuda’/ ‘Khoda’, a Muslim not only disobeys the order of Allah, Al-Hakeem, but he also pronounces the word of Idol, he is actually calling the idol ‘God’, unknowingly or knowingly, which could be a Shirk of ‘words of mouth’, shirk by the tongue. And Allah knows best. And then, Allah asks Muslims to leave those who still insist on using those names for Allah. Now, argument comes. (shaitan is not sitting idle, May Allah protect us from shaitan) That, brother, when Quraish called ‘Lat’, ‘Ujja’, ‘Manat’, they actually worship those idols. But today, Muslims do not worship those idols whose name was ‘God’ or ‘Khuda’; they call Allah by using those names only. You should not put it on the same scale. Seems very logical, doesn’t it? But read the Ayah again, Allah doesn’t say, ‘those who practice deviation in HIS WORSHIP’. Rather, HE says, “those who practice deviation regarding HIS NAMES’ Then, isn’t calling Allah by those names of idols is a deviation in HIS names? Part 3 of the Ayah: سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ Finally, this is a severe warning from Ar-Rahman, who is also Shadidul Eqab. And Allah knows best. May Allah give us beneficial knowledge and understanding of Deen. May Allah save us from HIS punishment. Ameen. We have discussed this thoroughly in another place. Please refer to the article below to read about it. ‘GOD’ is the name of an IDOL; O Muslims, why do you call Allah by that name?

t: Quran 72:14-15 – Al-Jinn: Either you are FULLY OBEDIENT (Muslim) to Allah or you are UNJUST and unjust is for FIRE
x: 72:14 وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا Sahih International And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah ] , and among us are the unjust . And whoever has become Muslim – those have sought out the right course. 72:15 وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا Sahih International But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.’ The clear general meaning of the Ayah is, disbelieving Allah is an act of UNJUST. Not recognizing one’s creator is UNJUST, Being Kafir is UNJUST. As if the Ayah clearly says, Either you are Muslim or you are Unjust. That’s a clear statement about Kafir. But then we should translate the meaning as per the impact of what it means in today’s context and today’s condition. As for the word ‘Muslim’, what does it mean? It means those who submit to Allah, who obey Allah fully and full heartedly. Therefore, the Ayah should be a matter of concern to those namesake Muslims, those who disobeying Allah everyday by not following Allah’s command to worship Him, not following the system of Allah in their life and following a system other than Allah’s Deen. So, in a traditional translation, the ‘modern Muslim’ of today, will actually find no impact of these Ayat because they think they are ‘Muslim’. But if we take the literal meaning of Muslim properly (which is, fully obedient to Allah) and apply it then we should translate it like this, “Not FULLY OBEDIENT to Allah is an act of UNJUST and unjust means FIRE” so that namesake Muslims might give it a thought InShaaAllah. And Allah knows best. May Allah guide us to Allah’s full obedience. Ameen

t: 2:239 SALAT is allowed SITTING only when you FEAR ENEMY (not because you are SHY to stand in front of the KAFIRS)

x: Inclusive commentary 2:239 فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ فَرِجَالًا أَوْ رُكْبَانًا ۖ فَإِذَا أَمِنتُمْ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَمَا عَلَّمَكُم مَّا لَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْلَمُونَ Sahih International And if you fear [an enemy, then pray] on foot or riding. But when you are secure, then remember Allah [in prayer], as He has taught you that which you did not [previously] know. Bangla অতঃপর যদি তোমাদের কারো ব্যাপারে ভয় থাকে, তাহলে পদচারী অবস্থাতেই পড়ে নাও অথবা সওয়ারীর উপরে। তারপর যখন তোমরা নিরাপত্তা পাবে, তখন আল্লাহকে স্মরণ কর, যেভাবে তোমাদের শেখানো হয়েছে, যা তোমরা ইতিপূর্বে জানতে না। My Comments: Today many born Muslims of weak faith (with a clear chick heart) clearly manifest their weakness in the belief by praying Salat sitting in the chair in the office or sitting in a parked car. He doesn’t have the ‘gut’ or courage to manage a space and stand in his office or stand in a public place or on a footpath. He manifests Islam to the lowest of the low to the kafirs because he has no knowledge of Allah. He carries Islam only because he just born in a Muslim family. But now read what Allah says, if you only fear of enemy then you praying riding or even on walking. And then there are the matters of fiqh with reference from Hadiths that allowed a sick person to sit or even lying. Look at these people with strong eeman, how they prayed in front of the eyes of spectators, May Allah reward them abundantly. Now, my brothers and sisters, I am sorry for being so harsh but let me give you some eeman booster for you. First thing, read this Hadith. Abu Dawud , Imam Nasai in his Sunan and Imam Nawabi in 40 Hadith Qudsi recorded it. ————————————————————————– It was narrated that ‘Uqbah bin ‘Amir said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: ‘ Your Rabb is pleased with a shepherd high in the mountains who calls the Adhan for the prayer and prays. Allah says: ‘Look at this slave of Mine; he calls the Adhan and Iqamah for the prayer and fears Me. I have forgiven My slave and admitted him to Paradise.'” أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أَبَا عُشَّانَةَ الْمَعَافِرِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ “‏ يَعْجَبُ رَبُّكَ مِنْ رَاعِي غَنَمٍ فِي رَأْسِ شَظِيَّةِ الْجَبَلِ يُؤَذِّنُ بِالصَّلاَةِ وَيُصَلِّي فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ انْظُرُوا إِلَى عَبْدِي هَذَا يُؤَذِّنُ وَيُقِيمُ الصَّلاَةَ يَخَافُ مِنِّي قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي وَأَدْخَلْتُهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏” ‏ ‏.‏ Grade : Sahih (Darussalam) Sunan an-Nasa’i » The Book of the Adhan (The Call to Prayer) – كتاب الأذان English reference : Vol. 1, Book 7, Hadith 667 Arabic reference : Book 7, Hadith 674 ————————————————————————– See, what an opportunity for you to please Allah. Even when praying in Masjid, how do you know if Allah pleased with you or not, right? So, why would you miss this opportunity? Then I put this analogy only to give you some mental strength which might work for you InShaaAllah. If you happen to work in the prime minister’s office of your country, what would you feel in status, prestige and proudness? Would you feel shy about telling people or showing people that you work in the prime minister’s office? Imagine that in real. And then think of the owner of this entire earth and the universe and you have a direct connection with Him, what should be your prestige and proudness among those people who even do not know their creator? How can you be shy standing in front of the owner of this universe in which they have no connection? And who are they? Allah said they are the worst of the creation and you are the best of the creation. You should always be proud to show your connection with Allah, the owner of the universe in front of them InShaaAllah. May Allah make us strong in eeman and taqwa. Ameen.

Such people cannot hope to ……………… You can read related Hadith that put OBLIGATION on a Muslim to ENJOIN good and FORBID evil : Ibne Katheer mention the following Hadith in his tafsir of this Ayah: Imam Ahmad recorded that Abu Ar-Riqad said, “I heard Hudhayfah saying, ` A person used to utter one word during the time of the Messenger of Allah and become a hypocrite on account of it. t: Quran 42:13. Ash-Shuara. Allah GUIDES him who TURNS to Allah in OBEDIENCE
x: 42:13 Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills, and guides unto Himself who turns to Him in repentance and in obedience. شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ Muhsin Khan He (Allah) has ordained for you the same religion (Islam) which He ordained for Nuh (Noah), and that which We have inspired in you (O Muhammad SAW), and that which We ordained for Ibrahim (Abraham), Musa (Moses) and ‘Iesa (Jesus) saying you should establish religion (i.e. to do what it orders you to do practically), and make no divisions in it (religion) (i.e. various sects in religion). Intolerable for the Mushrikun , is that to which you (O Muhammad SAW) call them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills, and guides unto Himself who turns to Him in repentance and in obedience. Bangla তিনি তোমাদের জন্যে দ্বীনের ক্ষেত্রে সে পথই নিধারিত করেছেন, যার আদেশ দিয়েছিলেন নূহকে, যা আমি প্রত্যাদেশ করেছি আপনার প্রতি এবং যার আদেশ দিয়েছিলাম ইব্রাহীম, মূসা ও ঈসাকে এই মর্মে যে, তোমরা দ্বীনকে প্রতিষ্ঠিত কর এবং তাতে অনৈক্য সৃষ্টি করো না। আপনি মূশরেকদেরকে যে বিষয়ের প্রতি আমন্ত্রণ জানান, তা তাদের কাছে দুঃসাধ্য বলে মনে হয়। আল্লাহ যাকে ইচ্ছা মনোনীত করেন এবং যে তাঁর অভিমুখী হয়, তাকে পথ প্রদর্শন করেন।

t: Quran 6:116 – Al-A’nam: DO NOT THINK (follow) what MAJORITY people do is right
x: 6:116 وَإِن تُطِعْ أَكْثَرَ مَن فِي الْأَرْضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ Shabbir Ahmed Translation: (People will confront you with what the majority is doing.) Now if you pay heed to, or get intimidated by majority of those who live on earth, they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Most of the people follow nothing but conjecture and they only live by guesswork Bijan Moeinian Translation: If [instead of the Allah’s Book,] you follow the opinion of the majority [as it is the case of today’s democracies], they will divert you from the path of God. The majority of the people follow nothing but unfounded guess works [as they do not know the truth.] Bangla আর যদি আপনি পৃথিবীর অধিকাংশ লোকের কথা মেনে নেন, তবে তারা আপনাকে আল্লাহর পথ থেকে পথগামী করে দেবে। তারা শুধু অলীক কল্পনার অনুসরণ করে এবং সম্পূর্ণ অনুমান ভিত্তিক কথাবার্তা বলে থাকে।

t: 7:33. Allah made it HARAM to SAY THINGS about Allah that you have NO KNOWLEDGE
x: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَالْإِثْمَ وَالْبَغْيَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَأَن تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا وَأَن تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ Sahih International Say, “My Lord has only forbidden immoralities – what is apparent of them and what is concealed – and sin, and oppression without right, and that you associate with Allah that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allah that which you do not know.” Bangla আপনি বলে দিনঃ আমার পালনকর্তা কেবলমাত্র অশ্লীল বিষয়সমূহ হারাম করেছেন যা প্রকাশ্য ও অপ্রকাশ্য এবং হারাম করেছেন গোনাহ, অন্যায়-অত্যাচার আল্লাহর সাথে এমন বস্তুকে অংশীদার করা, তিনি যার কোন, সনদ অবতীর্ণ করেননি এবং আল্লাহর প্রতি এমন কথা আরোপ করা, যা তোমরা জান না।

t: Quran 25:43 – Al-Furqan. When you follow your HAWA (desire), you take that as your ‘ILAHA’, as if you are worshiping YOURSELF!
e: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire?
x: 25:43 Have you seen the one who takes as his ‘ god’ his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him? أَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا Have you seen the one who takes as his ‘ god’ his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him? Bangla আপনি কি তাকে দেখেন না, যে তারা প্রবৃত্তিকে উপাস্যরূপে গ্রহণ করে? তবুও কি আপনি তার যিম্মাদার হবেন? Related Ayah: 53:23 53:23 They are not but [mere] names you have named them – you and your forefathers – for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance. এগুলো কতগুলো নাম বৈ নয়, যা তোমরা এবং তোমাদের পূর্ব-পুরুষদের রেখেছ। এর সমর্থনে আল্লাহ কোন দলীল নাযিল করেননি। তারা অনুমান এবং প্রবৃত্তিরই অনুসরণ করে। অথচ তাদের কাছে তাদের পালনকর্তার পক্ষ থেকে পথ নির্দেশ এসেছে। Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! Look, how things are connected. In Ayah 53:23 Allah give us an information, which seem not much connected with us, but now read that Ayah again and connect with this Ayah, see it is terrifying SHIRK! The gist of the Ayah 53:23 was something like this: Whatever idea and thoughts you might come up about Allah, the Almighty, if you do not have an evidence for that then that is from what your heart desires. Therefore, first you need to check whether the ideas you have about Allah, your creator, did Allah mention about that in the Quran or was their any authentic narrations from Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam? If it is not, then Allah said, it is from your DESIRE. That’s the understanding from Ayah 53:23. Contemplate further on the word that Allah mentions. Allah mentions “he did not sent from him an AUTHORITY (sultan)”. Means, anything, in regards to Allah’s authority, needs his approval, needs evidence from Him. Now come to this Ayah we study. Allah mention that DESIRE is actually their ‘ILAHA’, which means worshiping yourself, which is nothing other than a clear SHIRK. And Allah knows best. May Allah save us from all forms of Shirk.

t: 49:12. DO NOT SPY or look for SECRETS of one another
e: DO NOT SPY or look for SECRETS of one another
x: 49:12 O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ Sahih International O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. t: Quran 7:179. Those who do NOT USE their SENSES (Qalb, vision, hearing) are worst than the sheep and the cattle
e: They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear.
x: 7:179 They have hearts with which they do not understand , they have eyes with which they do not see , and they have ears with which they do not hear. وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ ۖ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ آذَانٌ لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ Sahih International And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand , they have eyes with which they do not see , and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless. t: Quran 31:21. FOLLOW only what Allah has sent, NOT your Forefather’s ways.
e: “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers.” Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?
x: 31:21 31:21 And when it is said to them, “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers.” “E ven if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze”? وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوا مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ Sahih International And when it is said to them, “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers.” Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze? Bangla তাদেরকে যখন বলা হয়, আল্লাহ যা নাযিল করেছেন, তোমরা তার অনুসরণ কর, তখন তারা বলে, বরং আমরা আমাদের পূর্বপুরুষদেরকে যে বিষয়ের উপর পেয়েছি, তারই অনুসরণ করব। শয়তান যদি তাদেরকে জাহান্নামের শাস্তির দিকে দাওয়াত দেয়, তবুও কি? Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! My Critical Reasoning: What are the issues here? 1. A Command: “Follow what Allah has revealed”, 2. A response to that Command: “Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers.” 3. Allah’s warning: “Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze”? What does it mean by the calling of shaitan? Denying the way of worship revealed by Allah is the calling of shaitan. Where will you get what Allah has revealed? It’s in the Quran and in authentic Hadith. Doing ebadah (worship) OTHER THAN what Allah revealed is from shaitan

t: Quran 17:73 – Al-Isra. Rasulullah was ABOUT to be TEMPTED away to FABRICATE Quran
e: Verily, they were about to tempt you away from that which We have revealed (the Quran) unto you (O Muhammad SAW), to fabricate something other than it against Us, and then they would certainly have taken you a friend!

Bangla আমি আপনাকে দৃঢ়পদ না রাখলে আপনি তাদের প্রতি কিছুটা ঝুঁকেই পড়তেন। Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! Let’s concise the Ayah to focus. Verily, they were about to tempt you away from that which We have revealed (the Quran) unto you (O Muhammad SAW), to fabricate something other than it against Us, and then they would certainly have taken you a friend! May Allah protect us. If Kuffar almost influence and tempt your prophet, Sallillahu Aaihi WaSallam, then are you thinking associating with the Kuffar but sitting in Jannah? Is Jannah that easy? So read what Allah said in the next Ayah. 17:74. Unless Allah, our Mawlana, the protector, made Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi WaSallam firm and strengthen him, he (Rasulullah) would have almost inclined to the Kuffar and distort Allah’s Wahee. Then, what about those Ulema who maintain strong associations with the Kuffar and whenever they get a least scope to relate to Quran and Hadith, they use it to justify their relations with them. Watch those scholars mindfully, it’s very easy to notice. How can you stay firm in Deen without Allah, the Turner of Hearts, will make you firm? And how can Allah make you firm while you take the Kuffar as your friend, while you follow the system of Kuffar in your daily life? How would you stay firm on Deen when you engrossed in the Kuffar’s environment wholeheartedly with your whole family? How do you not understand the significance of Allah’s warning that Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. (3:118) So, think the significance of this Ayah A nd stay away from associating with the Kuffar and their systems . Rethink your situation, shaitan is working hard to take every single child of Adam to Jahannam except the one who obeys Allah’s command entirely. And Allah knows best. May Allah guide Muslims, Ameen.

e: Say, “O Allah , Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You

Bangla বলুন ইয়া আল্লাহ! তুমিই সার্বভৌম শক্তির অধিকারী। তুমি যাকে ইচ্ছা রাজ্য দান কর এবং যার কাছ থেকে ইচ্ছা রাজ্য ছিনিয়ে নাও এবং যাকে ইচ্ছা সম্মান দান কর আর যাকে ইচ্ছা অপমানে পতিত কর। তোমারই হাতে রয়েছে যাবতীয় কল্যাণ। নিশ্চয়ই তুমি সর্ব বিষয়ে ক্ষমতাশীল। My Reflection: Bismillah Al Hamdulillah AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah O Muslims, after knowing this Ayah that belongs to the Quran that you believe in, how can you then be a part of democracy? How do you then vote, support and engage yourself in talk and discussion about democracy? When you do, you agree that ‘people are sovereign’, you put yourself in a clear Kufr . That’s the full stop if you fear Allah, if you fear Jahannam. Don’t let any ‘but’s or ‘if’s come into your mind, because that’s from shayateen. And he is working. So, whatever you do from praying Tahajjud, going to Hajj, doing Sadaqah, engaging vigorously in Dawah work, but you are engaging in democracy because you have a Fatwa from ‘your Ulema’ , know that shaitan has promised Allah to take son of Adam A’lihi Wa Sallam to Jahannam and he just needs one slightest disobedience from you, the slightest chance of Shirk or Kufr . So, do not feed yourself by all those ‘reasons’ why you are engaging in democracy, what ‘intention’ you have etc. Disassociate yourself from democracy today. Imagine if Jahannam is displayed in front of you in the sky, I am sure, you won’t do a thing that could cause the slightest possibility for entering Jahannam. I seek refuse with Allah from Jahannam. May Allah protect us from Jahannam. And Allah knows best. May Allah guide us.

e: O ye who believe! If ye obey a party of those who have received the Scripture they will make you disbelievers after your belief.

Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! “If you obey them, to those who are given the scriptures, They will make you disbelieve, after you believed.” What does it mean obeying them? In what regard? In what respect? When you work under them and they gave you an instruction, you don’t obey them? Is it that? Not at all, right? Absolutely it is in the matter where Allah, the only law giver, has a clear command or a clear law or a clear ways/ systems for you but you do not follow that rather you follow the system of the Jews and Christians, then, what it is regarded as you ‘obeying’ them. And Allah knows best. Just a basic daily life example of following Jews and Christians: When you greet another Muslim saying “Hi” or “Good Morning” where Allah gave you a system how to greet a Muslim by saying “Salam” then you are obeying them. Similarly, when you say “Bye Bye” to give farewell to another Muslim you are just obeying the Kuffar. And thus as a Muslim business person when you put ‘$0.99’ as your product price instead of putting it straight ‘$1.00’, you have no idea how closely inch by inch you are following Kafir’s system and walking towards disbelieve (not me, Allah said that, they will make you Kafir). And you have no idea how you can repay that ‘$0.01’ on the day of Qiyamah. Allah knows best. So, what can you do? Check in every matters in your life, when there is a system for you from your Rabb, Allah, the best guide, then leave the system of the Kuffa’s. What are these systems that you and I follow in our everyday life, knowingly being unmindful about Allah, the Most high and unknowingly being ignorant, because we are now surrounded by the system of the Kuffar’s. To know them read and subscribe this blog May Allah, the most forgiving, save us from the Kufr May Allah protect s from following Kuffar’s Ways of Life. And May Allah make us those who follow Allah’s system in every aspects of life. Ameen.
