t: Quran 5:44 – Al-Maidah. Whoever (Obviously those ‘Muslim’ rulers) do NOT JUDGE by Allah’s LAW (thus REJECT Allah’s Law) – they are the KAFIRUN
e: So do not fear the people but fear Me, and do not exchange My verses for a small price. And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed – then it is those who are the disbelievers.
x: :|: Quran Study – One Ayah a Day :|: :|: Quran for Critical Reasoning :|: :|: Quran – Distinguishes Haqq from the Baatil :|: :|: Undersranding the Haqq – Understanding the Baatil/ Astray :|: 5:44 So do not fear the people but fear Me, and do not exchange My verses for a small price. And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed – then it is those who are the Kafirun. Reflecting/ Critical Reasoning: Bismillah! AL Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’la Rasulillah! Ayah 5:44 (Whoever doesn’t rule by Allah’s Law is a Kafir) What does this mean? The one who doesn’t believe in Allah and His Rasul is a Kafir, isn’t that what we know already? Yes, that’s true. Then what about this Kafir? Does it give us another definition of Kafir? Good question and very thoughtful. Let’s have a critical reasoning of this. A kafir, who is already a kafir, can he be kafir because he doesn’t rule by Allah’s Law? No! A kafir rejects Allah and Rasulullah already. Obviously, he won’t follow Allah’s LAW. Therefore, not following Allah’s law cannot be a condition for them to confirm their kufr again, make sense? Then, who is Allah talking about in this Ayah? Obviously, the Ayah only makes sense when you put a ‘Muslim’ ruler in that situation, those ‘Muslims’ who do not rule by Allah’s law and those who choose and enforce Kuffar’s law, man-made law (and exept the one is forced) over the law of Allah, the Only Law Giver, thus they REJECT Allah’s Law (by their action, even though one might not intent it) and it is the REJECTION of Allah’s law that makes them Kafir. And Allah knows best. Understanding the misguidance: But here is the greatest scholar of our time, Shaikh Ibn Uthaimeen, who gives the following explanations of this Ayah: (read it from here/ copy-paste the link): http://oasisofknowledge.com/imaam-ibn-uthaimeen-on-the-khawaarij-of-the-era/) “There is another (narration) from Ibn Abbaas concerning this verse, which explains that the intent is the Kufr which does not expel from the religion, as occurs in the saying of the Messenger (sallallaahu alaihi wasallam), “Reviling a Muslim is sin (fusooq) and fighting him is Kufr (disbelief). And in the view of some of Mufassiroon , it was actually revealed for the People of the Book , this is because the actual context of the passage is what occurs before” Do you have any idea what he intended by quoting these references? Let’s do the critical reasoning of these explanations. We will do the second part first. By bringing the view of ‘……Some Mufassiroon…….before’, doesn’t he try to imply that the ayah is applicable to the Jews and Christians? It seems so. Alright. Let’s take that context of “ it was actually revealed for the People of the Book” into account as a possibility, and let’s agree on that and then again make a critical analysis of that too. Allah says, “ whosoever does not judge by what Allâh has revealed, such are the Kâfirûn” Who does Allah say will be Kafir? Jews and Christians. Why? Because they don’t judge by Allah’s LAW, while Allah gave them TORAH. So, why are they supposed to judge by Allah’s LAW? Because they are the people who believed in Allah, and Allah gave the legislation of the Torah to them to follow. Then, if not judging by Allah’s law makes Jews and Christians Kafir, then did Allah give a book of Law to Muslims too? Yes, Then let me ask you, If Jews and Christians can be Kafir because they don’t judge by Allah’s Law, then if Muslims do not judge by Allah’s LAW, doesn’t it apply the same to Muslim too? It should. Yes, it’s simple math! Of course, it is simple math while Allah, the ONLY Legislator, commanded in many other Ayahs to judge by Allah’s Law. La Hawla Wa La Quawwata Illa Billah, How come then such a great scholar covers up such an issue by coming up with this shallow argument that it is revealed for the people of the book? Weren’t there are ‘hundred’s of issues that were revealed for the Ahlul Kitab, yet they use it on Muslims. Subhanallah! Which Muslims do not know this Ayah: “If you do not know, ask the people of knowledge” (Quran 16:43) Wasn’t it revealed to ask from the Scholars of Ahlul Kitab? Do they have any problem using this for Muslim scholars today? La Hawla Wa La Quwata Illa Billah! Not only that, he is actually trying to cover himself up by saying, “It is the view of some Mufassiroon….” What can you understand from it? It’s an effort to divert the attention of the ‘sheep’ among the Muslims away, to give those ‘sheep’ an impression that it does not apply to Muslims now! And we Muslims refer to such things to one reason, shaitan . And Allah knows best. Important NOTE: Whoever wants to understand this Ayah in a holistic perspective, please read from here SHAYKH SULAYMAAN AL-‘ALWAAN Sheikh Muhammed Salih Al-Munajjid The kufr of one who rules according to other than what Allaah revealed (https://islamqa.info/en/974) Ruling on one who rules by something other than that which Allaah has revealed (https://islamqa.info/en/13659) Now, come to the first part of his explanations. In the first part, ‘the intent is the Kufr which does not expel from the religion’ Why did he take the discussion to the next level when he has a problem recognising the main issue properly? The only explanation is that he tried to take the minds of his readers away from the main issue by bringing the branches into the discussion. This is done with the intention to misguide people from straight thinking, while the Ayah is straightforward, ‘You don’t judge by Allah’s Law, you are Kafir’ . If you are really on the truth, you would have agreed on this point straight away. The general meaning and understanding of this Ayah is that ‘You don’t judge by Allah’s Law, you are Kafir’ . Besides, we Muslims do not know the heart, what a person intends. The heart belongs to Allah’s knowledge, while we judge by what is apparent. Umar bin Khattab, RA said, “We were sometimes judged by the Wahee revealed during the time of Rasululullah! Now, Wahee is stopped, therefore, we judge you by the deeds you practice publicly” (Saheeh Bukhari 2641) An individual’s circumstances come under an individual case; whether a person intentionally did it or not, that comes second. A spy is working in the enemies rank; (every nation has spies working inside the enemy.) What happens when the fighting erupts? Everyone in the enemies rank is considered an enemy, even though they know there could be a fighter who is their spy, their own soldier. Yet the bullet towards the enemy rank doesn’t consider it. It considers everyone in the enemy ranks an enemy. Let me use an analogy to clear the delusion. You witnessed a person killing another person in front of your very eyes. The person is brought into the court. How do you describe the person? As ‘the Killer’! Would you think twice to describe this person other than that? It is a clear day. A person klilled another person, he will be called a Killer. No buts, no ifs. Plain and simple! The other issues come later. Why did he kill him? What is his intention? Did he intentionally kill him or not? These things come later on investigation. But in every stage, he will be described as a Killer. No doubt about that. You need to agree on that in the first place; generally, he is a Kafir who clearly is judging by the law other than Allah’s law. And by doing that, you are not going out of the Quran! Any ‘Muslim’ country, the govt., each and every individual involved in the process, who judges by even a single Law other than Allah’s Law, are Kafir. It’s just that simple! This is the first thing you have to agree on. Only then you can come to the next discussion. There could be people who are Jaheel, ignorant, who don’t know the law he is involved in is against Allah’s Law. There could be people who know that the law he is working with is against Allah’s law, but he is not much concerned about the Sharia’s implications for him. There could be people who know that the law he is working with is against Allah’s law, but he has nowhere to go for a living. There could be people who know that the law he is working with is against Allah’s law, but he is forced by his personal circumstances. And so on. You don’t know the people’s individual circumstances. And you don’t have to bother about that. What you see is what you judge by. You don’t know the mind and intention of the people. You judge people according to their actions. His action is Kufr outwardly; he is a Kafir. It’s just that simple. And it is Allah who will judge their individual situations and intentions. (Bukhari 4418) We don’t see people’s hearts; we don’t deal with that. (Saheeh Bukhari 2498) The matter of the heart is with Allah. We don’t open it. And then why do you go to explain the next level issues, “It doesn’t expel him from religion”, when you are clearly denying the issue by diverting it elsewhere in the first place? And I hope this is one of the issues that will help a truth seeker to understand the falsehood and the Baatil Ulema. May Allah guide them to the truth. And Allah knows best. And may Allah guide, give strength and rectify these types of Ulema to fear Allah and speak Haqq, those who are aligned with the Zalimun and Taghut, thus misguiding the masses of Muslims. Any good that comes from this is only from Allah, And may Allah, the perpetual forgiver, forgive me for any mistake from me, and may Allah protect me from any harm that this may bring to me, And may Allah guide us to the truth wherever it is. t: Quran 60:1 – Al-Mumtahanah. Whoever takes the Kuffar as FRIENDS or show LOVE, he is gone ASTRAY
x: 60:1 O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth….. . t: 42:13 Allah COMMANDED to ESTABLISH Allah’s SYSTEM in EVERY ASPECT of your LIFE
e: He has ordained for you all, the same System of Life that He enjoined upon Noah – And We have revealed to you (O Prophet) the same Message as We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: “Establish the Divine System of Li
x: 42:13 He has ordained for you all, the same System of Life that He enjoined upon Noah – And We have revealed to you (O Prophet) the same Message as We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: “Establish the Divine System of Life and make no sects in it.” شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ Shabbir Ahmed translation: He has ordained for you all, the same System of Life that He enjoined upon Noah – And We have revealed to you (O Prophet) the same Message as We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: “Establish the Divine System of Life and make no sects in it.” (O Prophet) Hard it is upon the idolaters (those who worship false ‘authorities’) the unity you call to. Allah draws unto Himself everyone who is willing, and guides unto Himself everyone who turns unto Him.” (Sects vs. Unity: (3:32), (3:104), (6:160), (30:31), (42:13), (45:17-18)). Bangla তিনি তোমাদের জন্যে দ্বীনের ক্ষেত্রে সে পথই নিধারিত করেছেন, যার আদেশ দিয়েছিলেন নূহকে, যা আমি প্রত্যাদেশ করেছি আপনার প্রতি এবং যার আদেশ দিয়েছিলাম ইব্রাহীম, মূসা ও ঈসাকে এই মর্মে যে, তোমরা দ্বীনকে প্রতিষ্ঠিত কর এবং তাতে অনৈক্য সৃষ্টি করো না। আপনি মূশরেকদেরকে যে বিষয়ের প্রতি আমন্ত্রণ জানান, তা তাদের কাছে দুঃসাধ্য বলে মনে হয়। আল্লাহ যাকে ইচ্ছা মনোনীত করেন এবং যে তাঁর অভিমুখী হয়, তাকে পথ প্রদর্শন করেন। My Comment: About establishing system (deen) of Allah in our daily life: O my Muslim brothers and Sisters, Read the Arabic words Allah, your Rabb, used here, it is the same wording Allah used as He used for commanding salat. But we made salat as a pillar of Islam (as Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi WaSallam made it pillar) but how come we abandon Allah’s system from our daily life which is a clear command from Allah, the legislator and by making Salat as a pillar Rasulullah Sallillahi Alaihi WaSallam did not abandon Allah’s system rather he established the system of Allah and made it prevail until we choose to abandon it. We now establish salat, Al Hamdulillah. Then forget about establishing the system of Allah in state, politics, judicial, economic or education even in our personal life we follow the system of kafir’s. We even greet each other the way kafir’s greet themselves. Imagine before Islam, sahaba had a greetings among each other but when they came into Islam, they greet each other as the way Rasulullah taught them, that’s how they establish Deen of Allah in every aspect of their daily life. Today we pray salah but we Muslims greet each other in our official environment by the way of Kafir’s, such as greeting with ‘Good morning’ etc. We feel shy or embarrassed to greet each other with plain ‘Salam’ in our official and many other occasional environment and that is happening in the Muslim countries among Muslims and then imagine the situation of Muslims around the lands of Kafirs. La Hawala Wa La Quwata Illa Billah. May Allah make us Muslims, fully submitting Muslims who follows Allah’s system in every aspect of their life. Ameen. About the translation of ‘Deen’: This is a big issue but briefly let me tell you how Muslims has adopted everything from kuffars, they either lost their identity or adjusted with kuffar’s system everywhere possible. Deen means the entire Islamic system. But you will find it is translated as ‘religion’, why? so that English speaking non Muslims can understand this. The first Quran translated by non Muslims and they needed to understand things from their perspective, which is reasonable, so they translated the word ‘deen’ as ‘religion’. But what religion means to them? Just whatever they do in churches, that’s their religion limited to. But for Muslim whenever you see this word ‘deen’ is mentioned, it is for indicating the entire system of Islam. But now when Muslims have been also translated the word to ‘religion’ and ordinary people do not even get a least idea from the word that it means the entire Islamic system of life. What’s the impact? Clear shirk and abandoning Allah’s system from every aspects of life because they know deed means ‘religion’ and they are doing the religion! They go to masjid, fast in Ramadhan, they go to Hajj! They established the religion! They have no idea they following the system of life of kuffar’s day in and day out and they have the mind-set of kuffars. I know there are many reasons for Ummah being in this humiliating state today but everybody would agree that abandoning Quran is the main cause and then the ones who try to understand Quran these translations render them no benefit towards understanding Quran. I hope publications and the translators would correct the translations if not immediately then in next editions: And I propose not to translate the following words: Allah (It’s humiliating for Allah to translate this as ‘God’, may Allah forgive them) Rabb (it’s a crime to translate it as ‘lord’, should not be translated at all but given a detail understanding in glossary) Deen (should be translated as ‘the system of life in for every aspects’) Muslim (which should be translated as ‘the fully submitting one’ InShaaAllah will detail about these in other occasions. May Allah give us the understanding of His deen and make Muslims fully submitting Muslims. Ameen

t: Quran 12:53 – Yusuf. Human are NATURALLY prone to EVIL, except the one has Allah’s RAHMAH!
e: for human nature is surely prone to enjoin evil, except on whom my Lord has mercy.
x: 12:53 `Yet I do not hold myself to be free from weakness, for human nature is surely prone to enjoin evil, except on whom my Lord has mercy. My Lord is of course Protector (against sins), Ever Merciful.’ وَمَا أُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِي ۚ إِ نَّ النَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ إِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّي ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ Amatul Rahman Omar Translation `Yet I do not hold myself to be free from weakness, for human nature is surely prone to enjoin evil, except on whom my Lord has mercy. My Lord is of course Protector (against sins), Ever Merciful.’ Bangla আমি নিজেকে নির্দোষ বলি না। নিশ্চয় মানুষের মন মন্দ কর্মপ্রবণ কিন্তু সে নয় -আমার পালনকর্তা যার প্রতি অনুগ্রহ করেন। নিশ্চয় আমার পালনকর্তা ক্ষমাশীল, দয়ালু। My Comment: This is the certain knowledge about human nature. It means without the mercy of Allah already evil is about to fall in from within ourselves and then add with this, the external force on us from shaitan, imagine, together these two, what evil human are capable of, what harm we cause to ourselves and to others. May Allah protect us from having no mercy from Him. Then who are those who have upon them the mercy of Allah? We will InShaaAllah get to know this. Therefore, be watchful to know about what actions brings Allah’s mercy and on what type of people are entitled to Allah’s mercy. InShaaAllah I will update with those criteria that brings Allah’s mercy. Instantly I can recall about a hadith which says, Allah has mercy on him who prays 4 Rakah Salah before Asr. So make the intention and Click and Read the hadith. Sunan Abu Dawud 1271 (Graded Hasan by Albani) If this is very hard for you then choose the ones that is easy for you such as: Standing on the first row in Masjid Having Mercy on others bring Allah’s mercy on you Here are the Actions that might help you to get Allah’s Mercy In Shaa Allah! And Allah knows best. May Allah have Rahmah on us. Ameen.

Only one meaning, Jahannam! and Let’s understand a SIMPLE MATH now! shaitan promised to take sons of Adam to Jahannam. Here in this Ayah Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta’ala mentions there are those who are guided by shaitan , they are leading by shaitan. Therefore, where does shaitan inevitably lead them to? Only one destination, Jahannam!

t: Quran 4:60 – An-Nisaa. Allah commanded believers to REJECT TAGHUT, therefore, you must REJECT DEMOCRACY, the Taghut of the modern-times.
x: 4:60 أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَتَحَاكَمُوا إِلَى الطَّاغُوتِ وَقَدْ أُمِرُوا أَن يَكْفُرُوا بِهِ وَيُرِيدُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَن يُضِلَّهُمْ ضَلَالًا بَعِيدًا Sahih International Have you not seen those who claim to have believed in what was revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you? They wish to refer legislation to Taghut, while they were commanded to reject it; and Satan wishes to lead them far astray. Bangla By জহুরুল হক তুমি কি তাদের দিকে চেয়ে দেখো নি যারা ভাণ করে যে তারা বিশ্বাস করে যা তোমার কাছে অবতীর্ণ হয়েছে ও যা তোমার পূর্ববর্তীদের কাছে অবতীর্ণ হয়েছে, তারা বিচার খুজঁতে চায় তাগুত থেকে, যদিও নিশ্চয়ই তাদের নির্দেশ দেয়া হয়েছিল তাকে অস্বীকার করতে? আর শয়তান চায় তাদের সুদূর বিপথে পথহারা করতে। Bangla By Mohiudin Khan আপনি কি তাদেরকে দেখেননি, যারা দাবী করে যে, যা আপনার প্রতি অবর্তীর্ণ হয়েছে আমরা সে বিষয়ের উপর ঈমান এনেছি এবং আপনার পূর্বে যা অবর্তীণ হয়েছে। তারা বিরোধীয় বিষয়কে শয়তানের দিকে নিয়ে যেতে চায়, অথচ তাদের প্রতি নির্দেশ হয়েছে, যাতে তারা ওকে মান্য না করে। পক্ষান্তরে শয়তান তাদেরকে প্রতারিত করে পথভ্রষ্ট করে ফেলতে চায়। Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! There are 4 parts in this Ayah: (Part 1) أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ “Have you not seen those who claim to have believed in what was revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you?” “তুমি কি তাদের দিকে চেয়ে দেখো নি যারা ভাণ করে যে তারা বিশ্বাস করে যা তোমার কাছে অবতীর্ণ হয়েছে ও যা তোমার পূর্ববর্তীদের কাছে অবতীর্ণ হয়েছে, “ Part 2: أَن يَتَحَاكَمُوا إِلَى الطَّاغُوتِ “They wish to refer legislation to Taghut” “তারা বিচার খুজঁতে চায় তাগুত থেকে,” Part 3: وَقَدْ أُمِرُوا أَن يَكْفُرُوا بِهِ “While they were commanded to reject it;” “অথচ তাদের প্রতি নির্দেশ হয়েছে, যাতে তারা ওকে মান্য না করে।” Part 4: وَيُرِيدُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَن يُضِلَّهُمْ ضَلَالًا بَعِيدًا and Satan wishes to lead them far astray. পক্ষান্তরে শয়তান তাদেরকে পথভ্রষ্ট করে ফেলতে চায়। Here we only discuss a portion of the Ayah, Bi-Iznillah! PART 3: وَقَدْ أُمِرُوا أَن يَكْفُرُوا بِهِ while they were commanded to reject it; যদিও নিশ্চয়ই তাদের নির্দেশ দেয়া হয়েছিল তাকে অস্বীকার করতে? What is Allah’s COMMAND in regards to TAGHUT? REJECT it and Reject it’s LAWS. But what is Taghut? Taghut is what/ whoever rules by other than Allah’s law. (We discussed it in the other posts) Therefore, we only discuss within the limit of this part of the Ayah. So, let us find how this Ayah could be implemented in our time. And here is our questions: Is democracy a process that intends to make law according to the people’s wish and will? Yes! Therefore, what’s the obligation to a Muslim, in regards to democracy? REJECT it. So, those who engage in democracy, are they rejecting it or they endorsing it? Endorsing it. Is democracy a process that declares itself EQUAL to Allah by empowering people to legislate? Yes! So, whoever engages and endorsing democracy are they fall in SHIRK? Clearly! And Allah knows best. May Allah give people understanding of Tawheed and save from Shirk. May Allah guide those ‘Muslims’ to Tawheed. Ameen

e: Whoever DISBELIEVES after BELIEF, upon him will be WRATH of Allah and SEVERE PUNISHMENT
x: 16:106 Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief……upon them is wrath from Allah , and for them is a great punishment; مَن كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ Sahih International Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief … except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. t: Quran 2:165. All POWER belongs to Allah
x: 2:165 وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَندَادًا يُحِبُّونَهُمْ كَحُبِّ اللَّهِ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَشَدُّ حُبًّا لِّلَّهِ ۗ وَلَوْ يَرَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا إِذْ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ أَنَّ الْقُوَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعَذَابِ Sahih International And [yet], among the people are those who take other than Allah as equals [to Him]. Bangla আর কোন লোক এমনও রয়েছে যারা অন্যান্যকে আল্লাহর সমকক্ষ সাব্যস্ত করে এবং তাদের প্রতি তেমনি ভালবাসা পোষণ করে, যেমন আল্লাহর প্রতি ভালবাসা হয়ে থাকে। কিন্তু যারা আল্লাহর প্রতি ঈমানদার তাদের ভালবাসা ওদের তুলনায় বহুগুণ বেশী। আর কতইনা উত্তম হâ€™ত যদি এ জালেমরা পার্থিব কোন কোন আযাব প্রত্যক্ষ করেই উপলব্ধি করে নিত যে, যাবতীয় ক্ষমতা শুধুমাত্র আল্লাহরই জন্য এবং আল্লাহর আযাবই সবচেয়ে কঠিনতর।

They love them as they [should] love Allah . But those who believe are stronger in love for Allah . If only, those who do wrong could see, when they will see the torment, [they will be certain] that all power belongs to Allah and that Allah is severe in punishment. Bangla আর কোন লোক এমনও রয়েছে যারা অন্যান্যকে আল্লাহর সমকক্ষ সাব্যস্ত করে এবং তাদের প্রতি তেমনি ভালবাসা পোষণ করে, যেমন আল্লাহর প্রতি ভালবাসা হয়ে থাকে। কিন্তু যারা আল্লাহর প্রতি ঈমানদার তাদের ভালবাসা ওদের তুলনায় বহুগুণ বেশী। আর কতইনা উত্তম হâ€™ত যদি এ জালেমরা পার্থিব কোন কোন আযাব প্রত্যক্ষ করেই উপলব্ধি করে নিত যে, যাবতীয় ক্ষমতা শুধুমাত্র আল্লাহরই জন্য এবং আল্লাহর আযাবই সবচেয়ে কঠিনতর। Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! So, how do people set equals with Allah? A simple one way of understanding it is when people give the right to something/ someone else which only deserves/ belongs to Allah Subhanahu. How do we understand it more simpler way in a regular acts? Say, a men (husband) has a particular right over his women (wife). This right only belong to the husband, not to any second person. What if the wife gives the same right for 5 minutes to someone else? As an act, She will commit a Zina. The husband will never take it easy. But as an idea, the wife just make someone else equal to the husband. So now, how do people make someone/ something equals to Allah? To understand that we have to find what is Allah’s right that he doesn’t accept any share/ partner/ equal to him? Issue no. 1: Allah doesn’t accept a partner/ equal in regards to Ebadah. (Sura Al-Kahf 18:110) Issue no. 2: Allah doesn’t accept a partner/ equal in regards to His Hukm/ Law/ Legislation. (Sura Al-Kahf 18:26) Now, if a Muslim obeys a law other than Allah’s law willingly, he gives those lawgivers equal status to Allah. Thus he commits Shirk and become a Mushik. Allah knows best. May Allah save us from engaging in Shirk by giving His right to the Kuffar by willingly obeying, submitting to the Kuffar’s law by willingly staying in the Kuffar’s lands, under the Kuffar’s authority. Ameen.

t: Quran 2:22. O Muslims, Know! How is your life weaved with Shirk of ‘Words of Mouth’!
x: 2:22 DO NOT make EQUALS to Allah while you know الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ Sahih International [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him]. Bangla যে পবিত্রসত্তা তোমাদের জন্য ভূমিকে বিছানা এবং আকাশকে ছাদ স্বরূপ স্থাপন করে দিয়েছেন, আর আকাশ থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করে তোমাদের জন্য ফল-ফসল উৎপাদন করেছেন তোমাদের খাদ্য হিসাবে। অতএব, আল্লাহর সাথে তোমরা অন্য কাকেও সমকক্ষ করো না। বস্তুতঃ এসব তোমরা জান। My Critical Reasoning: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! What type of Ayah is this? Statement or description Warning or prohibition. What are the subjects discussed here? Allah, The Best Provider mentions 4 favours Then a warning or prohibition is made about equality. What are the favours mentioned? Made EARTH as bed (spread out) Made SKY as a ceiling Sent RAIN from the sky Produce FRUITS and Vegies What is the Warning about? Do not make EQUALS with Allah, The Best of the Creators. What do you understand by ‘EQUALS’? Setting as Partners. which means shirk which means something that cause to enter Jahannam! What do you think could be the relation of this warning with the favours mentioned? Simple! I give you favour, not someone else or something else. Therefore, if you give CREDIT to someone or something else for those favours, then you making me equal with something or somebody. How could this happen? Simple, if you say it rains because “water evaporated as a result of heat from the sun, then moisture from air gathered to form cloud and then those cloud become heavy and dropped back to the earth” but you just give credits to those chemical reactions and saying ‘natural cycle’ etc. but do not give credit to Allah who is maintaining all these affairs and made all these things happen, then you are setting equals with Allah. It’s just that simple! (Note: all of these science are correct as Allah, The Maintainers of All Affairs, has described all these ‘water cycles’ process in Quran ) And that’s how they taught you in schools, universities, documentaries and you only knew science behind all these process and incidents and they never taught you the reason behind this science. The Creator of all these matters, Allah were absent in their teachings and that’s how, O Muslims, by years after years of brain washing (giving credit to ‘nature’, you can observe the outcome, how even Muslim scholars, let alone the regular Muslim, say the words, ‘natural disaster’, ‘natural phenomenon’), they took you out of Islam (by engaging you in Shirk) and that’s how they put a ‘secular’ mind set in your grand parents (water cycle being only one example) more than 100 years back when they introduce thier school system in Muslim countries and your fathers and grandfathers rushed towards these schools to get educated and became ‘modern’ and you can see the result of modern ‘Muslim’ today! May Allah forgive them. And Allah knows best. Allah guide Muslims! Ameen!

Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulallah! What type of Ayah is this? Statement or description Warning or prohibition. What are the subjects discussed here? Allah, The Best Provider mentions 4 favours Then a warning or prohibition is made about equality. What are the fabours mentioned? Made EARTH as bed (spread out) Made SKY as a ceiling Sent RAIN from the sky Produce FRUITS and Vegies What is the Warning about? Do not make EQUALS with Allah, The Best of the Creators. What you understand by ‘EQUALS’? Setting as Partners. which means Shirk which means something that cause to enter Jahannam! What do you think could be the relation of this warning with the favours mentioned? Simple! I give you favour, not someone else or something else. Therefore, if you give CREDIT to someone or something else for those favours, then you making me equal with something or somebody. How could this happen? Simple, if you say it rains because “water evaporated as a result of heat from the sun, then moisture from air gathered to form cloud and then those cloud become heavy and dropped back to the earth” but you just give credits to those chemical reactions and saying ‘natural cycle’ etc. but do not give credit to Allah who is maintaining all these affairs and made all these things happen, then you setting equals with Allah. It’s just that simple! (Note: all of these science are correct as Allah, The Maintainers of All Affairs, has described all these ‘water cycles’ process in Quran ) The Kufr in the teaching in the schools: And that’s how they taught you in schools, universities, documentaries and you only knew science behind all these process and incidents and they never taught you the reason behind this science, the Creator of all these matters were absent in their teachings and that’s how, O Muslims, by years after years of brain washing (giving credit to ‘nature’. The outcome! You can observe how even Muslim scholars, let alone the regular Muslim, say the words, ‘natural disaster’, ‘natural phenomenon’) thus they took you out of Islam (by engaging you in Shirk) and that’s how they put a ‘secular’ mind-set in your grand parents (water cycle being only one example) more than 100 years back when they introduce this school system in Muslim countries and your fathers and grandfathers rushed towards these schools to get educated and became ‘modern’. The pride and the prestige, you call it certificate: On the other hand they put you through a system of ‘certificate’ namely as a process of evaluating you, grading your skill but in their scheme that was done to put ‘prestige, social ‘status’ in your mind through those certificates which eventually would make you proud so that you honor, respect those and introduce yourself as ‘Dr’, ‘Eng’, ‘PhD’ etc and thus you disregard, dishonored what Allah give honor to. To Allah, the Best Judge, the best one among you are who has FEAR Allah more, but these Kuffar’s school systems make you to believe the best one is who has got PhDs, and University degrees. And this disease of Shirk engraved into your mind to such an extent (as the root planted in few generations before) that not only secular system of schools or universities but today the Muslims also earn prestige and gives honor to those who has a degree from such and such ‘Islamic’ University not to those who has more fear of Allah. And that’s how you put down Allah, the Most High and honor the system of kuffar and that’s how they take you out of Islam and put you straight to the path of Jahannam. And Allah knows best. May Allah guide Muslims! May Allah save Muslims from these built-in Shirk that the Kuffar brought onto them in last 100 years. Ameen!

t: Quran 18:26. Allah do not SHARE His LEGISLATION/ LAW with anyone.
e: and He shares not His legislation with anyone.
x: 18:26 and He shares not His legislation with anyone. وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِي حُكْمِهِ أَحَدًا قُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا ۖ لَهُ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ أَبْصِرْ بِهِ وَأَسْمِعْ ۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِي حُكْمِهِ أَحَدًا Sahih International Say, ” Allah is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone. “ Bangla বলুনঃ তারা কতকাল অবস্থান করেছে, তা আল্লাহই ভাল জানেন। নভোমন্ডল ও ভুমন্ডলের অদৃশ্য বিষয়ের জ্ঞান তাঁরই কাছে রয়েছে। তিনি কত চমৎকার দেখেন ও শোনেন। তিনি ব্যতীত তাদের জন্য কোন সাহায্যকারী নেই। তিনি কাউকে নিজ কর্তৃত্বে শরীক করেন না।

t: Quran 7:54. Allah is the RABB of the universe
e: Indeed, your Lord is Allah , who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, th
x: 7:54 Indeed, your Lord is Allah……His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah , Lord of the worlds. إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ ۗ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ Sahih International Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah , Lord of the worlds. Bangla নিশ্চয় তোমাদের প্রতিপালক আল্লাহ। তিনি নভোমন্ডল ও ভূমন্ডলকে ছয় দিনে সৃষ্টি করেছেন। অতঃপর আরশের উপর অধিষ্টিত হয়েছেন। তিনি পরিয়ে দেন রাতের উপর দিনকে এমতাবস্থায় যে, দিন দৌড়ে রাতের পিছনে আসে। তিনি সৃষ্টি করেছেন সূর্য, চন্দ্র ও নক্ষত্র দৌড় স্বীয় আদেশের অনুগামী। শুনে রেখ, তাঁরই কাজ সৃষ্টি করা এবং আদেশ দান করা। আল্লাহ, বরকতময় যিনি বিশ্বজগতের প্রতিপালক। Universe created in Six periods. Allah created the nature. My Comment: I don’t like the translation of the word ‘Rabb’ as ‘Lord’ which is common in almost all English translations. It seems that is the best choice, however, it gives me an awkward feeling. It doesn’t even come close to the proper meaning of Rabb. It means everything that the creator does for me, from creating me as a best creation and then nourishing every single cell of my body , giving me the needs , guiding me , teaching me knowledge , teaching me how to worship him , guarding me , showing me the right or wrong , warning me of the bad , rewarding me for the good , and everything else in between . I think those translations should be corrected and the word ‘Lord’ should be replaced with the original Allah’s word ‘Rabb’ by putting a general note about what ‘Rabb’ means. And Allah knows best. May Allah guide us and make us submit to him entirely and enrich us with pure knowledge. Ameen.

t: 2:22 Allah made EARTH for us as a RESTING PLACE

t: Quran 2:22. Allah created EARTH as a FLAT BED and SKY as a CEILING, sent RAIN as RIZQ
x: 2:22 الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ Sahih International He who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him]. Bangla যে পবিত্রসত্তা তোমাদের জন্য ভূমিকে বিছানা এবং আকাশকে ছাদ স্বরূপ স্থাপন করে দিয়েছেন , আর আকাশ থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করে তোমাদের জন্য ফল-ফসল উৎপাদন করেছেন তোমাদের খাদ্য হিসাবে। অতএব, আল্লাহর সাথে তোমরা অন্য কাকেও সমকক্ষ করো না। বস্তুতঃ এসব তোমরা জান। Critical REASONING: What’s the relation of describing Allah’s creation and then Allah’s favour (Rain as RIZQ) with not setting EQAL/ RIVAL with Allah? Simply, giving credit for these favours and these creations to anything or anybody else is a matter of SHIRK. Who sent rain? Allah! The Earth as a FARASHA (FLAT BED)

t: Quran 6:70 – Al-Ana’m. And leave those who take their Deen (religion) as play and amusement.
x: 6:70 And leave those whom the worldly life has deluded. وَذَرِ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَذَكِّرْ بِهِ أَن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ وَإِن تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَا ۗ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوا بِمَا كَسَبُوا ۖ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْفُرُونَ Sahih International And leave those who take their religion as amusement and diversion and whom the worldly life has deluded. But remind with the Qur’an, lest a soul be given up to destruction for what it earned; it will have other than Allah no protector and no intercessor. And if it should offer every compensation, it would not be taken from it. Those are the ones who are given to destruction for what they have earned. For them will be a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve. Bangla তাদেরকে পরিত্যাগ করুন, যারা নিজেদের ধর্মকে ক্রীড়া ও কৌতুকরূপে গ্রহণ করেছে এবং পার্থিব জীবন যাদেরকে ধোঁকায় ফেলে রেখেছে। কোরআন দ্বারা তাদেরকে উপদেশ দিন, যাতে কেউ স্বীয় কর্মে এমন ভাবে গ্রেফতার না হয়ে যায় যে, আল্লাহ ব্যতীত তার কোন সাহায্যকারী ও সুপারিশকারী নেই এবং যদি তারা জগতের বিনিময়ও প্রদান কবে, তবু তাদের কাছ থেকে তা গ্রহণ করা হবে না। একাই স্বীয় কর্মে জড়িত হয়ে পড়েছে। তাদের জন্যে উত্তপ্ত পানি এবং যন্ত্রণাদায়ক শাস্তি রয়েছে-কুফরের কারণে।

Bangla নিশ্চয় তোমাদের প্রতিপালক আল্লাহ। তিনি নভোমন্ডল ও ভূমন্ডলকে ছয় দিনে সৃষ্টি করেছেন। অতঃপর আরশের উপর অধিষ্টিত হয়েছেন। তিনি পরিয়ে দেন রাতের উপর দিনকে এমতাবস্থায় যে, দিন দৌড়ে রাতের পিছনে আসে। তিনি সৃষ্টি করেছেন সূর্য, চন্দ্র ও নক্ষত্র দৌড় স্বীয় আদেশের অনুগামী। শুনে রেখ, তাঁরই কাজ সৃষ্টি করা এবং আদেশ দান করা। আল্লাহ, বরকতময় যিনি বিশ্বজগতের প্রতিপালক। My Comment: I don’t like the translation of the word ‘Rabb’ as ‘Lord’, which is common in almost all English translations. It means everything that the creator does for me, from creating me as a best creation and then nourishing every single cell of my body , giving me the needs , guiding me , teaching me knowledge , teaching me how to worship him , guarding me , showing me write or wrong , warning me of the bad , rewarding me for the good , and everything else in between . Bangla তোমরা আল্লাহকে ছেড়ে নিছক কতগুলো নামের এবাদত কর, সেগুলো তোমরা এবং তোমাদের বাপ-দাদারা সাব্যস্ত করে নিয়েছে। আল্লাহ এদের কোন প্রমাণ অবতীর্ণ করেননি। আল্লাহ ছাড়া কারও বিধান দেবার ক্ষমতা নেই। তিনি আদেশ দিয়েছেন যে, তিনি ব্যতীত অন্য কারও এবাদত করো না। এটাই সরল পথ। কিন্তু অধিকাংশ লোক তা জানে না। Related Ayah: 53:23 My Comments: This aya is enough to confirm that any worship requires approval from Allah as such from his messengers for all previous nations as such from Muhammad Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi WaSAllam for this nation as he has instructed or showed or approved. Traditionally this is regarded as ‘Bida’h’ according to the hadith. But logically this is just not only ‘bida’h’ but a clear shirk. Let me explain. As Allah mentions He did not send ‘AUTHORITY’ for what they worship, therefore, it is clear that any worship needs authority from Allah. In other words, worship methods or system is Allah’s authority. Therefore, if you do not follow the ‘proper’ authority, you are giving someone else that right of ‘authority’, therefore you setting an equal to Allah by giving the authority, which belongs to Allah, to someone or something else, in this case, it is your own ‘desire’ (ideas and thoughts) as Allah mentions else where at 53:23 That’s how it becomes shirk, setting an equals to Allah, the only authority of worship. And Allah knows best.

What is it being a Muslim? How a Muslim differs from a Kafir? How a Muslim differs from a Kafir? Muslim is the one who, when things presented to him, he uses his mind , he looks for evidence and if it is the truth, he accepts it, that’s the history of people who became Muslim since Rasulullah sallillahu alaihi wa Sallam started calling to Allah. Ignorance, arrogance and ego have no place in being a Muslim. The truth is presented to him but he ignores it, that’s a character of a Kafir, not of a Muslim. The truth is presented to him but he passes it without giving a further thought about it, this is the character of an ignorant, the Jaheel, not of a Muslim. The truth is presented to him and even though he admits it as the truth but does not accept it, that’s the character of a kafir, not of a Muslim. The truth is presented to him and he knows in his heart that it is the truth but denies accepting it; this is the character of an arrogant kafir, not of a Muslim. The truth is presented to him, he accepts it as the truth but it doesn’t reflect in his action , he goes back to his habit; this is the character of sheep, the cattle, not of a Muslim Truth is presented to him and even though he accepts it as the truth but he does not practice it rather keeps following his father’s ways, that’s the character of a blind follower, not of a Muslim. css_animation=”fadeInUp”] O Mankind, Your Creator created you and equipped you with a device called the brain and its associated organs, unlike that which He gave to His other creations. And honoured you, raised you above all other creations. And He gave you an eternal life and put you in Al-Jannah – The Paradise. Then you were placed on this Earth for some time to test your obedience. And He laid down a path for you back to Jannah. And He gave you a map narrating every hurdle in detail in that path which you need to be aware of and protect yourself from on your way back to Jannah to live eternally. He informed you that you have an enemy within yourself, the NAFS – your desire He informed you that you have an unseen enemy, the shaitan – among the Jinns He informed you that you have a seen enemy, shaitan – among the Humans He informed you of your enemy, the kuffar, who will not believe in the creator and those who will not follow the CORRECT guidelines of your creator. And then He informed you of the hurdle of the life (only around 80 years). He informed you about the hurdle of the moment of death. He informed you about the hurdle of the grave (the space of time is unknown). He informed you about the hurdle of the Resurrection (the space of time is unknown). He informed you about the hurdle of the Day of Judgement (50,000 years long). And then he warned you about the greatest hurdle of all, Jahannam, Hell (eternal). And He laid down exactly how to overcome all those hurdles and make your way back to Jannah. He detailed everything which, if you do, will make Him LOVE you and that which will make Him HATE you. He warned you of everything which, if you do, will earn His WRATH and enter you in the FIRE. And He detailed everything which, if you follow, will earn His Blessing, Mercy and His Forgiveness. O Mankind, But you only have this tiny lifespan to work to overcome all those hurdles of the journey which will last for a long long time. But what are you doing? Why do you only care about ONE hurdle which consists of the smallest unit of your entire journey and forget about the other parts of the journey which are unimaginably longer? How are you so deluded and comfortable in this tiny space of your entire Journey? If you think this is about you, if you think this connects you, then this blog is designed to give you the whole picture of your journey In Shaa Allah, Bi Iznillah, so that you can find your status as to where you stand, what you lack and what you need to work on. I recommend you browse through the MAP and get your heart involved in it. May Allah Subhanahu make us understand and May Allah guide us and May Allah, the perpetual forgiver forgive us and allow us to enter into Jannah, the Paradise, our original home. Ameen. On the other hand, did you notice how much you remain focus when you are on a journey? Do you know why? Read more… [/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”GET a TOTAL PICTURE of your DEEN and KNOW where you STAND” tab_id=”1540912564982-5136cd78-5256″][vc_video link=”https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dL6wK_jOIc8″ align=”center” css_animation=”zoomIn”][vc_column_text css_animation=”fadeInUp” css=”.vc_custom_1546629449556{background-color: #eaeaea !important;}”] You are reading an Ayah of the Quran or reading a Hadith or listening to a lecture, you are learning something. You remain focused on whatever you learned today. Tomorrow new things add up because you are learning continuously. Therefore what happens? You concentrate more on what you learned today and consequently, you give less concentration on the lessons of the previous days. And soon your focus on that previous ones gets faded away when you have to focus on new things every day. It happens to all of us, right? So, what do you do? How can you REMAIN focus on ALL the things and issues ALL the time? Read more… [/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Where does you FIT in which you learned today?” tab_id=”1540912637819-db68780f-1c1d”][vc_single_image image=”5335″ img_size=”” css_animation=”zoomIn”][vc_column_text css_animation=”fadeInUp”]You learned something of Deen today. But do you know where does it fit in the map of your journey? Exactly how significant it is in the different stages of your journey? It surely seems important what you learned today but are you giving it the optimum importance it should deserve? (Zalimun, Khasirun etc.) INFORMATION BASED: If the Ayah does not fall in any of the above questions then Is it an information/ Statement/ Description of Allah that gives me CERTAIN KNOWLEDGE? DUA: Is it a REQUEST/ asking for help? Is it a PRAISE/ Thanks/ Gratitude? FINDING SUBJECTS/ Issues/ Topics/ Incidents: WHAT is the SUBJECT Allah talking about? (Allah HIMSELF, Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi WaSallam, Quran, Prophets, Angels Qiamah, Jannah, Zahannam, Human Being, shaitan, Creations (Bees, Ants) etc. (to gain CERTAIN KNOWLEDGE about Deen and Aqeedah ) WHO is the subject? VOCABULARY: Learn one NEW easy word every day In case you want to do the same, TIPS for you: Make a separate Section in the folder for each Category such as Command, Prohibitions, Good thing to do, a Bad thing to avoid and for all the subjects mentioned You can use a hard file (if you prefer manual) or you use Microsoft One Note or Word to start noting. If your intention is to obey and know Allah so that you can worship Allah better, then you will see what knowledge Allah bestow on you , InShaaAllah. On the contrary, if you read Quran just for the sake of knowledge and knowing Quran, then you might get knowledge of Quran but you might not get benefit from that knowledge. Allah knows best. Make this dua always in every prayer . May Allah make it easy for you to learn Quran with the correct intention. Ameen. If you like it then print this and give it to your child from 7 years of age to an old person who wants to inquire into the Quran. You can get this in word and pdf files in English and in Bangla from this link.

x: AsSalamu Alaikum, To whom it may concern This is my effort to emphasis EACH WORD of an ayah and my understanding on that ayah. It is not a scholarly opinion on Quran but only a reader’s understanding of Quran. I took Quran personally and look at an ayah to find the following: Is it a COMMAND for me to act on? Is it a COMMAND (Prohibition) for me to stay away from? Is it what Allah likes and Allah Loves? Is it what Allah dislikes or HATES? Is it a character of the people of Jannah that I have to achieve? Is it a character of the people of Jahannam that I have to stay away from? Is it a statement of Allah which gives a CERTAIN KNOWLEDGE? But my limitations is that I ONLY depend on the English TRANSLATIONS, which is, in my understanding nowhere near to the original meaning but best possible way to get closer to an understanding of Allah’s word for me while I am still trying to learn the Arabic language. Meanwhile, I try to look at the Arabic word how it was translated in different ayah all over the Quran. Credit goes to Quran.com . Al Hamdulillah, they did tremendous Job, you can have a look what I mean by ‘how a particular word is translated in a different context all over the Quran’ Then very rarely though I look at the Lanes Lexicon Then sometimes I look at Tafsir Ibne Katheer and Tafsir by Sayid Qutb and Tafsir Ibne Abbas. Very important: If it does happen that any learned brother or sister do not agree with my understanding or I did a mistake or went wrong in anything, please teach me and correct me. But your obligation is to produce relevant evidence. Furthermore, if it does happen that you find I am too far away from what really is understood by our Ulama then please do not insult me in your writings as it might bring arrogance in me and take me far away from accepting the truth rather write me with respect so that I may find it easy to correct myself. I did not keep comment open to my reader as I do not want to spend time on a reader’s knocking on me on the run. Rather, I expect that a sincere reader would take time to write me for anything of his/her concern and if you do, please email me to “Abu.Aabdullah.Ahsan@gmail.com” JazakAllahu Khair. By the way, just not to beat around the bush, I need to clear something straightforward that I don’t belong to any group or sect, I call myself Muslim. “I am simply a Muslim”
